title.rendered: What It Actually Takes to Get Verified on Roblox: Here’s How to Get It

content.rendered:
Getting that blue checkmark on Roblox feels impossible, and in many ways, it is. It is not designed for most users, and Roblox doesn’t even provide an option to apply for verification. Accounts are automatically reviewed and verified when they meet certain criteria.

While the process is automatic, strict, and built around scale, there is still a clear path that can help you qualify for the verification badge, often without you actively aiming for it.

Here is exactly how the system works and what it really takes to get there.

Types of Roblox Verification: ID vs Verified Badge

On Roblox, there are two types of verification:

  • ID verification for all users
  • Verified badge for notable creators

ID verification involves submitting a government ID and taking a selfie. Roblox uses this to confirm your identity and age, which unlocks voice chat, 17+ experiences, and more relaxed communication features. This is mainly about access, and you can check this article to learn more about how to apply and get voice chat.

The verified badge is completely different. This is something that reflects your presence on the platform, and Roblox adds a badge next to your username in the app.

Can You Apply for Roblox Verification?

This is the biggest misconception. There is no form to fill out, no request button, and no direct way to ask for verification.

Instead, the system is passive. Roblox tracks accounts that meet its criteria and reviews them in cycles, usually once a month. Even if you qualify today, nothing happens immediately. Your account gets picked up in a later review.

The process works like this:

  • You meet the criteria
  • Roblox reviews your account
  • The badge appears later without notice

You do not apply. You qualify.

Roblox Verification Requirements: What You Need to Qualify

Roblox evaluates accounts using three signals. Think of this as a filter. You need to pass all three to move forward.

1. Notability Requirements (Followers, Playtime, Revenue)

This is the hardest part and also the most important consideration for Roblox to verify you. Roblox is looking for accounts that are already large and recognized.

Typical thresholds look like this:

  • Developers need over 1 million hours of playtime in the last 90 days
  • UGC creators need around 2 million Robux in revenue and 200,000 sales in the same period
  • Influencers or brands usually need around 100,000 followers on a major platform or involvement in official Roblox programs

At this stage, effort is not the deciding factor. Scale is. Your work needs to reach enough people that Roblox can confidently label it as notable.

2. ID Verification and Eligibility Rules

Once you reach that scale, Roblox needs to confirm that the account actually belongs to you.

This is done through ID verification. You submit a government-issued document and complete a face scan. The system checks if your identity matches the account owner.

This is not similar to the ID verification for all users to verify the user’s age. You can get verified even if you are under 17. However, users under 13 are not eligible for the verified badge.

3. Security and Activity Requirements

Verified accounts are high-value targets, so Roblox expects strong security and consistent usage. You need to:

  • Enable two-factor authentication using an authenticator app
  • Keep the account active consistently
  • Stay active on the platform

This tells Roblox that your account is secure, maintained, and not abandoned.

How Roblox Gives the Verified Badge (No Application Needed)

Once all requirements are met, there is no final step or confirmation. Roblox reviews eligible accounts during its monthly cycles. If your account passes all checks, the badge is added automatically.

There is no notification or approval message. The badge simply appears.

This badge is a trust signal for people to find your account easily and avoid impersonators. However, it doesn’t provide any in-game advantages or improve how your game or UGC items are recommended on the platform.

If you’re building your own experience, learning how to make a Game Pass on Roblox can help you monetize your game and grow faster.

Can You Lose the Roblox Verified Badge?

The system does not stop after you get verified. Even small changes can result in losing the badge:

  • Changing your username or display name
  • Disabling two-factor authentication
  • Violating platform rules
  • Long inactivity

If this happens, your account may need to be reviewed again in a future cycle.

Why Most People Never Get Verified on Roblox

Most people try to chase verification directly, but that approach does not work. Verification is not something you aim for on its own. It is the result of reaching a certain level of scale, trust, and consistency. A better approach is to focus on what leads to it:

  • Build experiences that people actually spend time in
  • Grow a real audience, not inflated numbers
  • Stay consistent over time

When your work reaches that level, verification becomes a byproduct.

title.rendered: Apple’s Entry-Level iPad With A18 Chip And Apple Intelligence Still Set For 2026 Launch

content.rendered:
Apple is preparing to launch a new entry-level iPad with an A18 chip and support for Apple Intelligence, with the device still on track to arrive in 2026. Bloomberg’s Mark Gurman said the product is “ready to go” and remains scheduled for release this year, positioning it as the final iPad model to gain Apple’s AI features.

A18 Chip Enables Apple Intelligence On Entry-Level iPad

The upcoming model is expected to move from the A16 chip in the current iPad to the A18, enabling support for Apple Intelligence. That shift is significant because the base iPad is currently the only model in Apple’s lineup without access to the company’s on-device and cloud-assisted AI features.

The A18 chip, already used in the iPhone 16 lineup, is designed to handle Apple Intelligence tasks such as text generation, summarization, and system-wide assistance. Bringing that capability to the lowest-cost iPad expands Apple’s AI platform across its entire tablet range.

Launch Window And Scope Of Changes

The device has been on Apple’s internal roadmap for a release aligned with the iOS 26.4 cycle, which runs through the first half of 2026. With that software update nearing completion, the hardware is expected to debut within the same timeframe. Gurman indicated the product is ready for launch, suggesting that timing now depends on Apple’s release schedule rather than development readiness.

No major design or hardware changes have been reported for the new model. The iPad is expected to retain the same overall design as the current generation, with the A18 upgrade serving as the primary update. There are indications that Apple could introduce its in-house connectivity components, including a C1 modem and N1 networking chip, though those details remain unconfirmed.

Apple last updated the base iPad in March 2025 with the A16 chip, starting at $349 in the United States. With the addition of Apple Intelligence, the next model would bring feature parity with the iPad mini, iPad Air, and iPad Pro, completing Apple’s transition to AI-capable hardware across its tablet lineup.

title.rendered: Apple WWDC 2026: Event Date, iOS 27 Changes, and What to Expect

content.rendered:
Apple’s biggest software event of the year is getting closer, and the conversation around WWDC 2026 has already started to take shape. The company hasn’t shared official dates yet, but all signs point to its usual early June window, with the keynote expected to land in the second week of the month.

What is more interesting than the timing, though, is the shift in focus.

This year’s updates, led by iOS 27, are not expected to chase dramatic redesigns or headline-grabbing features. Instead, Apple appears to be entering a phase where refinement, intelligence, and long-term platform stability take priority.

WWDC 2026 Timeline

Apple has consistently scheduled WWDC in the first half of June, and this year is expected to follow the same pattern. Based on this trend, the event could run from June 8 through June 12, with the keynote taking place on the opening day.

Apple typically confirms the dates toward the end of March, so an official announcement should arrive soon.

WWDC 2026: What to Expect

iOS 27 Could Be More About Polish Than New Features

This year’s iOS update does not appear to be about bold visual changes. Instead, iOS 27 is expected to focus on improving performance, reducing bugs, and delivering a more stable experience overall.

Apple has taken this approach before with polish updates that refine the system after multiple feature-heavy releases. The aim here is to make everyday interactions faster and more reliable without changing the core experience.

AI Could Take Center Stage Once Again

Artificial intelligence is likely to remain a major theme at WWDC 2026. Reports suggest that Siri could become more context-aware, backed by deeper integration with Apple Intelligence features.

Rather than introducing flashy additions, Apple is expected to focus on making AI more useful in real-world scenarios, while continuing its emphasis on on-device processing for privacy.

No Major Redesign Expected, but Improvements Are Likely

The existing Liquid Glass design language is expected to stay in place. Apple may instead refine elements such as readability, contrast, and overall interface consistency.

This signals a shift toward polishing the current design rather than introducing a completely new visual direction.

Hints of Foldable iPhone Support

iOS 27 could also include early groundwork for future hardware (iPhone Fold). Some reports point to early internal support for foldable displays, suggesting Apple is preparing its software for new form factors that could arrive later in 2026.

Try: Download the WWDC 2026 wallpapers in 4k

A Subtle but Strategic Update

Alongside iOS 27, Apple is expected to unveil updates across macOS, iPadOS, watchOS, visionOS, and tvOS, continuing its ecosystem-wide evolution.

WWDC 2026 may not be about dramatic announcements. Instead, it appears to be a transition phase focused on stability, intelligence, and long-term improvements.

What would you like Apple to improve in iOS 27? Drop your thoughts below.

title.rendered: How to Switch from Business to Personal Account on Instagram

content.rendered:
With influencer culture and brand marketing on the rise on Instagram, many users are switching to a Business account for insights, ads, and professional tools. These features help track performance and promote content, but they are not useful for everyone. However, not every business or aspiring influencer finds success, and many users eventually prefer a simpler, more private experience.

This is why many users look for ways to turn off their business account. The problem is that Instagram does not offer a direct option to disable a Business account. Instead, you need to switch the account back to a Personal account.

This post explains how to switch your Instagram business account to a personal account and what happens after.

Table of Contents
  • What is an Instagram Business Account?
  • 2 Ways to Switch Back to Personal Account on Instagram
    • Via the Professional Dashboard
    • From the Account Settings
  • What Happens After Switching to a Personal Account on Instagram
  • Why People Turn Off Business Accounts on Instagram
  • Can You Switch Back to a Business Account Later?
  • Difference Between a Business and Personal Account on Instagram
  • Back to a Simpler Instagram Experience…

What is an Instagram Business Account?

As the name suggests, a Business Account on Instagram is an account type designed for brands, companies, and service providers. It unlocks various tools and insights useful for growth and marketing that aren’t available to personal accounts and are largely similar to those in creator accounts.

Key features include:

  • Insights for posts and followers
  • Ad and promotion tools
  • Contact buttons, such as email or call
  • Access to Meta business tools
  • Product tagging and shopping features

2 Ways to Switch Back to Personal Account on Instagram

There are two ways you can turn off the business account on Instagram. Here’s how:

Via the Professional Dashboard

  1. Tap the Professional Dashboard banner on your Instagram profile.
  2. Tap the Settings icon in the top right corner.
  3. Next, scroll down and tap Switch account type.
  4. Now, choose “Switch to personal account.”
  5. Tap Switch to confirm.

From the Account Settings

  1. Head to your Instagram profile and tap the hamburger (More options) icon in the top right corner.
  2. Here, scroll down and tap Account type and tools under the For professionals section.
  3. Next, tap Account type.
  4. Now, tap Switch account type, then choose “Switch to personal account.”
  5. Tap Switch to confirm.

What Happens After Switching to a Personal Account on Instagram

Switching your account type does not affect your existing content or followers. However, you lose access to features and tools such as:

  • Insights and analytics data
  • Ad and promotion tools
  • Contact buttons on your profile
  • Access to a professional dashboard

Your account simply returns to a regular Instagram experience.

What Stays the Same:

  • Your posts, reels, and stories remain unchanged
  • Your followers and following list stay intact
  • Direct messages and chats are not affected

Why People Turn Off Business Accounts on Instagram

There are a few common reasons users switch back to a Personal account:

  • Simpler experience: Business tools add extra sections and notifications that are not always needed.
  • More control over privacy: Personal accounts can be set to private, giving you full control over who sees your content.
  • No need for analytics: If you are not tracking growth or running campaigns, insights may not be useful.

Can You Switch Back to a Business Account Later?

Just as you switched from a business account to a personal account, you can switch back to a business account at any time if you decide to use Business features again.

Difference Between a Business and Personal Account on Instagram

Each of the three Instagram account types is designed for a different kind of user and comes with its own tools and limitations. Understanding the differences can help you choose the account type that fits your needs.

Back to a Simpler Instagram Experience…

And that’s it; now you know that turning off a Business account on Instagram simply means switching it back to a Personal account. The process takes only a few taps and does not affect your posts, followers, or messages.

If you no longer need analytics or promotional tools and want to make your account private, this is the only way to simplify your Instagram experience while keeping everything else intact.

Have you switched your Instagram account back to Personal, or are you still using Business features? Share your experience in the comments.

You may like to read:

  • How to use AI Voice Effects in Instagram DMs
  • How to Block and Unblock Someone on Instagram

title.rendered: I Tested These Coloring Apps and Ditched Paper (Best Picks for iPhone and Android)

content.rendered:
Coloring isn’t just for kids anymore! It’s a fun, relaxing way for anyone to unwind, get creative, improve focus, and take a break from screens filled with stress. Whether you’re looking for a calming activity after a long day or a playful app to keep kids engaged, coloring apps make it easy to dive into creativity anytime, anywhere.

In this guide, I’ve rounded up the best coloring apps for iPhone, iPad, and Android that offer beautiful designs, intuitive tools, and something for every age group. And you don’t require any artistic skill; just open them and start filling in colors.

Table of Contents
  • How I Picked the Best Coloring Apps in 2026 (What Actually Matters)
  • I Tested These Coloring Apps So You Don't Have To
    • 1. Happy Color By Numbers Game: Offers a relaxing, no-effort coloring experience
    • 2. Sandbox Pixel Art: Unique game-like coloring
    • 3. Color Pop AI – Coloring Book: Enjoy creative flexibility with smart tools
    • 4. Coloring Book for Me: Calming, artistic experience
    • 5. Jelly Dye: Satisfying ASMR Game: Funny 3D graphics
    • 6. Color Page ASMR – Art Coloring: Guided coloring experience
  • Which Coloring App Should You Actually Use? (My Honest Picks)
  • Final Thoughts: What These Coloring Apps Taught Me After Using Them

How I Picked the Best Coloring Apps in 2026 (What Actually Matters)

Not all coloring apps feel the same. Some are designed to help you relax, while others lean more toward quick, game-like satisfaction. After trying a bunch of them, I’ve found that the “best” app really depends on how you plan to use it.

Before you download anything, here are a few things that actually matter:

  • Ease of Use: If you just want to relax, go for apps with tap-to-fill or paint-by-number systems. They’re simple and don’t require any learning curve.
  • Content Library: Some apps get boring pretty fast. If the app is good, then they’ll add more content frequently. So, you always have something fresh to color.
  • Ads and Pricing: Most free apps come with ads or locked content. If that bothers you, check if there’s a one-time purchase or a reasonable subscription.
  • Offline Support: Not every app works without internet. If you travel or have limited data, this makes a big difference.
  • AI Features: Some newer apps can suggest colors, auto-fill sections, or even turn your photos into coloring pages. It’s not essential, but it’s a nice bonus.

I Tested These Coloring Apps So You Don’t Have To

I have tested a mix of popular and lesser-known coloring apps to find the ones that are actually fun to use, not just stuffed with ads or repetitive designs. The apps below strike a good balance between ease of use, variety, and overall experience.

One more thing: my list below focuses on coloring apps, not full-fledged drawing tools like Sketchbook or Ibis Paint X. If you want to create art from scratch, those are better options. But if you just want something easy, relaxing, and fun, a dedicated coloring app is the way to go

1. Happy Color By Numbers Game: Offers a relaxing, no-effort coloring experience

I keep coming back to Happy Color whenever I just want to relax without thinking too much. It is a paint-by-numbers kind of app, and all you have to do is just tap away. There’s no guesswork, and it’s surprisingly satisfying once you get into it.

You get over 40,000 high-quality pictures from nature, atmospheric themes, and exclusive Disney scenes from The Lion King, Cinderella, Winnie the Pooh, etc., plus original hand-drawn pictures from artists worldwide.

The app also adds new images daily, which keeps things fresh. You can also color postcards, add a personal note, and share them with your loved ones. The best part is you get to enjoy all these for free, and coloring doesn’t require the internet.

Pros

  • Extremely easy to use 
  • Huge collection of images 
  • Daily new artwork 
  • Great for beginners 

Cons

  • Limited creative freedom (mostly guided coloring) 
  • Ads in the free version 

Price: Free (In-app purchases start at $1.99)

Download: iPhone | Android

2. Sandbox Pixel Art: Unique game-like coloring

If you enjoy pixel-style designs, Sandbox Pixel Art is one of the most satisfying apps you can use.

You zoom into a grid and fill tiny squares with colors one by one—similar to retro game graphics. It feels a bit like solving a puzzle, especially with more detailed images. Along with the pictures offered in the app, you can turn your photos from the gallery into pixel art.

Additionally, the app includes a free drawing mode to help you practice pixel art.

Pros

  • Unique pixel-art style 
  • Great zooming and precision controls 
  • Fun and addictive 

Cons

  • Can feel repetitive over time 
  • Less artistic variety compared to others 

Price: Free (In-app purchases start at $2.99)

Download: iPhone | Android

3. Color Pop AI – Coloring Book: Enjoy creative flexibility with smart tools

Color Pop AI feels more modern compared to most coloring apps. Instead of just filling sections, it lets you highlight parts of an image while keeping the rest black and white. You can even use AI to generate coloring pages using prompts or turn photos into different types of sketches, which you can color later.

After you finish your artwork, you can share it with others in the Color Pop community. What I liked about this app is its intuitive, realistic painting tools. Select a palette, choose the brushes and effects, and start coloring!

Pros

  • AI-powered features 
  • More creative control than basic apps 
  • Clean and modern interface 
  • Extensive catalogues including Mandala, patterns, and florals

Cons

  • Some features are locked behind a subscription 
  • Slight learning curve 

Price: Free (Weekly Premium Pass starts at $7.99) 

Download: iPhone | Android

4. Coloring Book for Me: Calming, artistic experience

This is the app I open when I want something calm and distraction-free. This app is designed primarily for adults who enjoy detailed artwork, such as mandalas and patterns, which are great for slowing down and focusing. You get unique gradients, textures, and a more artistic feel compared to basic color-by-number apps. 

Simply, create your own mandala and color it with different palettes while listening to soothing music. You can also color sketches using your own pictures. The app also provides coloring games if you want a fast-paced session.

Pros

  • Beautiful, detailed designs 
  • Advanced coloring tools 
  • Relaxing background music
  • Great for mindfulness 

Cons

  • Premium required for full access 
  • Not ideal for quick casual use 

Price: Free (Premium weekly starts at $2.99)

Download: iPhone | Android 

5. Jelly Dye: Satisfying ASMR Game: Funny 3D graphics 

Jelly Dye is more of a satisfying ASMR-style coloring game than a traditional coloring app. You inject colors in a soft, jelly-like animation that feels oddly relaxing. Just handpick the right color and pinpoint the best injection position to match the model above. I really liked its 3D graphics for the wobbly jelly reflections.

Pros

  • Highly satisfying visuals 
  • Simple and fun 
  • No-skill gameplay
  • Great for stress relief and quick breaks

Cons

  • Limited artistic depth 
  • Repetitive gameplay 

Price: Free (Premium Membership starts at $4.99)

Download: iPhone | Android 

6. Color Page ASMR – Art Coloring: Guided coloring experience

If you want something super simple, especially for your kids, Color Page ASMR is easy to get into. It guides you through drawing and coloring step by step, which makes it feel more interactive than most apps. As you go through the levels, you get more complex pictures.

Pros

  • Unique tracing + coloring combo 
  • Very beginner-friendly 
  • Relaxing gameplay 

Cons

  • Not ideal for advanced users
  • Lack of creative freedom

Price: Free (Remove ads for $1.99)

Download: iPhone | Android

Which Coloring App Should You Actually Use? (My Honest Picks)

Choosing the right app depends on your goal: 

  • Just want to relax? Go with Happy Color. 
  • Love pixel-style games? Try Sandbox Pixel Art.
  • Want AI and creativity? Pick Color Pop AI. 
  • Looking for detailed art? Choose Coloring Book for Me. 
  • Want something satisfying and fun? Try Jelly Dye or Color Page ASMR. 

If you’re unsure, start with Happy Color; it’s the easiest entry point. 

Final Thoughts: What These Coloring Apps Taught Me After Using Them

After spending time with these apps, one thing is clear. Coloring apps in 2026 are less about “art” and more about how you want to feel while using them.

Some are built to help you slow down and relax. Others are designed to keep you engaged with quick, satisfying interactions. The best ones manage to do both without overwhelming you with features or ads.

If you’re just getting started, don’t overthink it. Pick one app that looks simple and appealing, try it for a few minutes, and see how it fits into your routine. You can always switch later.

At the end of the day, the right coloring app is the one you actually enjoy opening, whether that’s for a quick break, a creative moment, or just a way to unwind after a long day.

About Dhvanesh Ever since teenage years, gadgets and technology have held a special place in Dhvanesh's heart. This fascination with gadgets and their inner workings fueled a lifelong passion for exploration and troubleshooting. Disassembled electronic items scattered around the house became a familiar sight during his younger years, a testament to this insatiable curiosity. However, the desire to share tech knowledge and connect with a like-minded community proved stronger. In 2012, Dhvanesh embarked on a new adventure, founding iGeeksBlog. This blog became a haven for Apple enthusiasts and tech aficionados seeking insightful and in-depth information about everything Apple. A Decade of iGeeksBlog: Leading the Apple Charge In the past 12 years, Dhvanesh has donned multiple hats at iGeeksBlog. As the founder, he has steered the blog’s vision, ensuring it remains a trusted resource for Apple users worldwide. Additionally, he has been serving as the CEO of iGeeks Media Private Limited for the past 4 years, overseeing the company's growth and development. Beyond Writing: A Multifaceted Approach Dhvanesh isn't just a prolific writer, having penned hundreds of articles for iGeeksBlog. He has also served as the blog’s Editor-in-Chief and Content Strategist, ensuring a consistent flow of high-quality content that caters to the diverse needs of the Apple user base. The passion for exploration extends beyond the written word. He has created numerous YouTube videos for iGeeksBlog, providing visual demonstrations and engaging directly with the audience. Staying Connected with the Apple Ecosystem Dhvanesh's dedication to the Apple community goes a step further. Currently, he also manages the iGeeksBlog+ weekly newsletter, delivering curated Apple news, gadgets, apps, tips and tricks straight to subscribers' inboxes. This unwavering commitment to Apple technology and a genuine desire to empower fellow users make him a valuable asset to the iGeeksBlog team.

aioseo_head_json.author_bio:
"The founder of iGeeksBlog, Dhvanesh, is an Apple aficionado, who cannot stand even a slight innuendo about Apple products. He dons the cap of editor-in-chief to make sure that articles match the quality standard before they are published."

About Dhvanesh

Ever since teenage years, gadgets and technology have held a special place in Dhvanesh's heart. This fascination with gadgets and their inner workings fueled a lifelong passion for exploration and troubleshooting. Disassembled electronic items scattered around the house became a familiar sight during his younger years, a testament to this insatiable curiosity.

From SEO Expert to Apple Evangelist

After completing his IT engineering diploma, Dhvanesh's professional journey began with a 4.5-year stint as an SEO executive, honing valuable digital marketing skills. However, the desire to share tech knowledge and connect with a like-minded community proved stronger. In 2012, Dhvanesh embarked on a new adventure, founding iGeeksBlog. This blog became a haven for Apple enthusiasts and tech aficionados seeking insightful and in-depth information about everything Apple.

A Decade of iGeeksBlog: Leading the Apple Charge

In the past 12 years, Dhvanesh has donned multiple hats at iGeeksBlog. As the founder, he has steered the blog’s vision, ensuring it remains a trusted resource for Apple users worldwide. Additionally, he has been serving as the CEO of iGeeks Media Private Limited for the past 4 years, overseeing the company's growth and development.

Beyond Writing: A Multifaceted Approach

Dhvanesh isn't just a prolific writer, having penned hundreds of articles for iGeeksBlog. He has also served as the blog’s Editor-in-Chief and Content Strategist, ensuring a consistent flow of high-quality content that caters to the diverse needs of the Apple user base. The passion for exploration extends beyond the written word. He has created numerous YouTube videos for iGeeksBlog, providing visual demonstrations and engaging directly with the audience.

Staying Connected with the Apple Ecosystem

Dhvanesh's dedication to the Apple community goes a step further. Currently, he also manages the iGeeksBlog+ weekly newsletter, delivering curated Apple news, gadgets, apps, tips and tricks straight to subscribers' inboxes. This unwavering commitment to Apple technology and a genuine desire to empower fellow users make him a valuable asset to the iGeeksBlog team.

title.rendered: Best Weather Apps for iPhone and Android You Can Use Right Now

content.rendered:
Weather apps are no longer just about checking the temperature before stepping out. They’ve become a part of how we plan our daily lives. Before heading out, planning a trip, or even deciding on weekend plans, most of us check the weather first. We look at forecasts to understand what conditions will be like at our destination, and then plan accordingly.

This growing reliance makes choosing the right weather app more important than ever. But with hundreds of options available, finding one that truly fits your needs is not as simple as it sounds.

To save you the effort, I’ve done the heavy lifting and narrowed it down to the five best weather apps for iPhone and Android you can rely on right now.

Why a Good Weather App Matters

Not all weather apps deliver the same level of accuracy or detail, and that difference can directly impact how useful they are in real situations.

A good weather app focuses on precision and timing. Features like minute-by-minute rain forecasts, real-time radar, and location-specific alerts can help you avoid getting caught in sudden weather changes. This becomes important during travel, outdoor activities, or daily commutes.

Another key factor is how information is presented. The best apps make complex data easy to understand, so you can quickly decide what to do without digging through unnecessary details.

In contrast, a poorly optimized app may show delayed updates, generic forecasts, or cluttered data, which reduces its reliability.

In short, the right weather app is informative, actionable, and gives you clarity at the exact moment you need it.

5 Best Weather Apps for iOS and Android Users

These are the weather apps I found most reliable for accurate forecasts and real-time updates.

1. The Weather Channel

The Weather Channel goes beyond basic forecasting and positions itself as a complete weather platform. It combines accurate forecasts with live radar, storm tracking, and regular updates on ongoing weather conditions.

Its interface is designed to be easy to understand, even with a lot of information on screen. Along with hourly and 10-day forecasts, it also includes videos and insights that help you understand what’s happening rather than just showing numbers.

Pros

  • Comprehensive forecasts and radar
  • Strong severe weather alerts
  • Easy to understand

Cons

  • Heavy ads
  • Feels content-heavy
  • Data usage concerns

Download: iPhone | Android

2. AccuWeather

AccuWeather is one of the most widely used weather apps, known for its reliable forecasts and precise short-term predictions. Its MinuteCast feature stands out by showing minute-by-minute rain updates, which are genuinely useful when you are about to step out.

The app presents detailed information like temperature, humidity, wind speed, and air quality in a structured format. Radar maps and severe weather alerts add another layer of usefulness, making it a strong choice for everyday planning.

Pros

  • Strong short-term accuracy with MinuteCast
  • Detailed weather data and alerts
  • Reliable for daily planning

Cons

  • Ads in free version
  • Key features behind subscription
  • Interface feels slightly crowded

Download: iPhone | Android

3. Windy.com

Windy is designed for users who want a detailed and visual understanding of weather conditions. Instead of focusing on simple forecasts, it presents interactive weather maps that show wind patterns, rainfall, pressure, and more.

The app also allows switching between different forecast models, giving a broader perspective on upcoming conditions. This makes it more suitable for advanced users than casual ones.

Pros

  • Advanced maps and weather models
  • Highly detailed data
  • Great for professionals

Cons

  • Steep learning curve
  • Overkill for casual use
  • Interface can feel complex

Download: iPhone | Android

4. CARROT Weather

CARROT Weather takes a different approach by blending accurate forecasts with a highly customizable interface. It allows you to choose how weather data is presented and even switch between different data sources.

The app is known for its personality-driven experience, but beyond that, it delivers solid forecasting and excellent widget support. It feels more tailored compared to most other weather apps.

Pros

  • Highly customizable
  • Multiple data sources
  • Excellent widgets

Cons

  • Subscription required for full features
  • Not ideal for basic users
  • Setup takes time

Download: iPhone | Android

5. MyRadar

MyRadar is a fast, radar-focused weather app that emphasizes real-time weather tracking. Instead of relying only on forecasts, it shows animated radar maps so you can see exactly what’s approaching your location.

The app opens directly into a live radar view, making it easy to check conditions at a glance. It also includes rain alerts and layers for wind, temperature, and cloud cover, which adds more context without complicating the experience.

Pros

  • Excellent real-time radar
  • Fast and easy to use
  • Reliable rain alerts 

Cons

  • Limited long-term forecast detail
  • More focused on visuals than data
  • Some features require a subscription

Download: iPhone | Android

How to Choose the Right Weather App

Choosing the right weather app comes down to how you plan to use it. Not every app is built for the same purpose, so the best option depends on your priorities.

  • Accuracy: Look for apps known for reliable and timely forecasts, not just good design.
  • Check short-term vs long-term forecasts: Some apps are better for minute-by-minute updates, while others focus on daily or weekly predictions.
  • Look for real-time updates: Frequent refresh rates and live data make a noticeable difference in daily use.
  • Radar and maps: A good radar view helps you track rain, storms, and movement in real time.
  • Level of detail: Choose based on your needs, basic info for casual use or detailed metrics like wind, AQI, and UV index for deeper insights.
  • Ease of use: The app should present information clearly without requiring too much navigation.
  • Alerts and notifications: Timely warnings for rain or severe weather can be genuinely useful.
  • Customization and widgets: Useful for quick access and a more personalized experience.
  • Ads and pricing: Free apps often include ads, while premium versions unlock better features.

Making the Right Choice

There is no single weather app that works for everyone. Each app excels in a specific area. Some focus on accuracy, others on visualization, and a few on customization. The best approach is to choose one that matches how you actually use weather data. For most people, a combination of a simple forecast app and a radar-based app works best.

Do you have a favorite weather app that didn’t make this list? Share it in the comments.

@graph.name: AccuWeather
@graph.description: AccuWeather provides a comprehensive and complete weather report of your location, and it’s also one of the best weather apps for the Apple Watch. I recommend this if you’re looking to get rainfall or snow forecasts up to 120 minutes before stepping out. Getting the exact temperature and rainfall likelihood in your area is one of the features you’ll find helpful on this app, as it updates you in real-time as the day passes. AccuWeather forecasts weather accurately by connecting to various meteorological APIs and mining weather data around you. This helps the app provide actionable insights about impending weather changes. Its MinuteCast feature allows you to foresee precipitation chances and temperature changes for a specified future time. It also has a weather alert system, but this is only currently available for US users. The free version features ads, which aren’t overly intrusive. But watch out! You might click an ad without knowing it’s an ad. However, you can opt for the premium plan to cancel ads and get advanced features.

properties.name: Yahoo Weather app for the iPhone
properties.description: Yahoo Weather offers great value for a free app. The app gives an hourly temperature forecast within 24 hours and a 15-minute interval precipitation forecast within an hour. So users stay in the loop as weather changes in real-time. You can also keep track of temperature changes for the next seven days from your current period. You might get shocked seeing extreme temperature values, but no worries, Yahoo Weather presents these numbers in Fahrenheit instead of Celcius. There’s a thunderstorm forecast, displayed with the percentage likelihood of precipitation, all on the dashboard. The dashboard also details humidity percentage, visibility, ultraviolet index, air quality index, and wind current. What’s unique about Yahoo Weather is it shows the number of confirmed COVID-19 cases in your region. The COVID-19 stat would’ve been better if you could check incidence for specific locations around you. The only reservation I have for this one is that its location auto-detection algorithm can use better precision.

title.rendered: Google Begins Private Testing of a Gemini App for Mac

content.rendered:
Google has started privately testing a dedicated Gemini app for macOS, a move that could give Mac users a much easier way to access its AI assistant without relying on the browser. Bloomberg reports that the company has shared an early version with a small group of testers, offering a first look at how Gemini may start moving into a more native desktop experience on the Mac.

Google Is Testing an Early Mac App With Only Basic Features for Now

Google says this Mac app is still an early build meant for feedback. The version shared with testers includes only the core Gemini features, not the full experience available across Google’s other clients.

That matters because Gemini has so far mostly lived in the browser on the Mac. Native apps usually have some clear advantages: they open faster, can work more directly with files and other apps on the device, and can support things like keyboard shortcuts for quickly opening Gemini from anywhere.

That also makes this a notable move for Google. The company has long treated the web as the main home for most of its services, with only a few desktop utilities such as Drive sync standing out as exceptions. Building a native Mac app for Gemini suggests Google is taking desktop AI more seriously as it tries to catch up with ChatGPT and Claude, both of which have offered public Mac apps for some time.

Also Read: How the Gemini-Powered Siri Could Work Under the Hood

Even in this early version, testers can already use Gemini for image, video, and music generation, tables and charts, data analysis, web search, conversation history, and document and media analysis.

The app is also said to look similar to Gemini on iPhone and iPad, giving it a more familiar feel for users already using Google’s AI on Apple devices.

Gemini App Comes With One Unique Added Feature

The app code also points to a feature called Desktop Intelligence. Google says that when people turn it on, Gemini can see what is on the screen and pull in content from supported apps while the assistant is being used.

In simple terms, that would let Gemini answer questions with more awareness of what the user is doing at that moment. Google’s example mentions apps such as Calendar, which could help Gemini give answers based on information already open on the Mac.

Google has not announced when the Mac app will be released publicly. What the test makes clear is that the company has moved beyond a browser-only version and is now working toward a more direct desktop experience.

The app is not finished, but this early build shows Google’s direction: a Mac version of Gemini that is faster to reach, easier to use with files and apps, and better able to respond to what is happening on the screen.

excerpt.rendered: Google has begun testing a native Gemini app for Mac, moving beyond the browser with faster access, deeper app integration, and a new Desktop Intelligence feature that can understand what’s on your screen.

title.rendered: Perplexity Can Now Analyze Your Apple Health Data to Deliver Medical Insights

content.rendered:
Perplexity AI is expanding beyond search and stepping into personal healthcare with Perplexity Health, a new feature that connects your medical data directly to its AI platform. The move positions Perplexity alongside major players racing to turn AI into a personalized health assistant.

Turning Scattered Health Data Into One System

Instead of relying on isolated apps and reports, Perplexity Health pulls data from multiple sources and organizes it into a single dashboard. This includes everything from lab results to wearable metrics, allowing users to track patterns across their biomarkers over time rather than viewing data in silos.

AI That Answers Using Your Own Health Records

What sets Perplexity Health apart is the way it responds to user queries. Rather than giving generic advice, it uses your actual health data to generate answers.

Through Perplexity Computer, users can go a step further and generate personalized outputs, such as fitness routines or nutrition plans, that adapt to their data.

Backed by Medical Standards, Not Just AI

Perplexity is emphasizing credibility alongside capability. The company says its system is grounded in clinical guidelines and peer-reviewed research.

It has also formed a dedicated Health Advisory Board made up of doctors and researchers to validate outputs and stress-test decisions against medical standards.

Deep Integration With Apple Health and Wearables

A key part of the rollout is integration with Apple Health, which brings in data collected from the Apple Watch. Support also extends to platforms like Fitbit, Ultrahuman, and Withings, as well as electronic health records from over 1.7 million providers.

Privacy Takes Center Stage

Handling health data raises clear privacy concerns, and Perplexity is placing heavy emphasis on privacy assurances.

The company says all data is encrypted, access is tightly controlled, and user information can be deleted at any time. It also claims that health data is not used to train its AI models or shared with third parties.

A Bigger Shift Is Underway

Perplexity’s move follows similar efforts from OpenAI, which recently introduced health integrations within ChatGPT. Meanwhile, Apple is reportedly working on its own AI-powered health coaching service expected to build on Apple Health data.

The growing interest highlights how major tech players are positioning health data as a key frontier for AI applications.

Availability

Perplexity Health is currently rolling out to Pro and Max users in the United States via Perplexity Computer.

There is no official timeline yet for a broader global rollout. Support for additional integrations, such as Oura and Function Health, is expected in future updates.

Would you trust an AI with your health data? Let us know in the comments.

title.rendered: Sorcerer Incremental Codes (April 2026)

content.rendered:
Update: Verified the latest Sorcerer Incremental Codes on April 08, 2026

If you have been playing Sorcerer Incremental for even a short time, you already know how grind-heavy the game can feel. You keep clicking, rolling, and progressing slowly, hoping to unlock something powerful. That is exactly where codes step inthey give you a shortcut, a small push that makes the journey smoother and a lot more fun.

In a game built around repetition and steady growth, even a few extra rolls or resources can completely change your progress. So if you are serious about getting stronger faster, these codes are not optional; they are essential.

All Active Sorcerer Incremental Codes

  • NEWHONORED: 100x Technique Roll, 18x Ally Scroll, 18x Energy Scroll, 15x Clan Scroll, 15x Weapon Roll (NEW)
  • LARPER: 10x Technique Roll, 18x Ally Scroll, 18x Energy Scroll, 15x Clan Scroll, 15x Weapon Roll (NEW)
  • HEIANKUNA: 15x Technique Roll, 18x Ally Scroll, 18x Energy Scroll, 15x Clan Scroll, 15x Weapon Roll (NEW)
  • KINGOFCURSES: 15x Technique Roll, 18x Ally Scroll, 18x Energy Scroll, 15x Clan Scroll, 15x Weapon Roll
  • PRESTIGE: 8x Technique Roll, 8x Ally Scroll, 8x Energy Scroll, 5x Clan Scroll, 5x Weapon Roll
  • SPRINGTIME: 8x Technique Roll, 10x Ally Scroll, 10x Energy Scroll, 10x Clan Scroll, 10x Weapon Roll

Each of these codes usually gives you a mix of useful resources like technique rolls, clan rolls, weapon rolls, ally rolls, energy scrolls, and sometimes even rare items like Sukuna Fingers. These are all things you would otherwise need to grind for.

If you want more free rewards, check out the latest Evil Plate Game Codes, Jujutsu Kaisen Incremental Codes, and our complete list of all Roblox game codes.

Expired Sorcerer Incremental Codes

2000LIKES, 3000LIKES, 4000LIKES, 5500LIKES, BINDINGVOWS, CLANTREE, DELAY, DOMAIN, EASTERBUNNY, EGGHUNT, NEWERA, QUEENOFCURSES, ROGUELIKE, SEASON3FINALE, SORRYFORWAIT, SRY4DELAY, THANKYOU, YUGOAT

How to Redeem Sorcerer Incremental Codes

Redeeming codes in Sorcerer Incremental is simple and takes just a few seconds. Before that, make sure you have joined the official Roblox group for the game, as some codes may not work without it.

  1. Open Sorcerer Incremental on Roblox.
  2. Look for the Codes button (usually at the top-right of the screen).
  3. Click on it to open the code menu.
  4. Enter your code exactly as shown.
  5. Press redeem and claim your rewards.

If the code is valid, your rewards will be added instantly. If not, double-check the spelling or try another code.

What Do These Codes Actually Give You?

This is where things get interesting. Sorcerer Incremental is built around rerolls and progression loops. You keep resetting, rolling, and improving your character step by step.

Codes directly feed into this system by giving you:

  • Technique Rolls: Unlock stronger abilities
  • Clan Rolls: Improve your base traits
  • Weapon Rolls: Get better combat tools
  • Ally Rolls: Strengthen your support system
  • Energy Scrolls: Boost progression speed
  • Sukuna Fingers: Rare and powerful upgrades

Instead of waiting hours to earn these, codes give them to you instantly. That is why using them early can make a huge difference in how fast you grow.

Why Codes Matter So Much in This Game

Sorcerer Incremental is not just about playing it is about optimizing. Every reset, every roll, every upgrade matters. Without extra resources, progress can feel slow and repetitive.

Codes act like a head start. They reduce the grind, help you experiment with builds, and make the game feel more rewarding instead of exhausting.

If you are someone who enjoys seeing progress quickly and trying different strategies, these codes are one of the best tools you have.

How to Get More Codes

New codes usually show up during updates, milestones, and events, but there is no fixed timing. The safest way is to follow the official places where the developers actually post them.

  • Blumea Productions Roblox group (required for some codes to work)
  • Sorcerer Incremental Discord server (fastest updates)
  • Official Trello (useful for understanding weapons, techniques, and systems)

Codes can expire without notice, so checking these regularly helps. If you do not want to track everything yourself, just bookmark this page. We keep it updated and tested so you always have the latest working codes.

Final Thoughts

Sorcerer Incremental is designed to be a slow, steady climb. That is part of its charm, but it can also feel frustrating at times. Codes help balance that experience. They give you just enough boost to keep things exciting without breaking the game.

If you want to progress faster, unlock better abilities, and enjoy the game without unnecessary grind, make sure you use every active code available. It is one of the simplest ways to improve your experience instantly.

In case you missed:

  • Diesel n Steel Codes
  • Summon Heroes Codes
  • Survive the Apocalypse codes

title.rendered: Celebrate Apple’s 50th Anniversary with These Rainbow Logo Wallpapers

content.rendered:
Apple turning 50 is not just a milestone, it’s a moment! And what better way to celebrate than with Apple’s 50th Anniversary Logo Wallpapers? They are beautiful and creative, giving nostalgia, colors, and minimalism!

CEO Tim Cook recently shared a heartfelt letter titled “50 Years of Thinking Different,” reflecting on the decades of design, innovation, and moments we’ve all experienced through its products. On the letterhead, a beautifully hand-drawn rainbow Apple logo is featured, giving tribute to Apple’s original logo from the late 1970s.

So, here we have curated 4K wallpapers with the logo highlighted. Whether you want something bold, minimal, or nostalgic, there’s one here that instantly makes your screen feel more meaningful.

Download Apple’s 50th Anniversary Logo Wallpapers in 4K

The 50th anniversary wallpapers are more than just colorful backgrounds. The hand-drawn, brushstroke-style rainbow Apple logo feels intentional, almost like a nod to the company’s early days when creativity mattered more than perfection.

The collection includes solid-color backgrounds, such as black gradient, purple, neon green, yellow, and more, with the iconic rainbow logo centered. Created by Jianoliu, these wallpapers pop beautifully on your screen and instantly make it stand out. Explore the collection below, download your favorite one, and carry the Apple legacy with you every day.

Download Apple 50th Anniversary Logo Wallpapers

Which Wallpaper Should You Choose?

Here’s a quick decision guide:

  • Go Dark (Black / Gradient) → If you want contrast + battery efficiency
  • Go Minimal (White / Blue) → For clean productivity vibes
  • Go Bold (Red / Green / Yellow) → If you want your phone to stand out
  • Go Premium (Purple / Gradient) → For aesthetic, modern setups

If you liked these wallpapers, don’t forget to check out our Apple Logo wallpaper collection.

Get Apple’s Legacy with Rainbow Logo Wallpapers!

With Apple’s 50th anniversary wallpapers, you get an everyday reminder of how far the brand has come each time you look at your screen. From the iconic rainbow logo to today’s refined design language, everything about these wallpapers reflects a journey built on creativity and bold thinking.

At the end of the day, whichever wallpaper you choose, it lets you carry a piece of Apple’s story in your pocket.

You can try: Download the WWDC 2026 wallpapers in 4k

title.rendered: Team Snapchat Won’t Stop Messaging? Here’s What You Can Do

content.rendered:
Snapchat often sends random snaps, tips, feature updates, and occasional promotions through its official Team Snapchat account. While some of this content can be useful, frequent messages can feel unnecessary or distracting.

Because of this, many users look for ways to stop or block Team Snapchat, just like they would with any other account. If you’re trying to do the same, here’s what you need to know.

Table of Contents
  • Can You Block Team Snapchat on Snapchat?
  • How to Stop Team Snapchat Messages (Best Alternative)
    • How to Mute Team Snapchat on iPhone and Android
  • What Happens When You Mute Team Snapchat?
  • Is There Any Way to Block Team Snapchat?
  • Why Snapchat Doesn't Allow Blocking Team Snapchat
    • Summing Up…

Can You Block Team Snapchat on Snapchat?

No, you cannot block Team Snapchat. Snapchat treats Team Snapchat as a system account, not a regular user profile. That’s why the usual Block option available for friends and other users does not apply here.

In some cases, you might still see a “Block” option in the profile or chat settings. However, selecting it does not actually stop messages or block the account.

This is because Team Snapchat is a built-in communication channel used for updates, announcements, safety alerts, and promotional content. As a result, it cannot be managed like a normal contact.

Snapchat’s official support also confirms that there is no way to block or remove Team Snapchat completely.

How to Stop Team Snapchat Messages (Best Alternative)

While you can’t block Team Snapchat, you can mute it. Muting stops notifications, so you won’t be interrupted by new snaps or messages. The chat will still exist, but it won’t demand your attention.

This is the most effective way to deal with frequent messages.

How to Mute Team Snapchat on iPhone and Android

Follow these steps:

  1. Open the Snapchat app, then swipe right to open the Chat screen.
  2. Here, locate the Team Snapchat chat.
  3. Now, long-press the chat, then tap Chat and Notification Settings on the menu that appears.
  4. Next, tap Notification Settings.
  5. Toggle on Mute Chat, then select the “Until I unmute them” option.

Once enabled, you’ll no longer receive alerts from Team Snapchat.

What Happens When You Mute Team Snapchat?

Muting only silences notifications. It does not block or remove the account.

Here’s what changes:

  • No notifications: You will no longer receive push notifications or alerts when Team Snapchat sends a message or snap.
  • Messages still appear in chats: The conversation remains visible in your Chat tab, and new messages will still appear there.
  • You can view messages anytime: Open the chat and check snaps or messages whenever you want.
  • No impact on your account: Muting does not affect your Snapchat account, friends, streaks, or other conversations.

Is There Any Way to Block Team Snapchat?

Currently, there is no reliable workaround to block Team Snapchat.

At the same time, some users have reported temporary tricks, such as reporting the account to reveal a Block option. However, these methods are inconsistent and often stop working after Snapchat updates the app. Even when the option appears, it may not permanently block messages.

Other attempts, like clearing the chat or removing the conversation, only hide it temporarily. Team Snapchat can still send new messages that appear again in your chat list.

In short, there is no dependable way to block Team Snapchat. Muting the chat remains the most effective way to avoid notifications and interruptions.

Why Snapchat Doesn’t Allow Blocking Team Snapchat

Snapchat uses the Team Snapchat account to send you:

  • Feature updates
  • App announcements
  • Safety alerts
  • Promotional content

Because of this, Snapchat keeps it as a built-in communication channel rather than a removable contact.

Summing Up…

You cannot block Team Snapchat in the traditional sense. The closest solution is muting notifications, which effectively stops interruptions without affecting your Snapchat experience. Workarounds are inconsistent and short-lived, making muting the only reliable solution to avoid interruptions. For most users, this is enough to keep the app usable without constant distractions.

Got more Snapchat tips you want us to cover? Let us know in the comments.

Don’t miss these related reads:

  • How to Turn Off Location on Snapchat (Step-by-Step Guide)
  • Snapchat Parental Controls: How to Set Up Family Center and Keep Your Teen Safe
  • Snapchat Planets in Order: Meaning and How They Actually Work

About Vikhyat Rishi

  • Vikhyat has over five years of experience writing consumer tech content.
  • During his association with Smartprix and Beebom, Vikhyat has tested, tested, and reviewed numerous gadgets, including but not limited to smartphones, TVs, and more.
  • His passion for technology and Apple products led him to iGeeksBlog, where he specializes in writing How-to and troubleshooting guides for fellow Apple enthusiasts.

Experience

Vikhyat embarked on his journey in consumer technology writing in 2019, driven by his passion for technology. He has sharpened his skills through associations with Smartprix and Beebom, where he extensively tested and reviewed various gadgets, focusing mainly on smartphones. Currently, Vikhyat specializes in crafting How-to and troubleshooting guides for the Apple ecosystem at iGeeksBlog. When not typing away on his MacBook Air, he loves exploring the real world.

title.rendered: Evil Plate Game Codes (April 2026)

content.rendered:
Update: Verified the latest Evil Plate Game Codes on April 12, 2026

Surviving a round in Evil Plate Game is never easy. One moment you are standing safely on your floating plate, and the next moment lightning strikes, lasers appear, or the ground suddenly shrinks beneath your feet. The chaos is exactly what makes the game so fun.

To make things a little easier, developers occasionally release Evil Plate Game codes. These codes give players free shards, the main in‑game currency used to unlock cosmetics, emotes, and other fun items. Redeeming them is one of the fastest ways to collect shards without grinding through rounds.

Below you will find all the latest Evil Plate Game codes along with how to redeem them and what the rewards are used for.

All Working Evil Plate Game Codes

  • MOAR!: 4000 Shards (NEW)
  • EASTER!: 12000 Shards (NEW)
  • 7UP: Free Rewards
  • 2M!: 8000 Shards

If you want more free rewards, check out the latest Tap Simulator codes, Titan Fishing codes, and our complete list of all Roblox game codes.

Expired Evil Plate Game Codes

1POINT5M, BUGTHANKS, FOOLISH, FOXY, XO, 100K, 1MTY, 200K, 300K, 500K, 600K, 700K, 800K, 900K, CELTICS, HBDSHOOTA, OOPS, SPUI

How to Redeem Evil Plate Game Codes

Redeeming codes in Evil Plate Game is slightly different from many other Roblox games because the code menu is accessed through an NPC in the lobby.

Follow these steps to redeem your rewards:

  1. Launch Evil Plate Game on Roblox.
  2. Spawn into the lobby area.
  3. Turn toward the shop area or leaderboard.
  4. Interact with the NPC to open the code window.
  5. Find the Codes NPC near the shop or leaderboard.
  6. Enter your code in the text box.
  7. Press Redeem to claim your rewards.

If the code is valid, the shards will be instantly added to your account.

What Are Shards Used For in Evil Plate Game

Shards are the main currency in Evil Plate Game. Players earn them by surviving rounds, completing quests, logging in regularly, or redeeming codes.

You can spend shards on:

  • Cosmetic items such as horns, halos, and visual accessories
  • Emotes that allow you to interact with other players
  • Crates that unlock additional cosmetic rewards

These items do not affect gameplay strength. They simply add personality and fun to your character while you try to survive the chaos.

Another interesting mechanic in the game is the karma system. Players can use shards to bless or curse other players during a match. Depending on your choices, your karma meter will shift toward positive or negative values.

Why Evil Plate Game Codes May Not Work

Sometimes a code might fail to redeem even if it looks correct. This usually happens for a few common reasons.

  1. The code has expired after a game update or milestone.
  2. The code was entered incorrectly.
  3. The code has already been redeemed on your account.

Copying and pasting the code directly is usually the easiest way to avoid typing mistakes.

How to Get More Evil Plate Game Codes

New codes usually appear when the game reaches milestones such as visit counts, like goals, or major updates. Developers also release them occasionally to celebrate bug fixes or community events.

The best way to stay updated is to follow the game’s official community channels and Discord server. Many players prefer bookmarking our page so they can quickly check back for new codes, since we update the list whenever fresh rewards are released.

What is Evil Plate Game?

Evil Plate Game is a chaotic Roblox survival experience where each player stands on their own floating plate while random disasters constantly try to eliminate them. Lightning strikes, lasers fire across the arena, gravity may change suddenly, and platforms can shrink or sink without warning.

The goal is simple: survive longer than everyone else. As players are eliminated, the tension rises until only one person remains standing. That final survivor wins the round and earns the glory.

Because every round is unpredictable, quick reactions and good movement matter a lot. But with the help of free shards from codes, you can unlock fun cosmetics and enjoy the chaos in style.

content.rendered:
Update: Verified the latest Universal Tower Defense Codes on April 01, 2026

Tower defense remains one of the most consistent and competitive genres on Roblox. Universal Tower Defense (UTD) builds on that foundation by combining strategic wave defense with anime-inspired units and progression-driven gameplay. As difficulty increases, redeemable codes can provide valuable resources that help players strengthen their teams faster.

Below is the complete and updated breakdown of Universal Tower Defense codes for March 2026, including what works, what has expired, and how everything actually works.

All Working Universal Tower Defense Codes

  • SorryEA2!: 5k Gems

Multiple recent updates indicate that all previously released codes have expired. New codes usually arrive alongside major updates or milestone celebrations, but at the moment, there are none active.

New codes can release at any time, especially after patches or major announcements, so it is worth checking back regularly.

Expired Universal Tower Defense Codes

THANKYOUEA!

What Do Universal Tower Defense Codes Give You?

When active, UTD codes usually provide progression resources that directly improve your units.

Gems are used for summoning new characters. Trait Rerolls let you re-roll unit traits for better bonuses. Stat Rerolls and Stat Locks help you fine-tune performance. Limited-event currencies like Ice Gifts and Spirit Souls are often tied to seasonal updates.

If you are struggling against later waves, rerolls can make a noticeable difference. A single strong trait can completely change how your team performs.

How to Redeem Universal Tower Defense Codes

Redeeming codes in Universal Tower Defense is simple once you know where to look.

  1. Launch Universal Tower Defense in Roblox.
  2. Click the “Codes” button on the right side of the screen.
  3. Enter a working code exactly as shown.
  4. Press Redeem to claim your rewards.

If you receive an error, double-check spelling and capitalization. Codes are case-sensitive and expire without notice.

Why Aren’t My UTD Codes Working?

If a code does not redeem, it usually means one of three things:

  1. The code has expired.
  2. There is a typo or formatting mistake.
  3. The game client may not be fully updated.

After major patches, servers sometimes need a few minutes to stabilize. If you are certain the code is correct, close and relaunch the game before trying again.

How to Get More Universal Tower Defense Codes

New codes are typically shared through the game’s official Discord server. Developers post them during updates, milestone celebrations, or special announcements.

However, codes are often scattered across announcements and not always organized. The best way to stay updated is to check this page regularly, as we update it immediately whenever new Universal Tower Defense codes arrive.

Universal Tower Defense continues to attract anime fans who enjoy building teams inspired by iconic series like Naruto, One Piece, and Dragon Ball-style characters. With new units and balance patches rolling out over time, fresh codes are likely to return.

For now, there are no active rewards available. When new codes release, they typically provide meaningful progression boosts. If you are planning to summon or reroll soon, waiting for the next code update may help you save valuable resources.

title.rendered: Tim Cook Says “There’s so much left that we can do with the iPhone”

content.rendered:
Apple CEO Tim Cook said the iPhone will continue to be the core device in people’s digital lives, emphasizing that the product still has significant room for future development. The comments were made during an interview at New York’s Grand Central Terminal, offering a rare direct statement on the long-term role of the iPhone as Apple expands into new categories.

Cook said, “There’s so much left that we can do with the iPhone,” adding that the device will remain the center of users’ digital ecosystems. The remarks come as Apple increases investment in areas such as spatial computing and wearable devices.

iPhone Remains Apple’s Primary Platform

Cook’s statement reinforces Apple’s current strategy, where the iPhone continues to function as the primary platform for services, identity, and connectivity. Despite ongoing development of new hardware categories, the company is not positioning any single device as a direct replacement.

Apple’s financial performance supports this positioning. The company reported $85.2 billion in iPhone revenue in its most recent quarter, marking an all-time high. Cook described demand during that period as “simply staggering,” with record performance across all geographic regions.

Expansion Into New Devices Does Not Replace iPhone

Apple is actively developing new product categories, including augmented reality glasses and an AI-powered wearable device without a display. These efforts reflect a broader shift toward ambient and spatial computing.

However, Cook’s comments indicate that these devices are expected to extend the iPhone’s role rather than replace it. The iPhone continues to provide core capabilities such as global connectivity, a mature app ecosystem, and integrated services, which newer devices currently depend on.dsd

Long-Term Positioning Ahead of iPhone’s 20th Anniversary

The iPhone is approaching its 20th anniversary next year, yet it continues to deliver growth and remain central to Apple’s business. Cook stated that the iPhone “is going to be around for a very long time,” signaling confidence in its long-term relevance.

While the broader technology industry continues to explore post-smartphone computing models, Apple’s current direction positions the iPhone as the foundational layer for those experiences rather than a product nearing replacement.

title.rendered: Perplexity Brings Comet AI Browser to iPhone

content.rendered:
Perplexity has officially launched its Comet AI browser for iPhone, bringing its assistant-powered browsing experience to iPhone users. The app aims to rethink how people search and navigate the web by putting AI at the center of the experience.

A Browser That Answers, Not Just Searches

Unlike traditional browsers that rely on tabs and manual searches, Comet blends web results with AI-generated answers. This reduces the need to jump between pages, making browsing more direct and efficient.

The idea is simple: you ask a question, and the browser does more of the work instead of sending you across multiple tabs.

Comet Assistant Does the Heavy Lifting

At the center of the experience is the Comet Assistant, which goes beyond traditional search. It can summarize long articles, answer detailed questions, and help with research, turning the browser into an active tool rather than a passive one.

Voice Support Adds a Conversational Layer

The iPhone version also includes voice-based interaction. Users can speak their queries and receive responses in a conversational format, making the experience more natural and hands-free.

This further blurs the line between a browser and a digital assistant.

Not a Full Replacement Yet

As with most early AI browsers, Comet still has limitations. There is no support for extensions on iOS, and the app does not yet offer a dedicated iPad version.

For now, it works best as a secondary browser rather than a complete replacement for Safari or Chrome.

Part of a Bigger Shift

With this launch, Perplexity joins a growing list of companies pushing AI into the core of web browsing.

The launch reflects a broader shift toward assistant-driven web browsing, where the browser not only shows information but actively helps users interact with it.

Have you tried the Comet browser on iPhone yet? Share your experience and let us know if you’d switch from Safari or Chrome.

content.rendered:
Update: Verified the latest Spin a Soccer Card Codes on April 10, 2026

If you enjoy collecting football cards, opening packs, and building something that keeps earning even when you are offline, Spin a Soccer Card on Roblox fits perfectly. The game blends simple mechanics with a satisfying loop: spin, unlock cards, place them on your plot, earn money, and repeat. What makes the experience even better is using codes, which give you a head start without the usual grind.

Below is everything you need to know, including the latest working codes, how to redeem them, and why they sometimes fail.

All Working Spin a Soccer Card Codes

  • FROZEN-DRAGON: 2x packs at your rebirth level and 3x free spins (NEW)

If you want more free rewards, check out the latest Blue Lock Rivals Codes, BLR Legacy Codes, and our complete list of all Roblox game codes.

Expired Spin a Soccer Card Codes

APRILDAY1, APRILDAY2, APRILDAY3, CHAMP-CRYSTAL, CHAMP-LEGEND, GOLDEN-BRONZE, GOLDEN-SHADOW, LETS1SPIN, MOON-STRIKER, MYTHIC-CRYSTAL, RAVEN-OMEGA, RELEASE, TIGER-MEGA, TRADEUPDATE

How to Redeem Spin a Soccer Card Codes

Before redeeming, make sure you join the official Pixellar Studios Roblox group. Some players may also need to complete basic progress, like tutorial or rebirth requirements.

Follow these steps:

  1. Launch Spin a Soccer Card on Roblox.
  2. Wait for the game to fully load.
  3. Click the Shop icon on the left side.
  4. Scroll down to find the Code section.
  5. Enter your code in the text box.
  6. Click Redeem.

Once redeemed, your rewards are added instantly.

Why These Codes Matter

Spin a Soccer Card is built around progression through packs and randomness. Normally, you earn money slowly by placing cards on your plot and reinvesting into new packs. Codes break this cycle early.

They give you free spins, packs, and sometimes large amounts of cash, letting you jump straight into better rewards. This is especially useful for new players trying to build a strong collection quickly.

Why Codes Might Not Work

If a code fails, it usually comes down to a few simple reasons:

  • Typing mistakes: Codes are case-sensitive, so even a small error breaks them
  • Server delay: New codes sometimes need a moment after updates
  • Expired codes: Many codes are time-limited and stop working without notice
  • Missing requirements: Some codes require joining the group or progressing in the game

The safest approach is to copy and paste codes exactly as listed.

How to Get More Codes

New codes are typically released during updates, events, or milestones. Developers usually share them through:

  • Official Pixellar Studios Roblox group
  • Discord server (#codes channel)

Since codes can expire quickly, checking regularly is important. Redeem them as soon as possible to avoid missing out.

You can also bookmark this page and check back often. We track new codes as soon as they drop and keep this list updated so you never miss free rewards.

Final Thoughts

Spin a Soccer Card works because it keeps things simple but rewarding. You open packs, chase rare players, and slowly turn your plot into a money-generating system. Codes accelerate that journey, giving you instant access to better cards and faster growth.

If you are just starting out, using codes early makes a noticeable difference. Instead of grinding for your first decent pack, you jump straight into the fun part of the game — collecting, upgrading, and building a stronger lineup.

title.rendered: How Long Does Apple Support iPhones: Everything You Need to Know

content.rendered:
iPhones are known for their great resale value. Part of this can be attributed to the extended software support Apple offers for them. This is in contrast to most Android phones, which get software support for fewer years.

That said, it’s important to consider how long Apple supports each iPhone model when buying an older or refurbished device. In this article, I’ll give you all the details you must know about Apple’s support for different iPhones, so you know how many years of support you can expect for your device.

Table of Contents
  • How Long Does Apple Support iOS?
  • What Happens When Apple No Longer Supports Your iPhone?
  • What Are the Obsolete and Vintage iPhones?
  • What is the Oldest iPhone Still Supported?
  • Which iPhones are Compatible With Apple Intelligence?

How Long Does Apple Support iOS?

Most iPhones receive six to eight years of iOS support. This is great from a longevity and security standpoint, as it ensures that your device will function optimally for several years.

However, it’s important to note that Apple cannot continue supporting devices that are too old since technology advances rapidly. Older devices lack the technical components to keep up with the demands of the latest software.

To make it easier for you, I’ve compiled a table showing Apple’s support of every iPhone model, including its release and discontinuation dates. Keep in mind that the dates are estimates based on past releases with an average of 7 years of support. So, they may change in the future as newer devices and iOS versions become available.

What Happens When Apple No Longer Supports Your iPhone?

When Apple no longer supports your iPhone, it means the device will no longer receive software updates, including critical security patches and new features. Without these updates, your iPhone becomes increasingly vulnerable to security risks and compatibility issues with apps and services that require newer software versions.

Over time, certain apps may stop working altogether, and you may encounter performance problems with your iPhone as well.

Additionally, if your iPhone encounters hardware issues, you may find it difficult to get repairs or replacements from Apple or authorized service providers as they gradually phase out support for older models. Hence, it’s best to keep your device up-to-date and ensure it’s still supported by Apple.

What Are the Obsolete and Vintage iPhones?

When we consider the question, “How many years does Apple support iPhones in terms of hardware,” here’s what the Apple Support website states:

“Owners of iPhone, iPad, iPod, Mac, Apple TV, Apple Watch, AirPods, Apple Vision Pro and Beats products may obtain a service and parts from Apple service providers for a minimum of five years* from when Apple last distributed the product for sale.”

This support may extend for up to seven years, depending on parts’ availability.

So, if your iPhone was still being sold by Apple up to 7 years ago, you could most likely get it fixed if you run into any issues. This is where we need to consider Apple’s list of obsolete and vintage iPhones.

Obsolete iPhones are those whose sales were discontinued by Apple more than 7 years ago, and as a result, hardware servicing is no longer available for them. Similarly, there are Vintage iPhones. These are those that have not been sold for more than 5 years (but fewer than 7 years). Apple can still service these devices, provided it has access to the needed parts.

Let’s see which iPhones belong to these categories.

What is the Oldest iPhone Still Supported?

At the time of writing this—in March 2026—Apple still supports iOS 15, which means the iPhone 6S is the oldest supported device. However, this model is also on Apple’s obsolete list, so I recommend upgrading your device. The same applies to the first-generation iPhone SE.

With the expected release of iOS 27 later in 2026, support for iOS 15 is likely to end, leaving only iPhone 8 and newer models (released in September 2017) to continue receiving updates.

Since Apple has discontinued support for iOS 12, the iPhone 5s, iPhone 6, and 6 Plus no longer receive software updates. Therefore, if you own an iPhone 6 or an older model, upgrading your iPhone is advisable.

Which iPhones are Compatible With Apple Intelligence?

In June 2024, Apple announced Apple Intelligence, which is all set to revolutionize how you interact with your iPhone.

This advanced technology requires significant processing power, so it can only work on the latest iPhones. Currently, the iPhone 15 Pro, 15 Pro Max, and iPhone 16 series and later are compatible with Apple Intelligence.

Of course, the upcoming iPhone 18 models are also expected to support this new technology.

Signing Off…

Apple does a great job of offering support for its iPhones. Thanks to this, you know your money is being invested in technology that will serve you well and last. In addition, it makes it worth buying an iPhone that’s a couple of years old—unless you absolutely need the latest and greatest hardware and software experience.

You can save this guide and refer to it whenever you want to check how long your iPhone will be supported. If you have further questions, let us know in the comments below.

Read more:

  • iOS History: Every Version From iPhone OS 1 to iOS 26 Explained
  • A Brief History of Mac Processors: Motorola 68 K to ARM
