title.rendered: Best AirPods Max 2 and 1 Cases and Covers for Protection and Style

content.rendered:
Apple’s AirPods Max are known for their sleek aluminum aesthetics and excellent audio quality. However, they are also quite expensive, so it only makes sense to protect them. Whether you’re using the latest AirPods Max 2 or the original model, a good case can keep it safe from scratches, drops, and everyday wear while also adding a touch of personal style.

In this guide, we’ve rounded up the best AirPods Max 2 and 1 cases and covers that balance protection, design, and practicality. From sleek minimalist covers to rugged travel cases, you’ll find options that not only safeguard your investment but also match your vibe.

Key factors to consider when choosing a case or cover for AirPods Max

When picking a case or cover for your AirPods Max 2 or 1, there are a few essential aspects you should keep in mind.

  • Material and durability: A case’s build quality determines how well it will be able to protect your AirPods Max. Hard-shell cases provide maximum protection, while silicone or leather covers add a touch of elegance with moderate safeguarding. Choose a material based on your use case.
  • Size and fit: A bulky case may offer better protection, but it can make portability cumbersome. Both AirPods Max have the same measurements, so ensure the case fits snugly while maintaining a lightweight design.
  • Design and aesthetics: Since the AirPods Max already look stunning, you might want a case that complements their premium appeal rather than hide it entirely. You can look at fancy designer cases or covers, for that matter.
  • Extra features: Some cases come with additional storage for cables, chargers, or waterproofing for added convenience. You can look for such features if you plan on carrying accessories with your AirPods Max.

Best AirPods Max 2 and AirPods Max cases and covers in 2025

With many different types of cases and covers available in the market, choosing the right one for your AirPods Max 2 and 1 can be confusing. So, we have broken down the case types and recommended the best ones in the category.

1. AirPods Max hard cases: Best for traveling

If you travel often, a hard case is a must have. These cases provide solid protection against impacts and ensure that your AirPods Max remain safe in your backpack or luggage.

  • ProCase Hard Case for AirPods Max: This is one of the best-rated hard cases on Amazon. It’s compact, handy, and portable, making it the best option for frequent travelers. The exterior of the case is made of hard EVA, which is a durable and rigid material, while the interior of the case has a soft mesh lining that protects your AirPods Max no matter what goes on the outside.
  • Spigen Klasden Hardcase: Spigen is one of the popular names in the electronics accessories market. Its Klasden case, while being a hard case, is very compact and light while offering ample protection with its external protective shell. It also has a leather strap for easy carrying while being one of the best-looking hard cases for the AirPods Max.
  • Co2CREA Hard Travel Case: This is an excellent option if you are looking for a water-resistant, dust-resistant hard case for your AirPods Max. The shell is made of three layers for enhanced protection and increased durability. One defining feature of this cover is that it comes with magnetic straps that you can unfold to keep your AirPods Max in sleep mode, saving battery life.

2. Sleek AirPods Max ear cup covers: Lightweight everyday protection

For everyday use, a lightweight ear cup cover is perfect for protecting your AirPods Max 2 or 1 from dust and minor scuffs without adding bulk.

  • Spigen Ultra Hybrid Case: Another Spigen case. This time it’s a hybrid case with incredible design. Remember that this is just a cover for the ear cups of your AirPods Max and not a carry case. It is a light and durable cover that protects the exterior of the headphones from accidental drops and scratches. If you workout or play sports wearing the AirPods Max, this case is perfect for you. Not to mention the XRAY design elevates the looks of your headphones inside the gym.
  • Fintie Soft Silicone Cover: If you are a fan of super lightweight silicone cases, then this Fintie case is the one you should look at. It perfectly snaps onto the ear cups of your AirPods Max and adds very little weight and bulk to them as they are made of super-strength silicone rubber. These are perfect for everyday use and even for traveling, and you can choose from a wide variety of colors; your favorite color is here, too.
  • Filoto Silicone Case: If you want a case that keeps your AirPods Max looking brand new while feeling great in hand, the Filoto silicone cover is a fantastic pick. The smooth, matte finish of the case improves grip, preventing accidental slips while also looking elegant. Along with the case, you also get a cover for the ear pad cushion, which is a nice touch.

3. Best AirPods Max leather cases: Premium look with decent protection

For those who appreciate elegance, leather cases offer a luxurious feel while keeping your headphones secure.

  • Hiram Leather Case: If you appreciate premium craftsmanship, then the Hiram Leather Case is a must-have for your AirPods Max. Made from high-quality, crazy horse leather, the structured design ensures excellent protection against drops, while the soft interior lining keeps your headphones safe and secure. With timeless style and durable construction, this case is a perfect blend of luxury and practicality for your AirPods Max.
  • Woolnut Leather Case: If you want to take the premium appeal of your AirPods Max up a notch, the Woolnut Leather Case is an excellent choice. Crafted from premium Scandinavian full-grain leather, this case exudes elegance while offering top-tier durability. The soft microfiber interior provides a plush environment for your headphones, keeping them safe from scratches and impacts. The case perfectly complements the classy looks of the AirPods Max, and the premium green color adds icing to the cake. Though the pricing of the case is slightly on the higher side, it does offer a perfect balance of style, protection, and luxury.

4. Best waterproof and shockproof AirPods Max cases: Rugged protection

If you need rugged protection against water and shock, consider these heavy-duty cases.

  • UAG Rugged Case: We had to include the adventurer AirPods Max users. This UAG case comes out on top with this ultra-durable yet stylish case. You can be worry-free once your AirPods Max are inside this case as the weather-resistant 840D ballistic nylon exterior will protect them from everything, be it drops, rain, snow, or heat. UAG’s brand superiority in this niche can also be trusted with quality.
  • SUOFIEK Case: If you have buttery hands, then the SUOFIEK case is the one you should buy. The hard shell cover on these is waterproof, drop, and shockproof. So whether you drop them on the ground or in the swimming pool, your AirPods Max inside should be safe. It is made from premium quality materials without much wear and tear for prolonged use.

Choosing the right case or cover for your AirPods Max 2 and 1 depends on your lifestyle and needs. Whether you prioritize style, durability, or full-fledged protection, there’s an option out there for your needs. So go ahead, pick the case or cover that best suits your requirements, and keep your investment safe and stylish.

@graph.description: iGeeksBlog is your global go-to source for Apple, tech, and gaming. Get the latest news, reviews, and tips to stay ahead in the fast-paced tech world.

@graph.name: ProCase Hard Case for AirPods Max
@graph.description: It’s compact, handy, and portable, making it the best option for frequent travelers. The exterior of the case is made of hard EVA, which is a durable and rigid material, while the interior of the case has a soft mesh lining that protects your AirPods Max no matter what goes on the outside.

@graph.name: Spigen Klasden Designed for Airpods Max
@graph.description: Spigen is one of the popular names in the electronics accessories market. Its Klasden case, while being a hard case, is very compact and light while offering ample protection with its external protective shell. It also has a leather strap for easy carrying while being one of the best-looking hard cases for the AirPods Max.

@graph.name: Co2CREA Hard Travel Case
@graph.description: This is an excellent option if you are looking for a water-resistant, dust-resistant hard case for your AirPods Max. The shell is made of three layers for enhanced protection and increased durability. One defining feature of this cover is that it comes with magnetic straps that you can unfold to keep your AirPods Max in sleep mode, saving battery life.

@graph.name: Spigen Ultra Hybrid Case
@graph.description: It is a light and durable cover that protects the exterior of the headphones from accidental drops and scratches. If you workout or play sports wearing the AirPods Max, this case is perfect for you. Not to mention the XRAY design elevates the looks of your headphones inside the gym.

@graph.name: Fintie Soft Silicone Cover
@graph.description: If you are a fan of super lightweight silicone cases, then this Fintie case is the one you should look at. It perfectly snaps onto the ear cups of your AirPods Max and adds very little weight and bulk to them as they are made of super-strength silicone rubber.

@graph.name: Filoto Silicone Case for AirPods Max
@graph.description: If you want a case that keeps your AirPods Max looking brand new while feeling great in hand, the Filoto silicone cover is a fantastic pick. The smooth, matte finish of the case improves grip, preventing accidental slips while also looking elegant.

@graph.name: Hiram Leather Case for Airpods Max
@graph.description: If you appreciate premium craftsmanship, then the Hiram Leather Case is a must-have for your AirPods Max. Made from high-quality, crazy horse leather, the structured design ensures excellent protection against drops, while the soft interior lining keeps your headphones safe and secure.

title.rendered: This Chrome Feature Lets You View Two Web Pages in One Tab on Mac

content.rendered:
Switching between multiple Chrome tabs can quickly interrupt your workflow, especially when you’re researching, taking notes, or multitasking. Chrome’s Split View feature solves this by allowing you to display two web pages side by side in a single tab. This lets you work efficiently without jumping between tabs or opening extra windows. This guide explains what it is, how to enable it, and how to use it effectively on a Mac.

Table of Contents
  • What Is Chrome Split View?
  • How to Use Chrome Split View on Mac
    • When Only One Tab Is Open
    • When Both Web Pages Are Open
    • Open a Link in Split View
  • How to Rearrange or Adjust Chrome Split View
  • How to Exit Chrome Split View on Mac
  • How to Pin the Chrome Split View Icon for Quick Access
  • Important Things to Know About Chrome Split View
  • Final Thoughts

What Is Chrome Split View?

The feature was introduced in Chrome version 145 and lets you open two web pages side by side in the same browser window. Each side works like a normal tab, so you can scroll, click links, and interact with both pages independently.

I often use it when writing in one tab while keeping reference material open in the other. It’s also helpful when comparing product specifications, reviewing two documents, or taking notes while reading an article.

Unlike the macOS native option, which places two separate app windows side by side, Chrome Split View keeps both pages inside the browser. Your tabs, bookmarks, and controls remain in the same window, making everything easier to manage.

How to Use Chrome Split View on Mac

You can use it in several ways depending on your activity.

When Only One Tab Is Open

  1. Right-click the active tab and select Add Tab to New Split View. Or click the Open tab in Split View icon in the toolbar menu.
  2. Select another open tab from the list or type a URL for the second pane.

The two pages will appear side by side in a single browser window.

When Both Web Pages Are Open

  1. Open the first page you want to keep.
  2. Right-click the other tab that you want to open.
  3. Select New Split View with Current Tab.

The two tabs will merge into a single split layout.

Open a Link in Split View

You can also open links directly from any web page in a split layout.

  1. Right-click any link on the web page.
  2. Select Open Link in Split View.

The link will open in the opposite pane of the current page.

How to Rearrange or Adjust Chrome Split View

You can adjust the space or change what appears on each side.

  1. Resize the pane: Hover over the divider between the two pages and drag it left or right to adjust how much space each page uses.
  2. Reverse views: Right-click the combined tab, choose Arrange Split View, then select Reverse Views. This swaps the left and right pages.
  3. Replace a side: Right-click a tab and select Move Tab into Split View. Then choose Swap with Left View or Swap with Right View.

How to Exit Chrome Split View on Mac

You can close the tabs or use a shortcut.

  1. Separate views: Right‑click the combined tab and select Separate Views. Each page will return to its own tab.
  2. Close one side: Click X on the pane you want to remove.
  3. Keyboard shortcut: Press Command + W to close the currently active pane.

How to Pin the Chrome Split View Icon for Quick Access

When a page supports it, you’ll see the Split View icon appear on the left side of the toolbar. If you don’t see it, update Chrome and temporarily disable extensions that modify the browser interface, as they may hide or block the feature.

To pin the icon for quick access:

  1. Enter Split View mode once.
  2. Locate the icon in the Toolbar menu.
  3. Right‑click the icon and select Pin.

Important Things to Know About Chrome Split View

Here are a few quick facts about what the feature can and cannot do.

  • You can use Chrome profiles to separate personal and work browsing.
  • It may feel cramped on smaller MacBook displays, such as 13-inch screens.
  • Currently, drag and drop between panes is not supported.
  • macOS Split View is still the better option when you need two different applications instead of two web pages.

Related: Split View not working on Mac? 6 Easy fixes

Final Thoughts

Chrome Split View is a simple but useful productivity tool that allows Mac users to view two websites in the same browser tab. It reduces tab switching and makes multitasking more efficient. If you frequently work across multiple web pages, using this feature can streamline your browsing workflow.

FAQs

Can I use Chrome Split View with external monitors on a Mac?

Yes. It works normally on extended displays and ultrawide monitors.

Why don’t I see the Split View option in Chrome?

Make sure you are using Chrome version 145 or later and disable extensions that modify the browser layout.

Does it work with Chrome apps, PDFs, or media players?

Most websites work normally, but some Chrome apps and certain PDF viewers may open in a separate tab.

How is this different from opening two Chrome windows in macOS Split View?

Chrome’s version keeps everything in a single window, so your tabs and settings stay in one place.

title.rendered: Best Wallpaper Apps for iPhone and Android You Should Try in 2026

content.rendered:
Your phone is something you look at hundreds of times a day. Why not make it look different and interesting? A good wallpaper is what it takes to instantly change the look of your phone and make it feel more personal. In 2026, many wallpaper apps are available, offering 4K resolution, live animations, and even AI-generated backgrounds.

In this guide, we’ll explore the best wallpaper apps for iPhone and Android, helping you find the perfect app to customize your screen and keep it looking fresh every day. Whether you prefer minimal designs, artistic illustrations, or dynamic live wallpapers, you will find the perfect one below.

Table of Contents
  • What to Look for in a Wallpaper App
  • 5 Best Wallpaper Apps for iOS and Android
    • 1. ZEDGE™ Wallpapers & Ringtones
    • 2. Wallcraft – Wallpapers, live
    • 3. Backdrops – Wallpapers
    • 4. Wave AI Live Wallpapers
    • 5. Walli: Cool Wallpapers HD, 4K
  • Free vs Premium Wallpaper Apps: What's the Difference?
  • Tips for Choosing the Right Wallpaper App
  • Final Thoughts: Which Wallpaper App Should You Choose?

What to Look for in a Wallpaper App

Before downloading a wallpaper app, it’s helpful to understand what separates a great app from an average one. Modern wallpaper apps focus on quality, customization, and ease of use.

  • High-resolution wallpapers: Most modern phones have high-resolution displays, so wallpapers should support Full HD, 4K, or even 8K resolution. They look great on OLED screens and can even help save battery.
  • Live or animated wallpapers included: These wallpapers add subtle movement or visual effects to your home screen, making your phone feel more dynamic.
  • AI wallpaper generation: This allows you to type a short description and instantly generate a unique wallpaper based on your idea.
  • Easy navigation and well-organized categories: Browsing should be simple, and downloading wallpapers should take just a few taps.
  • Auto-change wallpaper feature: It’s also useful because they automatically refresh your wallpaper daily or hourly.
  • Too many ads or locked features: Some apps are free but filled with ads, while others offer a cleaner experience through premium plans.

5 Best Wallpaper Apps for iOS and Android

Below are some of the most popular wallpaper apps available for both iPhone and Android users.

1. ZEDGE™ Wallpapers & Ringtones

ZEDGE is one of the most popular customization apps available. It has been around for years and continues to evolve with new features like AI wallpaper generation and a massive community library.

The app offers thousands of wallpapers across categories such as urban artwork, Sci-Fi, space themes, anime, abstract, and minimal designs. You can also set live photos as wallpapers to get video effects on the Lock Screen.

Simply browse trending wallpapers, save favorites, and apply backgrounds with just a few taps. What makes Zedge stand out is that it also includes ringtones, notification sounds, alarm tones, and custom app icons, making it a complete phone personalization tool.

Key Features

  • Huge wallpaper and ringtone library
  • AI wallpaper generator
  • Live wallpapers and animated backgrounds
  • Personalized recommendations
  • Easy download and apply options

Pros

  • Very large collection of wallpapers
  • Available on both Android and iPhone
  • Regular updates and trending content

Cons

  • Ads in the free version
  • Some content requires premium credits

Pricing: Free version available, with ads. Premium version available starting at $0.99.

Best For: Users who want one app for wallpapers, ringtones, and overall phone customization.

Download: iPhone | Android

2. Wallcraft – Wallpapers, live

Wallcraft is known for its extremely high-quality wallpapers. The app focuses on 4K and ultra-HD backgrounds that look great on modern smartphone displays. The wallpapers are carefully optimized for different screen sizes so they fit perfectly without losing quality.

You can explore several categories, such as AI arts, quotes, minimalist, texture, music, etc. and backgrounds designed for Dynamic Island. Wallcraft also offers parallax wallpapers, which create a subtle 3D effect when you move your phone.

Key Features

  • 4K and ultra-HD wallpapers
  • AMOLED optimized backgrounds
  • Live wallpapers and parallax effects
  • Categories for different styles
  • Daily wallpaper updates

Pros

  • Excellent image quality
  • Clean and modern interface
  • Large variety of categories

Cons

  • Too many ads

Pricing: Free with ads. Wallcraft PRO starts at $0.99/month.

Best For: Ultra-high-resolution wallpapers that look sharp on modern displays.

Download: iPhone | Android

3. Backdrops – Wallpapers

Backdrops app is popular with users who love clean, artistic, and minimalistic wallpapers. Unlike other wallpaper apps that offer only internet-found wallpapers, this app provides exclusive wallpapers designed by its team. This gives users unique wallpapers not found anywhere else.

Its collection includes niche categories such as polar void, power tower, glowform, etc. The app also has a strong community where you can upload and share your own creations. You will get a new Wall of the Day for a refresh. What I liked is the gamified Daily Streak, which lets you collect coins to unlock premium wallpapers.

Key Features

  • Exclusive wallpapers designed by the Backdrops team
  • Community wallpaper uploads
  • Simple and fast browsing experience
  • Daily wallpaper collections
  • Favorites and collections system

Pros

  • Unique wallpapers not available in other apps
  • Clean and user-friendly interface
  • Great for minimalist setups

Cons

  • Not as many wallpaper options available
  • More free content available than the pro version

Pricing: Free version available. You can buy premium collections starting at $1.99.

Best For: Users who enjoy minimalist, artistic, and unique wallpapers.

Download: iPhone | Android

4. Wave AI Live Wallpapers

Wave AI Live Wallpapers Maker specializes in providing animated and interactive wallpapers. This app has a wide variety of 3D live wallpapers, animated lock screens, and AI-powered backgrounds, all updated every week.

The animations react to touch or movement, which creates a more immersive phone experience. Moreover, you get tools to create your own live wallpapers so your screen is fully personalized.

Key Features

  • 3D animated live wallpapers
  • AI wallpaper generator
  • Interactive motion effects
  • Custom live wallpaper creator
  • Lock screen animations

Pros

  • Large collection of animated wallpapers
  • Unique interactive designs
  • Frequent updates

Cons

  • Live wallpapers may consume more battery power
  • Frequent glitches caused by ad loading

Pricing: The app is free with ads. You may purchase credits for $1.99.

Best For: If you prefer dynamic, animated wallpapers over static backgrounds.

Download: iPhone | Android

5. Walli: Cool Wallpapers HD, 4K

Walli is different from most wallpaper apps because it focuses on artist-created wallpapers. The platform is for artists to display their wallpapers for recognition and support. This means you can enjoy exclusive wallpapers.

Its collection often features unique illustrations and original designs you won’t find in traditional wallpaper libraries. Additionally, you get 4D live wallpapers and backgrounds optimized for iOS Depth Effect. Walli’s AI wallpaper generator has multiple art styles and themes for creativity.

Key Features

  • Artist-created wallpapers
  • High-resolution HD and 4K images for AMOLED
  • Curated wallpaper collections
  • Support for independent artists
  • Auto-resolution optimization
  • 20+ language support

Pros

  • Unique artwork and illustrations
  • High-quality wallpapers
  • Creative and artistic designs

Cons

  • Smaller selection compared to large apps
  • The library is not frequently updated

Pricing: Free with ads. Premium subscription starts at $4.99.

Best For: Creative digital art and unique wallpapers made by artists.

Download: iPhone | Android

Free vs Premium Wallpaper Apps: What’s the Difference?

Most wallpaper apps offer both free and premium versions. The free versions usually provide access to basic wallpapers but include advertisements or limited downloads.

Premium versions remove ads and unlock exclusive wallpapers, live animations, and advanced customization tools. Some apps also add AI features or allow higher-resolution downloads with a paid subscription.

If you only change wallpapers occasionally, the free version is usually enough. But if you enjoy frequently updating your phone’s look or want the best designs, upgrading to premium can be worth it.

Tips for Choosing the Right Wallpaper App

With so many wallpaper apps available, choosing the right one depends on your preferences.

  • First, consider what style of wallpaper you like. Some apps focus on minimal designs, while others specialize in photography, abstract art, or animated wallpapers.
  • Next, check the image resolution. If you have a high-resolution display, choose apps that offer 4K or AMOLED wallpapers to get the best visual quality.
  • You should also consider performance and battery life. Live wallpapers may be eye-catching, but they can also drain the battery more quickly than static wallpapers.
  • Another helpful feature is automatic wallpaper rotation. Some apps let you change your wallpaper daily, keeping your phone looking fresh without any effort.

It is recommended that you try a few applications before selecting the best one for you. Different apps offer different styles and browsing experiences.

Final Thoughts: Which Wallpaper App Should You Choose?

The best wallpaper app ultimately depends on what type of customization you want.

  • If you want the largest library and extra features like ringtones, Zedge is a strong choice.
  • If your priority is high-resolution and AMOLED wallpapers, Wallcraft offers some of the best image quality.
  • For minimal and exclusive designs, Backdrops is an excellent option.
  • If you enjoy animated and interactive backgrounds, Wave AI Live Wallpapers Maker is worth trying.
  • And if you prefer artistic wallpapers created by designers, Walli is a great platform.

The good news is that these apps offer a free trial, so you can try a few and find the one that suits your taste the most. A great wallpaper can make your phone feel new again, and with these apps, you will always have a fresh one at your disposal.

You might also like:

  • Best Photo Collage Apps
  • Best Coupon Apps
  • Best Audiobook Apps

title.rendered: WhatsApp Introduces New ‘You’ Profile Tab on iPhone

content.rendered:
WhatsApp has started rolling out a redesigned profile tab for iPhone users that replaces the traditional Settings tab with a new section called “You.” The update appears in the latest iOS release and aims to make account management more personal and easier to navigate.

New Profile-Focused Tab Appears in the Bottom Bar

In earlier versions of WhatsApp on iOS, the bottom navigation bar included a Settings tab represented by a gear icon. With the latest update, that section has been replaced by a You tab that uses the user’s profile photo as its icon.

The change was first noticed in TestFlight beta builds reported by WABetaInfo. The redesigned page opens a profile-centric dashboard that lets users manage account information, privacy settings, and other personal controls.

According to the App Store release notes for version 16.5.10.73, the new tab allows users to manage their accounts, customize identity details, and access profile-related settings in one place.

Designed with Multi-Account Support in Mind

Beyond visual changes, the redesign also hints at future functionality. The profile photo icon makes it easier to see which account is active, a design decision that aligns with Meta’s upcoming multi-account support, which is currently in testing.

This interface approach resembles how Instagram and Threads display profile icons when users manage multiple accounts on a single device.

Profile Page Receives a Visual Refresh

The update also introduces subtle design tweaks to the profile page itself. Some users now see a large header area with a default cover image at the top of the profile screen.

At the moment, users cannot change the cover image. The addition appears to be an early version of a feature that could enable profile customization in a future update.

Feature Still Rolling Out Gradually

Even though the update is listed in the App Store release notes, access to the new interface remains limited. Many users have yet to see the redesigned tab.

WhatsApp typically rolls out interface changes in phases, so it may take some time before the You tab becomes visible to all iPhone users.

Do you see the new You tab in WhatsApp on your iPhone yet? Let us know in the comments.

title.rendered: Apple Releases Security Updates to Fix WebKit Bug in iOS 26, iPadOS 26, and macOS Tahoe

content.rendered:
Apple has released its first Background Security Improvements (BSI) updates across iOS 26.3.1, iPadOS 26.3.1, and macOS Tahoe 26.3.1, introducing a new mechanism for delivering urgent security fixes outside standard software updates. The release addresses a WebKit vulnerability that could allow malicious web content to bypass the Same Origin Policy, a core browser security safeguard.

New Update System Replaces Rapid Security Responses

Background Security Improvements replace Apple’s earlier Rapid Security Responses, marking a shift in how the company delivers critical patches. The new system was introduced with iOS 26, iPadOS 26, and macOS Tahoe, and was tested in version 26.3 updates before its public rollout.

BSIs are designed to deliver security fixes more quickly, specifically targeting components like Safari, WebKit, and other system libraries without requiring a full OS update.

WebKit Vulnerability Patched With Input Validation Fix

The first BSI release fixes a WebKit vulnerability that could allow specially crafted web content to bypass Same Origin Policy restrictions. This policy is a foundational web security measure that prevents scripts from one site from accessing data on another.

Apple states the issue has been resolved through improved input validation, reducing the risk of cross-origin attacks.

Installation, Compatibility, And Rollback Details

Users can install Background Security Improvements through the Privacy and Security section in system settings, either manually or automatically if the relevant toggle is enabled. If users choose not to install BSIs, the same fixes will be included later in standard software updates.

Apple notes that BSIs may cause compatibility issues in rare cases. These updates can be temporarily removed, allowing Apple to refine and reissue them in subsequent releases. Apple has also issued a macOS Tahoe 26.3.2 BSI update specifically for the MacBook Neo.

title.rendered: Jujutsu Kaisen Incremental Codes (April 2026)

content.rendered:
Update: Verified the latest Jujutsu Kaisen Incremental Codes on April 12, 2026

If you are trying to get stronger in Jujutsu Kaisen Incremental, you will quickly realize that progress depends heavily on your rolls. Every better Trait, stronger Cursed Technique, or improved stat build comes down to how many chances you get. That is exactly where codes come in, giving you extra rolls and helping you grow faster without grinding endlessly.

Jujutsu Kaisen Incremental is a progression-based Roblox experience inspired by the anime. You train your sorcerer, fight curses, and slowly build power over time. The game even runs with idle mechanics, so you can keep improving while doing other things. But to truly stand out and reach higher grades, you need strong roles, and codes make that journey much easier.

All Working Jujutsu Kaisen Incremental Codes

  • HTH: 100 CT Rerolls, 100 Trait Rerolls, 100 Style Rerolls, 100 Clan Rerolls, 25 Companion Rerolls, 250,000 Yen, and 50,000 XP (NEW)
  • CONTRACTS: Free Rewards (NEW)

If you want more free rewards, check out the latest Jujutsu Infinite Codes, Anime Ascendants Codes, and our complete list of all Roblox game codes.

Expired Jujutsu Kaisen Incremental Codes

1000ROLLS, BOOGIE, CT, DELAYKAISENINCREMENTAL, EASTER, FINEHEREIGG, HEYLOL, ILOVEYOU, JJK3D, MEOW, MODULOSOON, OVERLORDOFTHECENTURY, QUALITYMOG, REINCARNATE, ROLLBACK, SHINJUKU2, SHINJUKUPT1, STILLINLOVE, YANDERE, 100KVISITS, 1KPLAYERS, 1MVISITS, ARTCONTEST, CLANWARS, CLOZYGOAT, CULLINGGAMES, CULLINGGAMESP2, FEMBOYS, LIKEREWARD, MINIUPDATE, PATREON, RAIDSUPDATE, SORRY, SORRY4DELAY, SORRYGUYS, THANKYOU, THEJJKISITUATIONISCRAZY, WDITTO, ZERO

How to Redeem Jujutsu Kaisen Incremental Codes

Before redeeming codes, you must join the Real Mouse Productions Roblox group. Without this step, the game will not allow you to claim rewards.

Once that is done, follow these steps:

  1. Launch Jujutsu Kaisen Incremental on Roblox.
  2. Click the Shop button at the top right of the screen.
  3. Find the Enter Code Here section.
  4. Paste your code into the box.
  5. Click Redeem to get your rewards instantly.

Make sure you enter codes exactly as shown. They are case-sensitive, so even a small mistake can prevent them from working.

Why Jujutsu Kaisen Incremental Codes Are Important

In this game, almost everything depends on your rolls. Your damage output, abilities, and overall potential are tied to what you unlock. That means more rolls directly translates into better builds.

Instead of waiting for slow progression, codes give you a shortcut. They help you reroll faster, chase rare traits, and build a stronger sorcerer without wasting time. If you want to reach higher ranks like Grade 1, using codes regularly is almost necessary.

How to Get More Jujutsu Kaisen Incremental Codes

New codes are usually released during updates, milestones, or special events. The developers also share them through their Discord server and community pages, but finding them there can be confusing since codes for multiple games are often posted together.

The easiest way is to bookmark our page. We keep this list updated with the latest working codes, so you can always find them in one place without searching.

Why Your Jujutsu Kaisen Incremental Code Is Not Working

If a code is not working, there are a few common reasons:

  • You have not joined the required Roblox group
  • The code is typed incorrectly or is missing capital letters
  • The code has expired
  • The code may only work in newer servers, so try rejoining

If a new code does not work immediately, wait a bit and try again, as some codes take time to activate across servers.

What Is Jujutsu Kaisen Incremental on Roblox?

Jujutsu Kaisen Incremental is a mix of simulation, idle progression, and turn-based combat. You train your character, fight enemies, and unlock stronger abilities over time. The game rewards patience, but also gives you tools like codes to speed things up.

You can:

  • Train to improve stats like strength, defense, and speed
  • Fight curses to earn rewards and experience
  • Roll for Traits and Cursed Techniques to shape your build
  • Progress even while AFK thanks to idle mechanics

There is also an official Trello that acts like a guidebook, helping you understand abilities, items, and strategies as you grow stronger.

title.rendered: AirPods Max 2 Digital Crown: All Controls and Gestures Explained

content.rendered:
Apple’s AirPods Max have always stood out for their design, premium audio quality, and intuitive controls. Instead of relying on touch or swipe gestures, Apple chose a physical Digital Crown, similar to the one on the Apple Watch, to control playback and system functions.

With the launch of AirPods Max 2, Apple has expanded the Digital Crown’s capabilities. Along with the familiar playback and volume controls, the crown now supports new gestures and camera controls, making it even more versatile.

Here’s a complete guide to AirPods Max 2 Digital Crown controls and gestures.

What is the Digital Crown on AirPods Max 2?

The Digital Crown on AirPods Max is similar to the one found on the Apple Watch. It is a rotary knob located on top of the right ear cup, designed to provide precise and tactile control over various functions.

Instead of relying on touch gestures, Apple uses the Digital Crown to let users interact with the headphones through rotation and press gestures. By rotating the crown, you can adjust the volume with fine precision, while pressing it in different patterns allows you to control playback, manage calls, and activate Siri.

This mechanical control system makes the AirPods Max easy to operate even when you are on the move, wearing gloves, or unable to quickly access your iPhone.

All Digital Crown Controls and Gestures on AirPods Max 2

These are all the ways you can use the Digital Crown on the AirPods Max 2:

Rotate to Adjust Volume

The primary function of the Digital Crown on the AirPods Max is volume control. Rotating the crown clockwise (downwards) decreases the volume, while rotating it counterclockwise (upwards) increases the volume.

Unlike on-screen sliders, the crown allows fine-tuned volume adjustments, making it easier to set the exact listening level you want.

Press Once to Play or Pause Media

Besides volume control, the Digital Crown also lets you control playback directly from the headphones without touching your iPhone. Press the Digital Crown once to:

  • Play music or podcasts
  • Pause the currently playing media

This gesture works across most audio apps, including Apple Music, Spotify, and podcast apps.

Double-Press to Skip Forward

If you want to jump to the next track, the Digital Crown provides a quick shortcut.

  • Press the crown twice quickly to skip to the next song or audio track.

This particularly comes in handy when you want to change tracks while walking, working out, or commuting without taking out your phone.

Triple-Press to Go Back to the Previous Track

In addition to skipping forward, you can use the Digital Crown to return to the previous track or replay the current one.

To do so, press the Digital Crown three times quickly.

Press and Hold to Activate Siri

As with the AirPods, pressing and holding the Digital Crown on the AirPods Max 2 activates Siri. Once Siri is active, you can ask it to perform tasks such as playing music, sending messages, checking weather updates, adjusting volume, getting directions, and much more.

Press Once to Answer a Call or Mute / Unmute

When you receive a call, you can manage it directly from the Digital Crown.

  • Press once to answer an incoming call.
  • During a call, press once to mute or unmute your microphone.

Press Twice to End a Call

To disconnect an ongoing call, press the Digital Crown twice quickly. This gesture immediately ends the call, making it easy to wrap up conversations directly from the headphones.

Use as a Camera Remote

One of the most interesting additions to the Digital Crown capabilities on the AirPods Max 2 is the ability to control the camera on your iPhone or iPad using it.

The feature requires iOS 26.4 installed on your iPhone and works with Apple’s Camera app or compatible third-party camera apps on an iPhone or iPad.

All you need to do is open the Camera app and press the Digital Crown to trigger the shutter button. This allows you to:

  • Take photos remotely
  • Start video recording
  • Stop video recording

Everything at Your Fingertips…

Apple has designed the Digital Crown on the AirPods Max 2 to serve as the central hub for media, calls, voice commands, and, now, even photography. While most of the controls were already available on the first-gen AirPods Max, the addition of camera controls has expanded the Digital Crown’s functionality beyond audio, making the AirPods Max 2 more versatile in everyday use.

Got a favorite Digital Crown gesture on AirPods Max 2? Share your experience or tips in the comments below.

  • Best Accessories for AirPods Max You Should Buy
  • AirPods Max 2 Alternatives

title.rendered: Best Reminder Apps to Manage Tasks and Stay Organized

content.rendered:
Modern life moves fast. Between work deadlines, meetings, personal tasks, and daily responsibilities, it’s easy to forget important things, leading to missed tasks, forgotten appointments, and unnecessary stress. This is where reminder apps become incredibly useful.

Reminder apps help you capture tasks the moment they come to mind and notify you exactly when you need to act. They combine task management, smart reminders, collaboration tools, calendar views, and cross-device syncing to help you manage your life more efficiently.

In this guide, we’ll explore the best reminder apps for iPhone and Android that help you stay organized, remember important tasks, and improve your productivity.

Table of Contents
  • What Makes a Great Reminder App in 2026
    • Smart Notifications
    • Cross-Platform Sync
    • Easy Task Creation
    • Task Organization
    • Integration With Other Tools
  • How We Tested and Chose the Best Reminder Apps
  • Best Reminder Apps on iOS and Android
    • 1. TickTick: To-Do List & Calendar
    • 2. Todoist: To Do List & Calendar
    • 3. Google Keep – Notes & Lists
    • 4. Any.do: To Do list & Planner
    • 5. Superlist: To-Do List & Tasks
    • 6. Yapp Random Reminders
  • Tips for Maximizing Productivity With Reminder Apps
  • Final Verdict: Which Reminder App Should You Choose?

What Makes a Great Reminder App in 2026

There are several reminder apps out in the market. Some focus on simple notifications, while others provide full productivity systems. When choosing the best reminder apps for this guide, several important features stood out.

Smart Notifications

A good reminder app must send notifications at the right time. This includes:

  • Time-based reminders
  • Recurring reminders
  • Location-based reminders
  • Persistent notifications until the task is completed

These features ensure you never miss important tasks even if you are traveling across different time zones.

Cross-Platform Sync

Most people switch between devices throughout the day. A great reminder app should work smoothly across iPhone, Android, and desktop apps.

Cloud syncing keeps all tasks up to date everywhere.

Easy Task Creation

If adding a task takes too long, people stop using the app. The best apps allow you to quickly add reminders using:

  • Natural language typing
  • Voice input
  • Quick add buttons
  • Widgets

Moreover, you should be able to reschedule the tasks in seconds and build automations for daily activities, saving time and effort.

Task Organization

A reminder app becomes much more powerful when it can organize tasks effectively. Helpful organization features include lists and folders, subtasks, tags or labels, and priority flags. Also, the latest apps use AI to automatically sort tasks and suggest reminders based on your past activities.

These features help you manage both simple reminders and complex task lists.

Integration With Other Tools

Many reminder apps integrate with productivity tools such as calendars, email services, and collaboration apps. This allows your reminders to fit smoothly into your workflow, especially useful for teams and families.

How We Tested and Chose the Best Reminder Apps

To find the best reminder apps for 2026, we tested each app across several key criteria.

  • Ease of Use: The first thing we looked at was how simple the app is to use. A reminder app should feel intuitive from the first moment. Users should be able to add reminders within seconds without navigating complicated menus.
  • Notification Reliability: A reminder app is useless if notifications fail. We tested whether reminders appeared consistently and on time across both iPhone and Android devices.
  • Feature Set: We checked the depth of features such as recurring reminders, voice reminders, task lists, calendar view, collaboration tools, and smart scheduling. Apps that offered useful productivity features without becoming overwhelming ranked higher.
  • Cross-Device Support: Since many users work across multiple devices, we checked whether each app supports syncing between mobile, desktop, and web platforms.
  • Free vs Paid Value: Some apps offer powerful free versions, while others require subscriptions. We considered whether the premium plans actually provide meaningful additional value.

After evaluating these factors, the following apps stood out as the best reminder apps for staying organized.

Best Reminder Apps on iOS and Android

Here, we have listed the top 6 reminder apps catering to different needs and requirements. Let’s explore each one and see which one fits your routine.

1. TickTick: To-Do List & Calendar

TickTick is one of the most complete reminder apps available today. It combines a simple task manager with powerful productivity features, including a built-in calendar, habit tracker, event countdowns, and a Pomodoro timer.

The interface is clean and easy to navigate, which makes it suitable for both beginners and productivity enthusiasts. You can quickly create tasks and add attachments, notes, and comments to them. Each task supports up to 5 reminders. You can dismiss, snooze, and mark reminders as done directly from their notification banner.

The app integrates well with your calendar apps and lets you add tasks via email. Moreover, you can create task lists and checklists and share them with others for collaboration. The priority levels and different sorting options ensure the most important tasks are always in your view.

Key Features

  • Smart recurring reminders based on location and time
  • Calendar view for visual task planning
  • Habit tracking system
  • Built-in Pomodoro focus timer
  • Subtasks and priority levels
  • Cross-platform syncing via cloud

Pros

  • Excellent feature set
  • Clean and intuitive design
  • Powerful free version
  • Great productivity tools

Cons

  • The interface may feel feature-heavy for simple users
  • No AI features

Pricing: Free. Premium plan available via subscription ($3.99/month)

Best For: Users who want a complete productivity and reminder system in one app.

Download: iPhone | Android

2. Todoist: To Do List & Calendar

Todoist has long been one of the most popular task management apps, and it remains a top choice in 2026. It excels at helping users manage both personal tasks and collaborative projects. You can quickly add tasks, set deadlines, assign priorities, and break big goals into smaller steps.

The app lets you add new tasks using natural language input. For example, saying or typing “Submit report tomorrow at 10am in School” automatically schedules the reminder in the right project. The clean interface and powerful organization tools have a minimal learning curve.

With features like sub-tasks, sections, labels, and calendar views, Todoist helps you stay focused on what matters and plan your day efficiently. You can also sync your tasks across devices and collaborate with others, making it useful for both personal and team productivity.

Key Features

  • Natural language reminders
  • Task priorities and labels
  • Project-based organization
  • Flexible recurring reminders for habit building
  • Productivity tool integrations, such as Google Calendar, Outlook Calendar, Zapier, Slack, and Dropbox.
  • Team collaboration tools

Pros

  • Clean and minimal interface
  • Extremely reliable reminders
  • Strong cross-platform support
  • Great collaboration features

Cons

  • Advanced features, like custom reminders and calendar view. etc., are locked behind the premium plan
  • You can’t store documents

Pricing: Free. Paid premium plan starts at $6.99/month.

Best For: Professionals, students, teams, and GTD practitioners seeking structured task management with reminders and notifications.

Download: iPhone | Android

3. Google Keep – Notes & Lists

Google Keep is a lightweight reminder and note-taking app designed for simplicity. It’s perfect for people who want quick reminders without complex productivity systems. Everything syncs automatically with your Google account. So, the tasks appear in your calendar and Google Assistant.

The app allows users to create notes, checklists, and reminders in seconds and arrange them visually using labels, pins, colors, and drawings. You can even attach voice memos to the reminder. Google Keep also supports location-based reminders that notify you when you arrive at a specific place.

Key Features

  • Simple notes and checklists
  • Time and location-based reminders
  • Voice notes
  • Color-coded organization
  • Google account syncing

Pros

  • Extremely simple and easy to use
  • Completely free
  • Works well with Google services
  • Fast reminder creation

Cons

  • Limited task management features
  • You can’t create recurring tasks
  • No advanced project organization

Pricing: Free

Best For: Beginners who need a simple reminder app for day-to-day tasks without any complexity.

Download: iPhone | Android

4. Any.do: To Do list & Planner

Any.do is a popular reminder and task management app known for its simple design and daily planning features. One standout feature is the project templates and Daily Planner, which help you review and organize tasks visually. You can also switch between different calendar views to check weekly and monthly tasks.

The app also includes voice reminders, WhatsApp support for creating reminders, and calendar integration with Google Calendar, Outlook Calendar, and Facebook events, making it a versatile productivity tool. Moreover, you can share to-do lists and assign tasks to others to collaborate in real-time.

Key Features

  • AI features and automations for recurring reminders
  • Daily planning assistant
  • Voice reminders
  • Calendar and productivity app integration
  • Shared lists
  • Private boards

Pros

  • Clean and user-friendly interface
  • Helpful daily planning feature and widgets
  • Strong reminder notifications
  • AI support

Cons

  • Some features require a premium plan
  • Customization is limited compared to other power apps

Pricing: Offers a free version with premium options starting at $2.99.

Best For: People who want structured daily task planning with AI-powered reminders.

Download: iPhone | Android

5. Superlist: To-Do List & Tasks

Superlist is a newer productivity app built by the team behind Wunderlist. It focuses on collaboration and task organization for teams and individuals. You can create tasks by talking to its AI assistant or typing in natural language.

The design is modern and visually appealing, and it supports reminders inside notes, shared lists, comments, and file attachments. Moreover, the app can be integrated with Google Calendar, Linear, Slack, etc. This makes Superlist particularly useful for collaborative task planning.

Key Features

  • Shared task lists
  • Comments and collaboration tools
  • File attachments
  • Clean modern interface
  • Cross-device syncing

Pros

  • Excellent team collaboration features
  • Modern and clean design
  • Good for project planning

Cons

  • Still developing compared to older apps

Pricing: Free version available with paid plans for teams (starting at $6/month).

Best For: Teams and groups who need shared reminders and collaborative task lists.

Download: iPhone | Android

6. Yapp Random Reminders

Yapp Random Reminders provides a different kind of reminder. Rather than reminders being sent at regular intervals, reminders are sent randomly. This makes it useful for habits, self-care prompts like drinking water, motivational messages, or mindfulness reminders.

The concept is simple but effective for users who want spontaneous prompts. You can organize the reminders by color-coding and customize settings, such as how many reminders you want per day, your daytime range, active days of the week, etc.

Key Features

  • Random reminder notifications
  • Custom message reminders
  • Habit and motivation prompts
  • Simple interface

Pros

  • Unique reminder concept
  • Great for habit building
  • Easy to use

Cons

  • Limited task management features
  • Not recommended for creating a structured task list

Pricing: Free with optional upgrades ($2.99/month).

Best For: Users who want random habit reminders and motivation prompts.

Download: iPhone | Android

Tips for Maximizing Productivity With Reminder Apps

Using a reminder app effectively requires more than just installing it. Here are a few tips to get the most out of your reminder system.

  • Capture Tasks Immediately: Whenever a task comes to mind, add it immediately. This prevents mental overload and ensures nothing gets forgotten.
  • Use Recurring Reminders: Many tasks repeat regularly. Set recurring reminders for things like weekly meetings, monthly bills, exercise routines, etc. It will not only save time but will also ensure that your routine is consistent.
  • Organize Tasks Into Lists: Create separate lists for different areas of life, such as work tasks, personal errands, shopping lists, and long-term goals. So, you can focus on the right tasks at the right time.
  • Review Your Tasks Daily: Spend a few minutes each morning reviewing your reminders. This helps you plan your day and prioritize important tasks.

Final Verdict: Which Reminder App Should You Choose?

It’s hard to say which reminder app is the best, as this depends on your personal workflow and productivity style.

  • If you want the most powerful all-in-one reminder app, TickTick is one of the best choices available.
  • If you prefer a clean and structured task management system, Todoist remains an excellent option.
  • For users who want simple reminders without complexity, Google Keep is a reliable and completely free solution.
  • If collaboration is important, Superlist provides strong shared task features.
  • Meanwhile, Any.do works well for daily planning, while Yapp Random Reminders offers a unique way for your habit-forming needs.

To conclude, the best thing you can do is try out one or two apps and see which one fits your workflow best. The right reminder app can significantly reduce stress in your life and help you stay on top of everything that matters.

content.rendered:
Apple is gearing up for one of its busiest product years yet in 2026, with rumored launches across iPhones, Macs, iPads, Apple Watches, home devices, audio accessories, and entirely new product categories. Based on the latest leaks and expert reporting, here are all the upcoming Apple products expected throughout the year.

Table of Contents
  • Summer 2026: WWDC & Mid-Year Releases
    • Macs with M5 Variants
    • Software Highlights
  • Fall 2026: The Big Launch Window
    • iPhone 18 Pro & iPhone 18 Pro Max
    • Apple’s First Foldable iPhone
    • Apple Watch Series 12 & Watch Ultra 4
  • Late 2026: Last But Not Least
    • iPad mini (OLED)
    • MacBook Pro (M6)
  • TBA 2026: Apple Devices That Could Appear
    • AirPods Pro with Cameras
    • Apple Glasses / AR Wearables
    • AR and Security Devices
  • Why 2026 Matters for Apple

Summer 2026: WWDC & Mid-Year Releases

The year kicked off with a host of budget-friendly and refreshed devices, including AirPods Max 2, MacBook Neo, MacBook Pro M5 Pro & M5 Max, MacBook Air M5, iPad Air M4, iPhone 17e, and Studio Display & Studio Display XDR.

Summer at Apple is traditionally dominated by software announcements, but hardware news won’t be silent either. Several leaks suggest a lots of Mac devices are coming in 2026.

Macs with M5 Variants

  • According to Mark Gurman, a new Mac mini is coming. However, he indicates it could include a new M6 chip, skipping the M5.
  • M5 Mac Studio with Max options and even a new M5 Ultra chip.

Software Highlights

At WWDC (June), Apple will likely unveil:

  • iOS 27 is laying the foundation for AI and foldable-ready enhancements mid-year. Reports indicate three key AI features, including a health coach and a Siri revamp integrating Gemini.
  • iPadOS, macOS, watchOS, tvOS, and visionOS will also get major upgrades.

Fall 2026: The Big Launch Window

Like clockwork, Fall will be the busiest quarter, with several major products slated for September–October.

iPhone 18 Pro & iPhone 18 Pro Max

This year, Apple is rumored to shift gears and only launch the flagship duo, the iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone 18 Pro Max, in the iconic September event. The iPhone 18 base model could launch in the spring of 2027.

  • A20 Pro chip with significantly faster performance and improved energy efficiency
  • Advanced camera system with a DSLR-style variable Aperture lens and
  • Under-display Face ID, smaller display hole, and refined design cues like a transparent backpanel.
  • C2 modem for faster connections
  • New fun colors, such as Purple, Burgundy, etc.

Apple’s First Foldable iPhone

Perhaps the most talked-about device of 2026, iPhone Fold, Apple’s first foldable smartphone, is expected around September alongside the new iPhones. Rumors suggest:

  • A crease-free wide display that may look like an iPad
  • Thinner build than the iPhone Air
  • Industry-first 24MP under-display camera
  • 5,400mAH big battery

The best part is iPhone Fold may launch at $1,800, which will help in wide adaptation and market dominance.

Apple Watch Series 12 & Watch Ultra 4

Apple is expected to launch the Apple Watch Series 12 and Watch Ultra 4 in Fall 2026, continuing its pace of yearly wearable updates.

  • New, faster S chips for smoother performance
  • Enhanced health sensors (potentially advanced metrics like glucose monitoring)
  • Refined designs with longer battery life
  • Possible Touch ID

Late 2026: Last But Not Least

Here are the remaining products that may launch at the end of the year:

iPad mini (OLED)

The iPad mini may transition to an OLED display with A20 Pro chips for enhanced visuals and performance. It may feature water resistant design and a vibration-based speaker system.

MacBook Pro (M6)

A redesigned MacBook Pro with M6 silicon and OLED display, rumored to be thinner, lighter, and packed with next-gen features like cellular support, could arrive late in autumn.

iPad 12th Generation with Apple Intelligence

The Apple iPad 12th generation is expected to be Apple’s next entry-level tablet, bringing meaningful performance upgrades while keeping the familiar iPad design. Rumors suggest it will feature a powerful A18 chip, which could enable Apple Intelligence AI features, Stage Manager 2, Wi-Fi 7, improved multitasking, and smoother everyday performance.

The device is also expected to include around 8GB of RAM, making it better suited for productivity, creative apps, and advanced iPadOS features. While the overall design may remain similar to the current model, the new iPad could still offer a 11-inch Liquid Retina display, 12MP cameras, and Touch ID, along with improved efficiency.

Apple Home and Display Products

  • Apple Studio Display 2 with mini‑LED backlighting, ProMotion support (120Hz), Thunderbolt 5, and 5K resolution.
  • A new Apple TV 4K with A17 Pro chipset, built-in FaceTime camera, Wi-Fi 7 and Apple Intelligence on-screen enhancements.
  • Home devices like HomePod mini 2 is also likely. It may have S9 chip or newer, mesh extender support, UWB 2.0, better sound tuning, and Apple Intelligence.
  • HomePod Smart Display (or Apple Home Hub) may arrive with 7” display with magnetic dock or stand, built-in camera, and Apple Intelligence integration.

TBA 2026: Apple Devices That Could Appear

These products are strongly rumored but don’t yet have a clear launch quarter:

AirPods Pro with Cameras

AirPods Pro with on-device cameras for visual AI features and improved spatial intelligence are expected to debut in the year.

Apple Glasses / AR Wearables

Apple’s long-anticipated AR glasses may be unveiled, potentially late in 2026 or teased for a 2027 ship window.

AR and Security Devices

  • A first-party smart security camera and video doorbell with Face ID support.
  • Targeting a 2027 launch, Vision Air could serve as a lightweight and budget-friendly alternative to Vision Pro. It is expected to be ~40% lighter with a magnesium alloy or plastic frame and likely powered by an A-series chip.

Why 2026 Matters for Apple

Apple’s strategy in 2026 is shaping up to be more aggressive, category-expanding, and ecosystem-wide than in typical years. The combination of staple updates (like iPhones and Macs), breakthrough category bets (foldables, Apple Glasses, smart home hubs), and AI-oriented experiences places 2026 as a pivotal year for consumer hardware and Apple’s long-term vision.

Bookmark this article; we’ll keep it updated as more rumors and confirmations roll in. Got a favorite from the list? Let us know in the comments!

title.rendered: Apple AI Model Reconstructs 3D Objects With Realistic Lighting From a Single Image

content.rendered:
Apple researchers have developed a new AI model that can reconstruct a full 3D object from a single image while preserving realistic lighting effects such as reflections and highlights. The work, introduced in the research paper LiTo: Surface Light Field Tokenization, aims to improve how machines represent both object geometry and view-dependent appearance in a unified system.

Model Encodes Geometry and Lighting in a Unified 3D Latent Space

The LiTo model introduces a 3D latent representation that captures not only the shape of an object but also how light interacts with its surface from different viewing angles. This approach addresses a limitation in prior methods, which typically focus either on reconstructing geometry or predicting simplified, view-independent appearance.

By encoding surface light field data into a compact set of latent vectors, the system can reproduce view-dependent effects such as specular highlights and Fresnel reflections under complex lighting conditions. This allows the reconstructed object to maintain consistent visual realism as the viewpoint changes.

System Reconstructs Full 3D Objects From a Single Image

Unlike traditional 3D reconstruction techniques that require multiple images from different angles, LiTo can infer a complete 3D representation from a single input image. The system achieves this through a two-stage process involving an encoder and a decoder.

The encoder compresses the object’s visual information into a latent representation, capturing both its structure and lighting behavior. The decoder then reconstructs the object, generating both its geometry and its appearance across different viewing angles.

A separate model is trained to predict the appropriate latent representation directly from a single image, enabling end-to-end reconstruction without requiring multi-view input data.

Training Uses Subsampled Multi-View and Lighting Data

To train the system, researchers used thousands of 3D objects rendered from 150 different viewing angles and three lighting conditions. Instead of feeding all available data into the model, the training process relied on randomly sampled subsets of surface light field data.

These subsets were encoded into latent representations, while the decoder was trained to reconstruct the full object and its appearance under varying conditions. Over time, the model learned to generalize both geometry and view-dependent lighting from partial information.

Latent Space Enables Efficient Representation and Reconstruction

The system relies on latent space, where visual information is represented as compact numerical vectors. This approach reduces computational cost while preserving essential relationships between object features and lighting behavior.

By operating in this compressed space, the model can efficiently infer how an object should appear under different viewpoints without explicitly storing every possible variation. This enables both faster processing and more consistent rendering results.

Comparisons Show Improved View-Dependent Rendering

Apple’s research includes comparisons between LiTo and an existing model called TRELLIS. The results demonstrate that LiTo produces more consistent and realistic lighting effects when objects are viewed from different angles, particularly in scenarios involving complex reflections.

The study highlights the model’s ability to jointly represent geometry and appearance, which is critical for applications that require high visual fidelity across dynamic viewpoints.

title.rendered: 15 New Features in Apple AirPods Max 2 You Should Know

content.rendered:
Apple has finally updated the AirPods Max, its premium over-ear headphones, more than five years after the original model arrived. On the outside, not much looks different. The shape is the same. The materials are the same. Even the overall feel is familiar. However, there are many updates in audio quality, performance, smart features, detection, and overall quality-of-life improvements.

Here is a closer look at all the new features in Apple’s AirPods Max 2, as mentioned by Apple.

Table of Contents
  • 1. H2 Chip Brings New Audio and Smart Features
  • 2. Active Noise Cancellation Is Up to 1.5x Better
  • 3. Adaptive Audio Adjusts to Your Surroundings
  • 4. Transparency Mode Sounds More Natural
  • 5. Conversation Awareness Lowers Audio When You Speak
  • 6. Personalized Volume Learns How Loud You Like to Listen
  • 7. Loud Sound Reduction Softens Harsh Noise Around You
  • 8. New Amplifier Improves Overall Sound Quality
  • 9. Adaptive EQ Now Adjusts Across More Frequencies
  • 10. Voice Isolation Improves Call Quality
  • 11. Bluetooth 5.3 Reduces Wireless Latency
  • 12. USB-C Lossless Audio Adds a Wired High-Quality Option
  • 13. Live Translation Adds Real-Time Language Help
  • 14. You Can Now Say Just “Siri” and Use Head Gestures
  • 15. Camera Remote Adds a New Creator-Friendly Control
  • Final Thoughts

1. H2 Chip Brings New Audio and Smart Features

The biggest upgrade in AirPods Max 2 is the move from the H1 chip to Apple’s newer H2 chip. This change powers most of the improvements in the new model.

The original AirPods Max still sounded good, but it missed many newer AirPods features because it used older hardware. With the H2 chip, AirPods Max 2 gains faster computational audio, better sound processing, lower latency, and several smart features that were missing before.

That is why almost every upgrade below starts with the H2 chip.

2. Active Noise Cancellation Is Up to 1.5x Better

Apple says AirPods Max 2 delivers up to 1.5 times better Active Noise Cancellation than the previous model.

In simple terms, it should block more outside noise when you are on a plane, in traffic, or working in a noisy environment. The older AirPods Max already had strong noise cancellation, so this upgrade builds on one of its best features.

3. Adaptive Audio Adjusts to Your Surroundings

Adaptive Audio automatically balances Noise Cancellation and Transparency based on where you are.

If you move from a quiet room to a busy street, the headphones can adjust on their own. The goal is simple: less manual switching and a smoother listening experience.

4. Transparency Mode Sounds More Natural

Apple has also improved Transparency mode with a new processing system built for the H2 chip and the AirPods Max microphones.

This means outside sounds should come through more naturally. Voices should sound clearer, and your own voice should sound less processed. This makes it easier to stay aware of your surroundings without taking the headphones off.

5. Conversation Awareness Lowers Audio When You Speak

Conversation Awareness detects when you start talking to someone nearby.

When that happens, AirPods Max 2 lowers your audio and makes voices easier to hear. When the conversation ends, your previous audio level returns. It is a small feature, but it removes one more manual step from daily use.

6. Personalized Volume Learns How Loud You Like to Listen

Personalized Volume learns your preferred listening levels over time and adjusts based on your environment.

Instead of constantly changing the volume in different places, the headphones gradually learn what sounds right to you.

7. Loud Sound Reduction Softens Harsh Noise Around You

AirPods Max 2 can also reduce sudden loud environmental sounds, such as construction noise or machinery, while keeping your audio experience more consistent.

This feature is designed to make everyday listening more comfortable, especially in places where noise levels change quickly.

8. New Amplifier Improves Overall Sound Quality

Apple says AirPods Max 2 uses the H2 chip with a new high dynamic range amplifier.

According to Apple, this improves bass, vocals, and instrument separation while making mids and highs sound more natural. In simple terms, the new model is designed to sound cleaner and more balanced.

9. Adaptive EQ Now Adjusts Across More Frequencies

Adaptive EQ has also been retuned for the H2 chip.

It uses inward-facing microphones to measure what you are hearing and adjusts playback in real time based on fit, movement, and ear shape. Apple says it now works across a wider frequency range, which should help the sound stay more consistent.

10. Voice Isolation Improves Call Quality

Voice Isolation helps your voice come through more clearly during calls by reducing background noise.

This is useful when you are outside, commuting, or calling from a busy room. Apple also says AirPods Max 2 supports studio-quality recording with more natural vocal texture, which gives it extra appeal for creators.

11. Bluetooth 5.3 Reduces Wireless Latency

AirPods Max 2 supports Bluetooth 5.3, up from Bluetooth 5.0 on the previous model.

Apple says this reduces wireless audio latency. That should help with gaming, video editing, watching videos, and other tasks where better audio sync matters.

12. USB-C Lossless Audio Adds a Wired High-Quality Option

AirPods Max 2 supports 24-bit, 48kHz lossless audio over a wired USB-C connection.

This gives users a higher-quality listening option that is not available on Apple’s in-ear AirPods models. For people who care about wired audio quality, this is one of the biggest upgrades in the new model.

13. Live Translation Adds Real-Time Language Help

AirPods Max 2 supports Live Translation when paired with a compatible Apple Intelligence-enabled iPhone.

This can help people follow in-person conversations across languages in real time. It is one of the biggest non-audio additions in the new model, giving the headphones a more practical role beyond music, calls, and entertainment.

14. You Can Now Say Just “Siri” and Use Head Gestures

AirPods Max 2 also makes Siri a little more natural to use.

You can now say just “Siri” instead of “Hey Siri.” Apple has also added Siri gesture controls, allowing users to respond to some prompts by nodding or shaking their head. These are small changes, but they make hands-free control feel quicker and more seamless.

15. Camera Remote Adds a New Creator-Friendly Control

Apple has also added camera remote support.

This lets users press the Digital Crown to take photos or start and stop video recording in the Camera app or compatible third-party camera apps on an iPhone or iPad. It is a niche feature, but it gives AirPods Max 2 one more practical use for creators and people who often record from a distance.

Final Thoughts

AirPods Max 2 is mainly an internal upgrade rather than a redesign.

The H2 chip is the core of the update. It brings better noise cancellation, smarter listening features, clearer calls, lower latency, and broader audio improvements across the board. Apple has kept the same overall design, fit, Smart Case, and claimed 20-hour battery life, so the focus here is clearly on performance and features rather than appearance.

AirPods Max 2 starts at $549 in the United States, with pre-orders opening March 25 and availability beginning in early April. For anyone who felt the original AirPods Max had fallen behind the rest of Apple’s AirPods lineup, this update closes much of that gap.

title.rendered: Best Photo Collage Apps for iPhone and Android (2026)

content.rendered:
Thanks to ongoing advancements in smartphone cameras, capturing stunning photos has become easier than ever. Modern phones now offer powerful sensors, advanced image processing, and intelligent features that help anyone take high-quality pictures with minimal effort.

However, taking great photos is only part of the story. Presenting them in a visually appealing way can make those moments even more memorable. This is where photo collage apps come in. They let you combine multiple photos into creative layouts, helping you tell a story, highlight special memories, or create eye-catching social media posts.

To help you get started, we’ve rounded up the best photo collage apps for iPhone and Android to create stunning layouts in minutes.

What is a Photo Collage App?

A photo collage app lets you combine multiple photos into a single layout. Instead of sharing images one by one, you can arrange them in grids, frames, or creative designs to present several moments together.

Most collage apps also include editing tools such as filters, text overlays, stickers, backgrounds, and borders. These features help you customize the collage and make it more visually appealing.

These apps are commonly used for social media posts, travel memories, event highlights, and digital scrapbooks, as they make it easy to turn a collection of photos into a cohesive visual story.

Key Features to Look for in a Photo Collage App

With hundreds of collage-making apps available, it helps to understand which features improve the overall experience so you can choose the right one.

  • Multiple Layout Options: Apps should offer a variety of grid styles, frames, and freestyle collage layouts.
  • Editing Tools: Built-in features such as filters, brightness adjustment, cropping, and color tuning improve the final result.
  • Stickers and Text Tools: Creative stickers, fonts, and text overlays help personalize your collages.
  • Social Media Compatibility: The ability to export collages in Instagram-friendly sizes makes sharing easier.

Best Photo Collage Apps for iOS and Android

These are the top five photo collage apps you can try right now:

1. Canva

Canva is one of the most popular design tools available today, and its collage maker is equally impressive. The app offers thousands of ready-made templates that make it easy to create visually appealing collages without design experience.

With Canva, all you need to do is choose a template, add your photos, adjust the layout, and export the final design. It also includes powerful editing tools, fonts, stickers, and backgrounds that help you customize every detail.

Pros

  • Huge library of collage templates
  • Easy drag and drop editing
  • Powerful built-in design tools

Cons

  • Many premium templates require a subscription
  • Can feel feature-heavy for beginners

Download: iPhone | Android

2. Picsart

Picsart is a powerful photo editing app that also offers excellent collage-making tools. It allows you to create both grid collages and freestyle layouts, giving you greater creative control over how your photos are arranged.

The app includes filters, effects, stickers, and AI-powered editing tools that help turn simple collages into eye-catching designs.

Pros

  • Advanced editing tools and effects
  • Freestyle collage layouts
  • Large sticker and filter library

Cons

  • Ads in the free version
  • Some tools require a premium plan

Download: iPhone | Android

3. PhotoGrid

PhotoGrid is designed for users who want to create collages quickly without complicated editing steps. You get thousands of templates, frames, and backgrounds that can instantly transform multiple photos into stylish layouts.

Its simple interface makes it beginner-friendly while still offering enough features to create attractive social media posts.

Pros

  • Very easy to use
  • Thousands of collage layouts
  • Great for quick social media collages 

Cons

  • Watermark in the free version
  • Many assets locked behind premium

Download: iPhone | Android

4. PicCollage

PicCollage focuses on creativity and storytelling. The app lets you create scrapbook-style collages using photos, doodles, stickers, and colorful backgrounds.

It also includes themed templates for events such as birthdays, holidays, and celebrations, making it a great option for creating personalized collages.

Pros

  • Fun scrapbook-style collages
  • Stickers, doodles, and themed templates
  • Beginner friendly

Cons

  • Limited advanced editing options
  • Premium subscription for extra content

Download: iPhone | Android

5. InCollage

InCollage is a lightweight collage app designed for simplicity. It allows you to combine multiple photos into grid layouts while offering filters, frames, and background customization. You can easily create collages for Instagram, WhatsApp, or other social media platforms in just a few taps.

Pros

  • Simple and lightweight
  • Many grid layouts and frames
  • Quick collage creation

Cons

  • Basic interface
  • Ads in the free version

Download: iPhone | Android

Tips to Create Better Photo Collages

Now that you know which photo collage app fits your needs, it’s time to learn a few small techniques that can make your design look much better:

  • Choose photos with a similar color tone or theme
  • Avoid overcrowding the collage with too many images
  • Use white space or borders to make layouts cleaner
  • Add text or stickers carefully to maintain balance
  • Use square or vertical layouts for social media posts

Create Eye-Catching Photo Collages in Minutes

These photo collage apps make it easier to transform ordinary photos into creative layouts that stand out on social media or to preserve your favorite memories. All you need is a little creativity, and you can turn your photos into visually appealing collages in just a few minutes.

Which of these photo collage apps are you excited to try? Share your favorite in the comments below.
