title.rendered: AirPods Max 2 vs. AirPods Max: Here’s Everything New

content.rendered:
When Apple launched AirPods Max, it quickly became one of the most premium and recognizable over-ear headphones on the market. With its sleek aluminum design, powerful noise cancellation, and deep integration with the Apple ecosystem, it set a new standard for high-end wireless headphones.

Now, after 5 long years, Apple is back with AirPods Max 2, and while the design may look familiar, there are several important upgrades under the hood. From a new H2 chip and smarter audio features to improved noise cancellation and support for lossless audio, the second-generation model brings meaningful improvements.

So what exactly is new? And is it worth upgrading from the original model? In this guide, we’ll break down AirPods Max 2 vs. AirPods Max, explore every major change, and help you decide which one is the better choice.

Table of Contents
  • AirPods Max 2 vs. AirPods Max: Key Differences
  • AirPods Max 2 vs. AirPods Max: Detailed Comparison
    • Design and Build Quality
    • Performance and Chip Upgrade
    • Active Noise Cancellation and Transparency Mode
    • AirPods Max 2: New Smart Features
    • Audio Quality and Lossless Support
    • Battery Life
    • Controls and Extra Features
    • Price and Availability
  • AirPods Max 2 vs. AirPods Max: Should You Upgrade?

AirPods Max 2 vs. AirPods Max: Key Differences

Here’s a quick summary of the most important upgrades:

AirPods Max 2 vs. AirPods Max: Detailed Comparison

Here, I have listed all the features offered in AirPods Max 2 and compared them side by side with the older AirPods Max. So, you will have a clear idea whether the upgrade is worth it!

Design and Build Quality

The original AirPods Max stand out because of their premium materials and distinctive look. Apple used anodized aluminum ear cups, a stainless-steel frame, and a breathable mesh canopy headband.

These materials give the headphones a luxurious feel and strong durability. The memory foam ear cushions are magnetically attached, making them easy to remove and replace.

Visually, the AirPods Max 2 looks very similar to the original model. Apple chose to keep the same recognizable color options, shape, and materials. Therefore, if you liked the original AirPods Max design, you’ll feel right at home with the new model.

15 New Features in Apple AirPods Max 2

Performance and Chip Upgrade

One of the biggest changes in the new headphones is the processor.

The original AirPods Max run on Apple’s H1 chip, which was powerful when it launched but now feels outdated compared to newer AirPods products.

AirPods Max 2 introduces the H2 chip, which powers most of Apple’s latest audio devices.

This upgrade brings several benefits:

  • Faster audio processing and improved high-fidelity sound
  • Exhilarating audio with deep bass, expansive mids, and crisp highs
  • Improved noise cancellation algorithms
  • Better battery efficiency
  • Support for new intelligent audio features

Because of this new chip, the second-generation model can support technologies that were not available on the first version.

Active Noise Cancellation and Transparency Mode

Active Noise Cancellation (ANC) has always been one of the biggest selling points of the AirPods Max. The first generation already offered excellent noise reduction, blocking out airplane noise, traffic sounds, and office chatter.

However, Apple claims the new AirPods Max 2 delivers up to 1.5× stronger noise cancellation compared to the original model. This improvement comes mainly from the H2 chip, updated microphones, and computational audio algorithms. So, now it can counter more external sound with equal anti‑noise while maintaining premium sound quality.

Transparency Mode has also been refined. Apple says outside sounds now feel more natural and realistic, making conversations and environmental awareness more comfortable while wearing the headphones.

AirPods Max 2: New Smart Features

One of the biggest reasons to upgrade to AirPods Max 2 is the new intelligent features powered by Apple’s latest software.

  • Conversation Awareness: When someone starts talking near you, the AirPods Max 2 automatically lower the music volume so you can hear them.
  • Voice Isolation: During phone calls, this feature focuses on your voice and reduces background noise, making conversations clearer.
  • Adaptive Audio and Personalized Volume: The AirPods can now automatically adjust sound levels depending on your environment.
  • Live Translation: Perhaps the most futuristic addition is real-time language translation. With Apple Intelligence, AirPods Max 2 can translate conversations into your preferred language while you listen.

These features make the new model feel much smarter than the original.

Audio Quality and Lossless Support

The first AirPods Max already offered impressive audio quality with custom drivers, Spatial audio, and Dynamic head tracking. But Bluetooth audio still limits the overall sound fidelity.

AirPods Max 2 improves this by supporting 24-bit/48 kHz lossless audio via USB-C. A new high-dynamic-range amplifier enhances the custom-built speaker. So you get fuller bass, more authentic voices, and more accurate instrument localization across a larger soundstage.

This is especially useful for music producers, audiophiles, and professional creators. For casual listeners, the sound improvements will still be noticeable thanks to better processing from the H2 chip and Bluetooth 5.3.

Battery Life

Interestingly, battery life remains similar between the two models. Both AirPods Max and AirPods Max 2 offer around 20 hours of listening time with active noise cancellation enabled.

While this may not seem like a major upgrade, Apple focused more on improving audio processing and smart features than on extending battery capacity. For most users, 20 hours is still enough for multiple days of listening.

Controls and Extra Features

AirPods Max introduced a unique control system using the Digital Crown, similar to the Apple Watch.

This control method returns on AirPods Max 2 but with a few new tricks:

  • Use the crown as a camera remote to take photos or start recording
  • Control playback and volume
  • Interact with Siri using head gestures like nodding or shaking your head

These additions make the headphones feel more interactive and integrated with Apple devices.

Price and Availability

The original AirPods Max launched with a premium price of $549.

Apple has kept the same pricing for the second generation. AirPods Max 2 also starts at $549, with preorders beginning in late March and availability following shortly after.

AirPods Max 2 vs. AirPods Max: Should You Upgrade?

If you already own the original AirPods Max, upgrading depends on how much you value the new features.

The biggest reasons to upgrade are:

  • noticeably better noise cancellation
  • smarter AI features
  • Improved voice calls and ANC
  • support for wired lossless audio
  • The powerful H2 chip

However, if you’re mainly happy with the sound quality and noise cancellation of your current AirPods Max, the differences may not feel dramatic enough to justify an immediate upgrade. For new buyers, though, AirPods Max 2 is clearly the better choice.

What do you think bout the new second-generation AirPods Max? Let us know in the comments below!

title.rendered: Apple Announces AirPods Max 2 with H2 Chip and Better ANC

content.rendered:
Apple has officially unveiled the second generation of its premium over-ear headphones, the AirPods Max 2. The update arrives more than five years after the original model debuted and brings several new features, including improved active noise cancellation, live language translation, and lossless audio support.

Here’s everything new Apple has introduced with the AirPods Max 2.

H2 Chip Powers Smarter Audio Features

The H2 chip allows AirPods Max 2 to support several adaptive listening technologies that automatically adjust the audio experience.

These include Adaptive Audio, which balances noise cancellation and transparency depending on your surroundings. Conversation Awareness lowers the media volume when the headphones detect someone speaking to you. Apple has also added Voice Isolation to improve call clarity by reducing background noise during phone or video calls.

Improved Noise Cancellation and Transparency Mode

Apple says the new AirPods Max deliver noticeably stronger active noise cancellation compared to the previous generation. Updated microphones and audio algorithms help block more environmental noise while maintaining audio clarity.

The company has also refined Transparency mode, allowing users to hear surrounding sounds more naturally when needed.

Live Translation Powered by Apple Intelligence

AirPods Max 2 introduce live language translation, powered by Apple Intelligence. This feature can translate spoken conversations in real time, allowing users to hear the translation directly through their headphones during multilingual interactions.

Lossless Audio Support with USB-C Connection

The new headphones support 24-bit/48 kHz lossless audio when connected via USB-C. This provides higher fidelity playback for users who prefer wired listening. It also comes equipped with a high-dynamic-range amplifier designed to deliver cleaner sound with improved detail and dynamic range.

Familiar Design with Premium Build

Despite the internal upgrades, the overall design remains largely unchanged. AirPods Max 2 continue to feature aluminum ear cups, a breathable mesh headband, and the Digital Crown for volume and playback controls.

Apple appears to have focused on improving performance rather than redesigning the hardware.

Price and Availability

AirPods Max 2 are priced at $549 in the United States. Apple says preorders will begin on March 25, with availability starting in early April.

The headphones are expected to launch in multiple markets around the same time.

What do you think about the new AirPods Max 2? Let us know in the comments.

title.rendered: WhatsApp Tests Guest Chats to Message People Without Accounts

content.rendered:
WhatsApp is testing a new feature called Guest Chats that allows users to message people who do not have a WhatsApp account. The feature lets users generate a secure invite link that opens a temporary conversation in a web browser, allowing recipients to reply without installing the app or creating an account.

The feature is currently rolling out to a limited number of beta users on Android and iOS. If widely released, it could lower the barrier to starting conversations with people who are not already on WhatsApp.

Invite Links Open Temporary Browser-Based Conversations

Guest Chats allow a WhatsApp user to create an invitation link from the app’s “Invite a Friend” section or from the contacts list. The link can be shared through SMS, email, or other messaging platforms.

When the recipient opens the link, it launches WhatsApp Web in a browser. The person can choose to install the app or continue the conversation as a guest. If they continue as a guest, they are asked to enter a display name and can begin messaging immediately.

The chat interface clearly labels the participant as a “Guest” to indicate that the person is not using a registered WhatsApp account.

Guest Conversations Use End-to-End Encryption

WhatsApp says Guest Chats maintain the same end-to-end encryption used in regular conversations. When a guest joins the chat, WhatsApp Web generates a unique identifier that creates the encryption key used to secure the messages.

Because of this encryption model, WhatsApp says only the participants in the conversation can read the messages.

Feature Is Intentionally Limited to Basic Messaging

Guest Chats are designed as temporary conversations rather than full WhatsApp accounts. As a result, the feature supports only basic text messaging.

Media sharing is not supported, including photos, videos, GIFs, documents, stickers, or voice messages. Voice and video calls are also unavailable. The feature also does not support group chats and is limited to one-on-one conversations.

Guests may also not receive notifications for new messages, meaning they may need to manually check the browser conversation.

Chats Expire After 10 Days of Inactivity

Guest Chats automatically expire after 10 days of inactivity. If a conversation expires, the user who created the invitation must generate a new link to restart the chat.

WhatsApp also allows users to block guest participants in the same way they would block a regular account.

The company notes that guest identities are not verified. If an invite link is shared widely or intercepted, someone other than the intended recipient could join the chat. WhatsApp highlights this risk within the interface and clearly labels guest participants.

The feature is still in testing and is currently available only to a limited number of beta users. WhatsApp has not announced when Guest Chats will be released to all users.

title.rendered: Titan Fishing Codes (March 2026)

content.rendered:
Update: Verified the latest Titan Fishing Codes on April 01, 2026

Titan Fishing is one of those Roblox games where patience, timing, and persistence matter just as much as luck. Instead of catching small fish, players face enormous sea creatures that can weigh thousands of kilograms. Each battle becomes a test of speed and endurance as you tap continuously to weaken the fish before the time runs out.

To progress faster, Titan Fishing codes can give you useful rewards like free money, exclusive rod skins, and powerful skill books. These rewards help you roll for stronger abilities and improve your chances of landing massive catches.

All Working Titan Fishing Codes

  • TAIJIEVENT: Free Rewards (NEW)
  • TITANFISHING: Godzilla Blade Skin
  • 1MVISITS: 50K Money

These rewards are particularly useful early on. Money allows you to roll for skill books, while items like Mythical Books can unlock powerful abilities that make catching giant fish significantly easier.

Expired Titan Fishing Codes

LOVES2026, SORRY2026

How to Redeem Titan Fishing Codes

Redeeming codes in Titan Fishing only takes a few seconds once you know where to look. Follow these steps:

  1. Launch Titan Fishing in Roblox.
  2. Click the Settings icon on the left side of the screen.
  3. Scroll down to the code redemption box.
  4. Enter a working code exactly as shown.
  5. Click Claim to receive your rewards.

If the code is valid, the rewards will instantly appear in your account.

Check the All Roblox Game Codes Master List to find working codes for every game.

What Rewards Do Titan Fishing Codes Give?

Titan Fishing codes usually reward players with items that help progress faster in the game. These rewards may include:

  • Money used for rolling skill books
  • Rod skins for customizing your fishing rod
  • Skill books that grant powerful fishing abilities

Skill books are especially important because they directly affect your fishing power and strategy.

What Are Skill Books in Titan Fishing?

Skill Books are special items obtained by rolling at an NPC in the game. Each roll grants one random book, with rarities ranging from common books to extremely rare Mythical books.

Without skill books, fishing becomes far more difficult. These abilities improve your effectiveness when battling giant fish, which is why players often spend large amounts of money rolling for better books.

The price of each roll increases over time. For example:

  • First roll: 20,000 money
  • Second roll: 21,000 money
  • Third roll: 22,000 money

Because the price increases with every roll, free money from codes can be extremely valuable.

Why Titan Fishing Codes Might Not Work

Sometimes a code may fail to redeem even if it appears correct. This usually happens for a few common reasons:

  1. The code has expired. Codes often stop working after updates or milestone events. If a code is expired, the game will reject it.
  2. Typing mistakes. Titan Fishing codes are case‑sensitive, so even a small typo or missing character can prevent redemption. Copying and pasting the code usually avoids this problem.
  3. Server issues. Occasionally, the server may not process the code correctly. Leaving the game and joining a new server often fixes the issue.

How to Get More Titan Fishing Codes

New Titan Fishing codes are usually released when the game reaches major milestones or receives updates.

The best way to find new codes quickly is by checking the official Titan Fishing Discord server, where developers often post announcements and update notes. You can also follow community pages and developer social media accounts where new codes are occasionally shared.

Bookmark this page and check back regularly. We update this guide whenever new Titan Fishing codes are released, so you never miss free rewards.

What Is Titan Fishing?

Titan Fishing is a Roblox fishing game where players hunt for massive fish that can weigh thousands of kilograms. Instead of passive fishing, every catch turns into an active battle where you must tap rapidly to damage the fish before the timer expires.

Players earn money from successful catches, which can then be used to roll for powerful skill books, upgrade abilities, and customize their rods with skins.

Over time, you build a stronger fishing setup and take on even larger sea creatures. The mix of progression, skill upgrades, and intense fishing battles is what makes Titan Fishing stand out from typical Roblox fishing games.

With new updates and milestone rewards appearing regularly, redeeming the latest Titan Fishing codes is one of the easiest ways to stay ahead and strengthen your fishing build.

  • Jujutsu Kaisen Incremental Codes
  • Garden Horizons Codes
  • Evil Plate Game Codes
  • Diesel n Steel Codes

content.rendered:
Update: Verified the latest Playground Basketball Codes on April 07, 2026

If you’ve been grinding Playground Basketball and watching your coin balance go nowhere, you’re not alone. The good news? There are active codes right now that hand you free coins, and using them takes less than a minute. Here’s everything you need: working codes, how to redeem them, and where to find more when these expire.

All Working Playground Basketball Codes

  • UPDATE5: 4.5k coins (NEW)
  • STAGE: 4.5k coins
  • 25MVISITS: 7.5k coins

That’s up to 16,500 free coins if you redeem all three right now. That’s real progress toward move animations, stat upgrades, and cosmetics you’d otherwise grind hours for.

You can also grab rewards with Anime Last Stand codes, Anime Defenders codes, or explore all Roblox game codes for more freebies.

Expired Playground Basketball Codes

Currently, all available codes are valid and can be redeemed. Keep in mind that developers may remove them when new codes are issued, so it’s best to redeem them promptly.

How to Redeem Playground Basketball Codes

Before anything else, there’s one thing most people miss that makes codes fail entirely. You must join the “Playground Basketball | Community” group on Roblox before codes will work. It’s a free group, just search it up on Roblox and hit Join. Skip this step and no code in the world will go through.

Once you’re in the group, here’s how to redeem:

  1. Launch Playground Basketball on Roblox and stay on the main menu.
  2. Look for the blue gift box icon in the top right corner and click it.
  3. A text field will pop up; type or paste your code there.
  4. Hit Redeem, and your coins will show up in your balance instantly.

One important tip: don’t type codes manually if you can avoid it. A single wrong character will give you an error, and it’s easy to waste time troubleshooting something that isn’t actually broken. Just copy the code straight from this article and paste it in.

Why Isn’t My Playground Basketball Code Working?

It’s frustrating when a code fails, but it’s almost always one of three things. First, check if the code has expired. If it’s in the expired list above, it’s done. Second, look for typos if you typed it manually. Third, if the game just got an update, give the servers a few minutes to stabilize before trying again, because fresh updates sometimes cause temporary redemption issues.

And the most overlooked reason of all? Not being in the community group. Double-check that first before anything else.

How to Get More Playground Basketball Codes

The developers drop new codes during game updates and when the game hits milestone numbers like visit counts or like counts. The faster the community grows, the more codes get released.

The two best ways to stay ahead are:

  • Bookmark this page so you catch codes as soon as they drop.
  • Join the Playground Basketball Guilded or Discord server, where the dev team posts codes in the updates channel directly. It’s the fastest way to catch a code before it expires.

Liking the game on its Roblox page also helps it reach milestones faster, which means more codes for everyone.

What Is Playground Basketball?

If you’re new to it, Playground Basketball is a Roblox sports game that’s more grounded than most. Forget the aura-farming and over-the-top dunks of other Roblox sports games. This one is about actually getting better. You build a customized player, train to improve your stats and traits, and take on real players in 1v1 or 2v2 matches across different courts, including city courts, park courts, and your own private practice area.

Coins are the currency that makes progression possible. They buy you new move animations, stat upgrades, and cosmetics. That’s exactly why these codes matter: they cut down the grind and let you focus on actually playing.

Check out more Roblox game codes:

  • Evil Plate Game Codes
  • Jujutsu Kaisen Incremental Codes
  • Garden Horizons Codes
  • Summon Heroes Codes

title.rendered: How to Stop iPhone Calls Ringing on Mac and iPad

content.rendered:
When you get a call on your iPhone, you may not want every nearby Apple device ringing along with it. While Apple’s ecosystem is designed for convenience, having your iPhone, Mac, and iPad ring at the same time can be distracting, especially during meetings or focused work.

The good news is that you can fix this quickly. Below, I’ll show you easy ways to stop iPhone calls from ringing on your Mac or iPad, whether you want to turn them off permanently or silence them temporarily.

Table of Contents
  • Why Are Your Mac and iPad Ringing When Your iPhone Gets a Call?
  • Method 1: Turn Off "Calls on Other Devices" on iPhone (Permanent Fix)
  • Method 2: Turn Off iPhone Call Notifications on Mac
  • Method 3: Use Focus Mode to Temporarily Silence Calls
    • On Mac:
    • On iPad:
  • How to Stop FaceTime Calls from Ringing on Mac and iPad
    • On Mac
    • On iPad:
  • Mac or iPad Still Ringing? Try These Quick Fixes
  • Final Thoughts

Why Are Your Mac and iPad Ringing When Your iPhone Gets a Call?

Your Mac and iPad ring with your iPhone because of Apple’s Continuity feature called “Calls on Other Devices.” When this feature is enabled, your iPhone sends incoming cellular calls to nearby Apple devices that are signed in with the same Apple ID and connected to the same Wi-Fi network. This allows you to answer calls from any of those devices.

If you do not want your Mac or iPad to ring, you can easily turn this feature off in your iPhone’s settings.

Method 1: Turn Off “Calls on Other Devices” on iPhone (Permanent Fix)

This is the most effective way to stop your Mac and iPad from ringing. Here’s how to turn it off:

  1. Open Settings.
  2. Scroll down to Apps and tap Phone.
  3. Tap Calls on Other Devices under Calls.
  4. Turn off the Allow Calls on Other Devices toggle.

Alternatively, instead of turning the feature off completely, you can disable it only for specific devices. Simply toggle off your Mac or iPad in the device list.

Note This setting affects both regular cellular calls and FaceTime audio calls routed through your phone number.

Method 2: Turn Off iPhone Call Notifications on Mac

If you want to manage this setting on a specific device, such as your Mac, you can turn it off directly from there.

Here’s how:

  1. Open the FaceTime app.
  2. Click FaceTime in the menu bar near the Apple icon.
  3. Select Settings (or Preferences on older versions).
  4. Uncheck Calls from iPhone.

This keeps the feature active on other devices while disabling it only on your Mac.

Method 3: Use Focus Mode to Temporarily Silence Calls

Turning on Focus mode is the quickest way to silence calls during meetings or work hours.

On Mac:

  1. Click the Control Center in the menu bar.
  2. Select Focus.
  3. Turn on Do Not Disturb.

You can set it for one hour, until the evening, or schedule it automatically.

On iPad:

  1. Open Control Center.
  2. Tap Focus.
  3. Enable Do Not Disturb.

Keep in mind that this silences all notifications, not just calls.

How to Stop FaceTime Calls from Ringing on Mac and iPad

FaceTime calls work differently from regular cellular calls. When someone calls you on FaceTime, every device signed in with your Apple ID may ring at the same time.

To stop this, sign out of FaceTime or remove your contact details from the device where you do not want to receive calls.

On Mac

  1. Open the FaceTime app.
  2. In the menu bar, go to FaceTime > Settings (or Preferences on older versions).
  3. Under the General tab, either Sign Out of FaceTime or update the “You can be reached for FaceTime at” section and deselect your phone number or email address.

On iPad:

  1. Open Settings.
  2. Scroll down and tap FaceTime.
  3. Turn off the FaceTime toggle

Mac or iPad Still Ringing? Try These Quick Fixes

If your Mac or iPad is still ringing, try the following quick checks:

  • Make sure both devices are signed in with the same Apple ID.
  • Restart your iPhone and Mac to clear temporary syncing issues.
  • Update to the latest version of iOS and macOS to avoid software glitches.

Sometimes Continuity settings take a few moments to sync across devices.

Final Thoughts

If your Mac and iPad ringing alongside your iPhone feels more chaotic than helpful, turning off “Calls on Other Devices” is an easy fix. Whether you disable it completely, adjust it for a specific device, or use Focus mode temporarily, you can control how calls appear across your Apple devices.

FAQs

Does turning this off affect iMessage?

No. Disabling “Calls on Other Devices” only affects phone call forwarding. iMessage syncing works separately.

Will emergency calls still ring?

If call forwarding is disabled, emergency calls will ring only on your iPhone.

Does this affect Handoff?

No. Handoff is a separate Continuity feature and will continue working unless you disable it separately.

blockGraphs.answer: No. Disabling “Calls on Other Devices” only affects phone call forwarding. iMessage syncing works separately.

blockGraphs.question: Will emergency calls still ring?
blockGraphs.answer: If call forwarding is disabled, emergency calls will ring only on your iPhone.

blockGraphs.question: Does this affect Handoff?
blockGraphs.answer: No. Handoff is a separate Continuity feature and will continue working unless you disable it separately.

title.rendered: Best Relaxing Games to Play on iPhone and Android

content.rendered:
After a long day, sometimes you don’t want intense battles or competitive matches—you just want a game that helps you relax and unwind. That’s where relaxing mobile games come in.

Instead of racing against the clock or competing with other players, they offer peaceful activities like building, organizing, farming, or solving gentle puzzles. In this article, we’ll explore some of the best relaxing games you can play on iPhone and Android to slow down, clear your mind, and enjoy a few peaceful moments anytime.

Table of Contents
  • How We Selected the Relaxing Games
  • Best Relaxing Games for iOS and Android
    • 1. My Perfect Hotel
    • 2. Cats&Soup: Relaxing Cozy Games
    • 3. Stardew Valley
    • 4. Tidy Up – Satisfeel ASMR
    • 5. Forest Island
    • 6. My Oasis: Anxiety Relief Game
    • 7. Energy: Anti-Stress Loops
  • Tips for Choosing the Right Relaxing Game
  • Final Thoughts

How We Selected the Relaxing Games

Not every casual game is truly relaxing. Some games may seem calm at first, but include timers, competitive pressure, or difficult challenges that can create stress.

To make this list helpful, we selected games based on a few important criteria.

  • Calm Gameplay Mechanics: Relaxing games should feel easy to pick up and enjoy without frustration. The games here include no time pressure, minimal punishment for mistakes, and an easy learning curve. So, you can focus on the experience rather than performance.
  • Soothing Visuals and Music: Most listed games use soft color palettes, gentle animations, ambient or calming soundtracks, and nature-inspired environments. These create a peaceful atmosphere, making the gameplay feel like a form of meditation.
  • Casual Play Sessions: Whether you have five minutes or an hour, the game should feel enjoyable. Because they don’t rely on competitive gameplay, you can simply play at your own pace and stop anytime.

Best Relaxing Games for iOS and Android

Below are some of the best relaxing games available on iPhone and Android. Each one offers a different style of calming gameplay, from cozy idle games to peaceful puzzles.

1. My Perfect Hotel

My Perfect Hotel is a relaxing time-management game where you build and run your own hotel. You start with a small property and slowly expand it to an empire by cleaning rooms, welcoming guests, and upgrading facilities.

The gameplay is simple and satisfying. Watching your hotel grow step by step creates a rewarding feeling without requiring complex strategies. Because tasks are repetitive and easy to complete, the game has a very satisfying rhythm that many players find relaxing.

Pros

  • Simple and satisfying gameplay
  • Progression feels rewarding
  • Easy to learn and simple to play

Cons

  • Contains ads and in-app purchases
  • Gameplay can become repetitive after long sessions

Download: iPhone | Android

2. Cats&Soup: Relaxing Cozy Games

Cats & Soup is one of the most charming, relaxing games available on iOS and Android. The game features adorable cats cooking soup and preparing food in a peaceful animal forest. It lets you name your own cats, dress them in different costumes, and feed them fish to receive hearts.

You mainly watch your cats work, collect resources when you go idle, and expand the forest by adding new cooking stations and decorations. The gentle animations, soft background music, relaxing ASMR sounds, and cute characters make this game feel extremely cozy.

Pros

  • Very cute and relaxing visuals
  • Soothing background music
  • Great for idle play

Cons

  • Progress can feel slow without upgrades
  • Some content is locked behind purchases

Download: iPhone | Android

3. Stardew Valley

Stardew Valley is a beloved farming RPG simulation game that offers a peaceful escape from busy life. In the game, you start off by inheriting a small farm and slowly build it into a beautiful countryside retreat.

Players can grow seasonal crops, raise animals, fish, decorate their farm, start a family, and build friendships with villagers. The auto-save option and mobile-specific features are intuitive.

Unlike many mobile games, Stardew Valley is a full premium game with deep gameplay and no ads. It allows players to move at their own pace, making it one of the most relaxing long-term games on mobile.

Pros

  • Rich and rewarding gameplay
  • No ads or aggressive monetization
  • Tons of activities to explore

Cons

  • Paid game
  • May feel overwhelming at the beginning due to many options

Download: iPhone | Android

4. Tidy Up – Satisfeel ASMR

Tidy Up is designed around the relaxing feeling of organizing and cleaning things. The game offers various mini tasks, such as arranging objects, cleaning messy spaces, applying makeup, and sorting items. Moreover, each week the mini-games get updated.

Many players enjoy this type of gameplay because it creates a sense of order and satisfaction, especially if you have OCD. The game also includes ASMR-style sound effects and chill background music for each level, enhancing the calming experience.

Pros

  • Extremely satisfying tasks
  • Simple gameplay mechanics
  • Good for quick relaxation sessions

Cons

  • Limited depth in gameplay
  • Levels are repetitive

Download: iPhone | Android

5. Forest Island

Forest Island is a peaceful idle game focused on nature and wildlife. You build a calm island habitat filled with over 100 species of animals and birds, including deer, foxes, whales, ducks, etc., from across various natural environments.

The game emphasizes nature, quiet music, and beautiful scenery. You can slowly unlock new animals and expand the island with new habitats while enjoying relaxing background music and soft ASMR environmental sounds, such as ocean, rain, wind, and bird chirps.

Pros

  • Beautiful nature-themed visuals
  • Very relaxing atmosphere
  • Perfect idle game for stress relief

Cons

  • Progress can be slow
  • Gameplay is mostly passive

Download: iPhone | Android

6. My Oasis: Anxiety Relief Game

My Oasis was specifically designed as a stress-relief game. Instead of focusing on competition or challenges, the game encourages relaxation and mindfulness.

Through simple tapping gameplay, you grow a peaceful zen oasis filled with trees, flowers, and animals and calming landscapes. It also has soothing music, affirmations, and soft interactions that are meant to reduce anxiety.

Many players use it to help unwind before bed or to de-stress after a long day at work.

Pros

  • Designed specifically for relaxation
  • Calm visuals and music
  • Encourages mindfulness

Cons

  • Limited gameplay mechanics
  • Mostly idle gameplay

Download: iPhone | Android

7. Energy: Anti-Stress Loops

Energy is a minimalist puzzle game where players connect energy loops to create satisfying visual patterns and turn on lights. The puzzles are simple, and there is no time pressure, which allows you to enjoy solving them slowly.

Moreover, the small brain teaser improves your concentration and logical skills. The game’s clean design makes each puzzle feel almost like a small meditation exercise.

Pros

  • Minimalist and elegant design
  • Relaxing puzzle experience
  • No stressful gameplay

Cons

  • Very simple gameplay
  • Not ideal for players who want deep progression

Download: iPhone | Android

Tips for Choosing the Right Relaxing Game

Not every relaxing game will feel the same for every player. The best game for you depends on your mood, play style, and how much time you want to spend.

Here are a few tips to help you choose.

  • Think about how you want to relax: Some players enjoy idle games where they can simply watch progress happen, like Cats&Soup or Forest Island. Others prefer light puzzles like Energy that gently stimulate the mind.
  • Consider session length: If you only have a few minutes to spare, quick games like Tidy Up work well. For longer relaxing sessions, deeper games like Stardew Valley offer much more to explore.
  • Look for calming audio and visuals: Games with soothing audio and visuals tend to help users relax more compared to games with bright colors and high-energy audio.
  • Avoid games with aggressive timers or competitive systems: Even casual games can become stressful if they push players to compete or rush.

Final Thoughts

Relaxing mobile games provide a great opportunity to take a breather from stress and slow down for a bit. Instead of focusing on competition and fast-paced gameplay, these mobile games focus on calm environments, simple mechanics, and enjoyable progression.

Whether you prefer cozy idle games, peaceful puzzles, or farming simulations, there are plenty of relaxing options available on both iPhone and Android. Games like Cats & Soup, Stardew Valley, and My Oasis are great examples of how mobile games can be both enjoyable and calming.

Which game did you like the most? Let us know in the comments below!

  • Best Roblox Fighting Games
  • Best Skateboarding Games
  • Best MMORPG Games

title.rendered: Apple May Drop Touchscreen Plans for MacBook Neo 2

content.rendered:
Apple’s rumored second-generation MacBook Neo 2 may not include a touchscreen, reversing earlier expectations about the feature.

Earlier reports suggested Apple was considering adding touchscreen support to the Neo lineup. However, newer information from analysts and insiders now indicates that the company may have dropped the idea entirely.

Earlier Rumors Created Excitement

Last year, Apple analyst Ming Chi Kuo reported that Apple was exploring touchscreen support for the MacBook Neo 2. That speculation quickly gained attention since Apple has historically resisted adding touchscreens to its Mac lineup.

Over time, the narrative shifted. Last week, Kuo said that the feature was still under internal discussion and might never make it to the final hardware.

The latest information now indicates that Apple may have decided to drop the idea entirely for this model.

Mark Gurman Weighs In on Touchscreen Macs

Bloomberg’s Mark Gurman has also weighed in on the rumors. In a recent discussion, Gurman said he would be “shocked” if Apple introduced a touchscreen Mac within the next three years.

His comments suggest that Apple is not actively planning to bring touch input to Mac notebooks in the near future. If accurate, this further reduces the chances that the MacBook Neo 2 will include the feature.

Possible Reason Behind the Shift

One major reason appears to be cost control. The MacBook Neo is marketed as Apple’s most affordable laptop, starting around $599, so adding a touch panel could increase manufacturing costs and push the price higher.

Apple seems intent on keeping the Neo positioned as a budget Mac competing with Chromebooks and low-cost Windows laptops.

Touchscreen Macs May Still Arrive Elsewhere

Even though the Neo may not receive the feature, reports suggest Apple is still exploring touch-enabled Macs.

For example, a higher-end MacBook with an OLED display and touchscreen may arrive first, potentially on the rumored MacBook Ultra, before the feature trickles down to cheaper Macs.

Do you think MacBooks should finally get touchscreens? Share your thoughts in the comments.

You may like to read:

  • MacBook Neo: The Best Reasons to Buy and the Biggest Reasons to Skip
  • MacBook Neo vs Mac mini: Which one should you actually buy?

title.rendered: Curious About Your First Liked Post on Instagram? You Can Actually Find It

content.rendered:
Instagram has been around for more than a decade. During that time, most users have liked thousands of posts without giving it much thought. From memes and celebrity photos to random travel shots, every double-tap quietly becomes part of your activity history.

What many people do not realize is that Instagram actually keeps a record of those likes. Hidden inside the app is a feature that lets you scroll through the posts you have liked over the years. With the right filter applied, you can even find the very first post you ever liked on the platform.

For long-time users, this can feel like opening a time capsule of their early social media days.

Table of Contents
  • Instagram Quietly Tracks Your Like History
  • Why People Are Suddenly Looking for Their First Liked Post?
  • Can You Actually See Your First Liked Post?
  • How to Find the First Post You Ever Liked on Instagram
  • What Your First Like Can Tell You
  • Why Instagram Keeps This Data
  • A Small but Fascinating Instagram Time Capsule

Instagram Quietly Tracks Your Like History

Every time you like a photo, Reel, or video on Instagram, that interaction is logged in your account activity. These interactions are collected so you can manage them later, and so Instagram can understand the type of content you engage with most.

This history is stored inside the Your Activity section of the app. From there, Instagram allows you to review the posts you have interacted with, including comments, story replies, and likes. Access to your activity history on the platform gives you more control over your digital activity and interactions.

Why People Are Suddenly Looking for Their First Liked Post?

The curiosity around first-liked posts did not appear out of nowhere. It began when Instagram users discovered that the app quietly stores liked posts in chronological order within the activity section.

Once people discovered this, many began revisiting their earliest Instagram interactions as part of a viral trend of nostalgia. Users started sharing screenshots of their first liked post and reflecting on how their interests have changed over time.

For some, the first like turns out to be an old celebrity photo. Others uncover early fandom posts, memes, or even pictures from accounts that no longer exist.

The experience often feels like scrolling through a personal archive of your internet life. Your first like can reveal what caught your attention years ago and how your social media habits have evolved since then.

Can You Actually See Your First Liked Post?

By default, Instagram shows your most recent 300 liked posts, arranged from newest to oldest. This means the posts you liked recently appear at the top of the list, while older ones appear as you scroll further down.

However, Instagram also includes a sorting option that allows you to rearrange these liked posts from oldest to newest. Once you apply this filter, the list flips and begins with your earliest available likes.

How to Find the First Post You Ever Liked on Instagram

If you want to take a trip down memory lane, here’s how you can find your first liked post on the Instagram app:

  1. Open the Instagram app and head to your profile.
  2. Here, tap the hamburger (More Options) icon in the top-right corner.
  3. Next, select Your Activity under the How you use Instagram section.
  4. Now, choose Likes under Interactions.
  5. Tap the Newest to Oldest button, then select Oldest to Newest option in the Sort by menu.
  6. Once done, the liked posts list will reload and display your liked posts starting from the earliest ones. The first item you see should be the first post you ever liked on the platform.

From there, you can tap the post to open it and revisit that moment.

What Your First Like Can Tell You

While most people look up their first liked post simply to satisfy curiosity and relive a bit of nostalgia, it can reveal more than just a random memory from the past.

If you look closely, you might notice things like:

  • The type of content you used to engage with
  • Accounts you followed years ago
  • Trends that were popular at the time
  • Early fandoms or hobbies that interested you

In a way, your first like works as a small digital marker of your early Instagram experience. It offers a glimpse into how your interests and social media habits have evolved over time.

Why Instagram Keeps This Data

Liking a post on Instagram does more than show appreciation. It also helps the platform understand the type of content you prefer to engage with, which Instagram then uses to personalize your overall experience.

Instagram analyzes interactions such as likes, comments, and saves to determine what content should appear in your feed and on the Explore page. Over time, these signals help shape the recommendations you see across the app. That means your earliest likes likely played a small role in influencing the type of content Instagram began showing you over the years.

A Small but Fascinating Instagram Time Capsule

While finding your first liked post on Instagram takes just a few seconds, the result can be surprisingly nostalgic. It reminds you of when you first joined the platform, the kind of content that caught your attention back then, and how much Instagram has changed since those early days.

Did you check your first liked post on Instagram? Share your findings in the comments.

About Vikhyat Rishi

  • Vikhyat has over five years of experience writing consumer tech content.
  • During his association with Smartprix and Beebom, Vikhyat has tested, tested, and reviewed numerous gadgets, including but not limited to smartphones, TVs, and more.
  • His passion for technology and Apple products led him to iGeeksBlog, where he specializes in writing How-to and troubleshooting guides for fellow Apple enthusiasts.

Experience

Vikhyat embarked on his journey in consumer technology writing in 2019, driven by his passion for technology. He has sharpened his skills through associations with Smartprix and Beebom, where he extensively tested and reviewed various gadgets, focusing mainly on smartphones. Currently, Vikhyat specializes in crafting How-to and troubleshooting guides for the Apple ecosystem at iGeeksBlog. When not typing away on his MacBook Air, he loves exploring the real world.

title.rendered: Apple Won’t Overhaul Liquid Glass in iOS 27, But a New Customization Slider Is in the Works

content.rendered:
Apple does not plan significant design changes to Liquid Glass in iOS 27, according to Mark Gurman’s Power On newsletter. The latest internal builds of iOS 27 and macOS 27 show no major departures from the translucent design language introduced with iOS 26, with Apple instead targeting gradual refinements over multiple release cycles.

iOS 27 Builds Show No Major Design Overhaul

Liquid Glass, which debuted as a system-wide visual framework in iOS 26, drew sustained criticism from users over readability issues, particularly around text legibility on translucent surfaces. Despite that feedback, Apple’s current development trajectory for iOS 27 does not include sweeping design revisions. Gurman characterizes the expected pace of change as “years of gradual improvements,” reflecting the significant engineering investment the design required.

Apple has incrementally expanded user control over Liquid Glass since launch. iOS 26.1 introduced a Tinted display mode offering reduced transparency, and iOS 26.4 added an option to disable Liquid Glass highlights entirely. iOS 27 is expected to continue that pattern rather than reverse course.

System-Wide Glass Intensity Slider Was Cut From iOS 26

One specific feature remains under active development: a system-wide slider that would allow users to continuously adjust the intensity of the glass effect across the entire operating system, including the home screen, app folders, and navigation bars. Apple implemented a version of this control for the lock screen clock in iOS 26 but encountered engineering obstacles that prevented it from being extended across all system elements before release.

Whether the feature ships in iOS 27 depends on resolving those engineering challenges alongside broader stability work. If it does, it would give users finer control than the current binary choice between the Clear and Tinted options.

Design Leadership Changed After iOS 26 Launch

Alan Dye, the design executive who oversaw Liquid Glass’s development, left Apple in late 2024 to join Meta. Steve Lemay succeeded him as design lead. The current iOS 27 builds suggest Lemay’s team is continuing within the design framework Dye established rather than reorienting it.

iOS 27, macOS 27, and watchOS 27 are expected to be announced at Apple’s Worldwide Developers Conference, with this year’s release cycle reported to prioritize performance and system stability.

excerpt.rendered: Apple’s iOS 27 keeps Liquid Glass but may finally add the system-wide intensity slider that was cut from iOS 26.

title.rendered: Best MacBook Neo Sleeves for Stylish and Safe Laptop Protection

content.rendered:
The MacBook Neo is designed to be lightweight, portable, and stylish. Like most modern MacBooks, it features a sleek aluminum body and a thin design that looks great but can also be vulnerable to scratches, dents, and everyday wear.

If you plan to carry your MacBook to work, school, or coffee shops, investing in a good protective case or sleeve is one of the smartest accessories you can buy. A quality sleeve not only protects your laptop but also makes it easier to carry and store inside backpacks or travel bags.

In this guide, we’ll walk through the best sleeves for MacBook Neo, explain how to choose the right one, and share practical tips to keep both your sleeve and laptop in great condition.

Why You Need a Protective Case or Sleeve for MacBook Neo

Even though MacBooks are built with strong aluminum bodies, they are not immune to damage. Everyday use introduces small risks that can slowly wear down your laptop.

  • Protection from scratches and dents: When you put your MacBook inside a backpack or tote bag, it often sits alongside chargers, keys, notebooks, and other items. These can easily scratch the surface or create pressure marks on the body. A padded sleeve creates a soft protective barrier that prevents direct contact with hard objects.
  • Safety during travel: Whether you’re commuting, working remotely, or flying, your laptop may get bumped, squeezed, or dropped. Many sleeves include shock-absorbing foam, corner protection, and water-resistant fabrics. This helps ensure the laptop remains safe even if it is accidentally dropped.
  • Better portability: Sleeves also make laptops easier to carry. Some include handles or extra pockets for accessories like chargers, mice, or USB hubs. For minimalists, sleeves are perfect because they add protection without making the laptop bulky.
  • Clean and organized storage: A sleeve keeps your MacBook separate from other items in your bag. This prevents dust, crumbs, or liquids from directly reaching the device.

If you use your laptop daily, a sleeve simply keeps everything neater and more organized.

Best Sleeve for MacBook Neo

Below are some of the best sleeve currently available that fit 13-inch MacBooks, making them suitable for MacBook Neo users. We selected them based on protection, build quality, usability, and value.

1. tomtoc 360° Protective Laptop Sleeve

tomtoc is one of the most trusted laptop case brands for excellent protection and durability. It’s also one of the top picks in our MacBook Neo accessories list.

The 360° protective sleeve uses CornerArmor technology and high-resilience edges for military-grade drop protection, which is especially helpful if you frequently carry your laptop in a backpack. The reinforced edges absorb shock during drops or impacts. Inside the sleeve, you’ll find soft fleece lining that prevents scratches.

The exterior material is water-resistant, helping protect the laptop from spills or light rain. What makes tomtoc stand out is its internal high-density padding structure. The sleeve doesn’t feel bulky yet still provides excellent protection. Moreover, you can carry basic accessories in the front pocket and attach an AirTag to the additional strap.

Best for: If you want maximum protection without a heavy case.

Check out on Amazon

2. Lacdo 13-inch Laptop Sleeve Case

The Lacdo sleeve is popular because it offers a great balance between affordability and protection. It features anti-scratch velour padding, high-resilience buffer layers, and thick shockproof lining that cushions your laptop during bumps.

The exterior is made with water-repellent fabric that keeps moisture away from your device.

Additionally, the sleeve liner is made of high-density velvet with an anti-static barrier, giving your MacBook both soft comfort and practical protection.

The best part is its extra accessory pocket, where you can store charging cables, a mouse, USB drives, and small notebooks. This makes it especially useful for students or professionals who carry multiple accessories.

Best for: Extra storage space for accessories.

Check out on Amazon

3. MOSISO Protective Sleeve Bag

MOSISO sleeves are known for their simple design and wide color selection. The sleeve bag features thick cushioning and a soft padded interior that protects the laptop’s surface from scratches and minor bumps.

It’s lightweight, slim, and includes an extendable handle, which makes it easy to carry.

If you are traveling with a trolley bag, you can secure it on top using the back luggage strap. MOSISO sleeves are also very popular because they come in many colors and include extra pockets for accessories.

If you care about aesthetics and want a sleeve that matches your style, MOSISO is a great option.

Best for: A classic business style and color variety.

Check out on Amazon

4. VANDEL The Original Puffy Laptop Sleeve

The VANDEL Puffy sleeve is inspired by puffer jackets, giving it a unique and trendy look. Instead of standard padding, this sleeve uses soft quilted cushioning to absorb shock while maintaining a lightweight feel.

The puffy texture adds extra softness and also makes the sleeve comfortable to carry. You can also compress it slightly to slip it into your backpack.

The sleeve has a plush interior that keeps your MacBook scratch-free from all sides.

Best for: Casual users who want something both fashionable and protective.

Check out on Amazon

5. JETech Slim Leather Case for MacBook Neo

If you prefer a more professional look, the JETech leather sleeve is an excellent option.

The sleeve is made of synthetic leather, giving it a clean and elegant appearance that works well in office environments. The exterior is also water- and dust-resistant, making it suitable for daily use.

Unlike padded sleeves, this design focuses more on scratch protection and presentation rather than heavy drop protection. It is only 0.36 inches thick and includes a magnetic closure to keep the laptop secure.

Best for: Professionals who want a premium and minimalist design.

Check out on Amazon

6. Fintie MacBook Sleeve Case with Stand

The Fintie sleeve is another budget-friendly option that offers good everyday protection.

It features a soft microfiber interior and a durable synthetic leather outer layer to help protect the laptop against scratches, water spills, fingerprints, and minor impacts.

Since it does not include heavy padding, it provides basic protection suitable for daily commuting.

The highlight of this sleeve is that it can also function as a stand for your MacBook. The top flap can even work as a mouse pad, allowing you to quickly set up a workspace anywhere.

Best for: Users who want a convenient and affordable sleeve.

Check out on Amazon

7. FINPAC Hard Laptop Sleeve Case

FINPAC sleeves are built for strong protection and outdoor durability.

It features a thick EVA hard shell, a protective ridge, and cushioned padding inside, which provide excellent shock resistance. This makes it a great choice for travelers or people who often carry their laptops in crowded environments.

Another advantage is its waterproof polyester exterior. Even if you get caught in the rain or spill something accidentally, your MacBook will remain safe.

Although slightly bulkier than other sleeves, the level of protection is noticeably higher.

Best for: Travelers who want extra drop and water protection.

Check out on Amazon

How to Choose the Right MacBook Neo Case or Sleeve

Choosing the right sleeve depends on how and where you use your laptop.

Consider Your Daily Usage

If your MacBook mostly stays at home or in an office, a simple padded sleeve is usually enough. However, if you travel often or commute daily, you should consider a sleeve with:

  • Shock-absorbing padding
  • Corner protection
  • Water-resistant materials

Check the Internal Padding and Protection

Good sleeves use soft materials like fleece or microfiber to prevent scratches.

Thin fabric sleeves may look nice but often provide very little protection.

Look for Extra Storage Pockets

If you carry chargers, cables, or a mouse, choosing a sleeve with extra storage pockets can make your setup more convenient.

Choose the Correct Size and Compatibility

Most MacBook Neo users will need a sleeve designed for 13-inch laptops.

A sleeve that is too loose can allow the laptop to move around, while one that is too tight may stress the zipper or seams.

Maintenance Tips to Keep Your MacBook Sleeve in Good Condition

A good sleeve can last for years if you take proper care of it.

  • Clean it regularly: Fabric sleeves can collect dust and dirt over time. Occasionally wipe the exterior with a slightly damp cloth. For fabric models, gentle hand cleaning can help remove stains.
  • Avoid overloading pockets: Accessory pockets are useful, but overfilling them with heavy items can press against the laptop and cause pressure damage.
  • Keep zippers clean: Dust inside the zipper track can lead to jamming or scratching your MacBook. Cleaning the area occasionally helps maintain smooth operation.
  • Store in dry environments: Even water-resistant sleeves can develop odors or mildew if stored in damp places. Keeping your sleeve dry helps extend its lifespan.

Final Thoughts: Which MacBook Neo Sleeve Should You Choose?

A sleeve may seem like a small accessory, but it plays a big role in protecting your MacBook Neo.

Whether you prefer maximum protection, stylish designs, or lightweight portability, there are plenty of great options available.

If protection is your top priority, sleeves like tomtoc or FINPAC offer excellent shock and water resistance. For something minimal and stylish, options like MOSISO, VANDEL, or JETech leather sleeves work very well. The Fintie sleeve is also a versatile choice thanks to its built-in stand and mouse pad functionality.

The best sleeve ultimately depends on how you use your laptop and how much protection you need.

Which one do you like the most? Let us know in the comments below.

title.rendered: How to Change Background Color on Instagram Story (5 Easy Methods)

content.rendered:
Sharing a Story on Instagram is one of the quickest ways to share your favorite moments with friends and followers. However, not every memory needs to be shown in full screen. Sometimes you may resize a photo or video to add text or stickers, or to create a cleaner layout. When you do that, Instagram fills the empty space with a default background color, and it does not always match the content you are sharing.

Fortunately, Instagram offers different ways to change the Story background color to better suit your photo, video, or design. Continue reading to learn how.

Table of Contents
  • Why Change the Background Color on Instagram Stories?
  • Method 1: Change Instagram Story Background to a Solid Color
  • Method 2: Use Create Mode for Gradient Backgrounds on Instagram Stories
  • Method 3: Add a Color Overlay to a Photo in Instagram Stories
  • Method 4: Change the Background Color When Sharing a Post to Instagram Story
  • Method 5: Use a Custom Image as Your Instagram Story Background
  • Tips to Design Better Instagram Story Backgrounds
  • Make Your Instagram Stories Stand Out

Why Change the Background Color on Instagram Stories?

Instagram Stories attract huge daily engagement, but they also move fast. So the way your content looks can determine how quickly it captures attention. A custom background helps set the tone and makes your Story visually stand out.

Here are a few practical reasons people change Story backgrounds:

  • Make text more readable against photos
  • Maintain a consistent aesthetic or brand color scheme
  • Highlight reposted posts or announcements
  • Create minimal or bold Story designs
  • Separate different Story slides visually

Method 1: Change Instagram Story Background to a Solid Color

Using a solid color background is one of the easiest ways to customize your Instagram Story. It allows you to create a clean canvas and then add photos, videos, text, or stickers on top of it.

  1. Open the Instagram app and swipe left to access the Instagram Camera.
  2. Here, tap the Capture button to take a photo.
  3. Tap the Draw tool icon in the vertical toolbar on the side.
  4. Choose a color from the palette at the bottom.
  5. If the available colors do not suit your design, you can tap and hold any color to open the full color slider and choose a custom shade.
  6. Press and hold anywhere on the screen for a second until the background fills with the selected color, then tap Done.
  7. Now, tap the Sticker icon in the side toolbar.
  8. Select Photo, then choose the photo or video you want to place on the Story.
  9. You can resize and reposition the added photo or video anywhere on the colored background.

Similarly, you can add text, stickers, GIFs, or additional photos to design your Story the way you want. You can also use the Draw tool again to change the background color.

Method 2: Use Create Mode for Gradient Backgrounds on Instagram Stories

Instagram’s Create mode lets you quickly add colorful gradient backgrounds to your Stories without uploading a photo or manually filling the canvas.

  1. Open Instagram, then swipe right to open the camera.
  2. Tap the Aa Create on the left side of the screen. Instagram automatically adds a gradient background.
  3. Tap the color circle in the bottom corner to cycle through different gradient styles.
  4. Once you find a background you like, tap the Capture button to continue editing your Story.
  5. Now, you can add a photo or video, text, stickers, GIFs, polls, or music to complete your Story.

Method 3: Add a Color Overlay to a Photo in Instagram Stories

This method adds a translucent color tint over the photo instead of covering it completely, allowing the image to remain visible while giving your Story a distinct visual style.

  1. Upload a photo to your Instagram Story.
  2. Tap the Draw tool icon in the vertical toolbar on the side.
  3. Here, select the Highlighter tool at the top.
  4. Next, select the preferred color from the color palette or tap and hold a color to open the full color slider and pick a custom shade.
  5. Once done, press and hold anywhere on the uploaded photo for a second until the selected color overlay appears.

Method 4: Change the Background Color When Sharing a Post to Instagram Story

When you add a post to your Story, Instagram automatically generates background colors based on the post you share. You can use the generated background color or switch among the available options until you find one that looks good with the post.

  1. Tap the Share button under the post you want to share to your Story.
  2. Next, tap Add to Story.
  3. Here, tap the background color circle in the right toolbar to cycle through different background color variations.

Method 5: Use a Custom Image as Your Instagram Story Background

Using a custom image as the background gives you greater creative control. Many creators use gradient designs, aesthetic wallpapers, or branded templates to make their Stories look more polished and visually consistent.

  1. Upload the photo or gradient design you want to use as your Story background.
  2. Now, tap the Sticker icon in the side toolbar.
  3. Select Photo, then choose the photo or video you want to place in the foreground of the Story.
  4. Repeat the same steps to add more photos, text, or stickers.
  5. Resize and position the added photos, text, or stickers according to your preferences.

Tips to Design Better Instagram Story Backgrounds

Changing the background color might be the first step, but it should not be the last. A few simple design choices can make your Instagram Story look more polished and visually appealing.

  • Use contrasting colors: Choose background colors that complement your text or stickers. This helps your content remain easy to read and visually clear.
  • Stick to a consistent color theme: Using the same set of colors across multiple Stories can give your content a more cohesive and recognizable look.
  • Layer photos creatively: Instead of using a single image, try adding multiple photos using the Photo sticker. Arrange and resize them to create a collage-style story.
  • Keep the layout clean: Avoid overcrowding your Story with too many elements. A minimal layout often looks cleaner and keeps the focus on the main content.
  • Use gradients or textures: Custom gradient backgrounds or subtle textures can make your Story look more visually interesting than a plain color.

Make Your Instagram Stories Stand Out

Changing the background color on your Instagram Story is a simple trick that can dramatically improve the visual appeal of your content. Once you start experimenting with colors, gradients, and overlays, you will find countless ways to make your Instagram Stories stand out.

Tried any of these methods? Share your experience in the comments.

title.rendered: How to Turn Off Autoplay on YouTube (iPhone, Android, Desktop, and TV)

content.rendered:
You may have noticed that whenever you finish watching a video on YouTube, another one automatically starts right after it. It’s YouTube Autoplay that starts the next recommended video without requiring you to click anything. While this can be convenient, it can also make you watch videos longer than you intended and consume more mobile data.

The good news is that YouTube offers several ways to turn autoplay off across devices. In this guide, we’ll walk through exactly how to stop autoplay and feed previews on YouTube using your iPhone, Android, computer, or TV.

Table of Contents
  • What Is YouTube Autoplay?
  • Why You Might Want to Turn Off YouTube Autoplay
  • How to Turn Off YouTube Autoplay on iPhone and Android
    • Method 1: Turn Off Autoplay from the Video Player
    • Method 2: Disable Autoplay from YouTube Settings
  • How to Turn Off YouTube Autoplay on Desktop (Web Browser)
  • How to Disable YouTube Autoplay on Smart TVs and Streaming Devices
  • How to Disable Video Previews on YouTube
    • On iPhone and Android
    • On Desktop and Web
    • On TV App
  • YouTube Autoplay Not Turning Off? Try These Fixes
  • Final Thoughts

What Is YouTube Autoplay?

Autoplay is a built-in YouTube feature that automatically starts playing another video once the current one ends. You’ll usually see a countdown timer when the video finishes. After a few seconds, the next suggested video begins automatically.

YouTube introduced this feature to keep viewers engaged and help them discover more content. The platform’s recommendation system analyzes what you’ve watched previously, the topics you frequently search for, and the channels you follow. Based on that data, it automatically queues a similar video you might want to watch next.

Note that if you are streaming videos on a mobile network, Autoplay automatically stops after 30 minutes of inactivity, regardless of your settings. When connected to Wi-Fi, Autoplay stops after four hours.

Why You Might Want to Turn Off YouTube Autoplay

While Autoplay can help you discover new videos, many users choose to turn it off for practical reasons. The most common ones include:

  • Control screen time: Autoplay can easily lead to endless viewing sessions without realizing how much time has passed. Turning it off helps you stop after finishing a video.
  • Save mobile data: If you are watching videos on a mobile network, Autoplay can quickly consume your data plan by loading multiple videos automatically.
  • Avoid irrelevant recommendations: Sometimes the next suggested video may not match what you want to watch.
  • Reduce distractions: When videos start playing automatically, they can interrupt your focus.
  • Improve browsing control: Disabling autoplay lets you choose exactly which video to watch next.

How to Turn Off YouTube Autoplay on iPhone and Android

Disabling YouTube Autoplay is simple, though the process can vary slightly depending on the device. You can turn it off in the following ways:

Method 1: Turn Off Autoplay from the Video Player

  1. Open the YouTube app on your phone.
  2. Start playing any video.
  3. Look for the Autoplay toggle near the top of the video player.
  4. Tap the switch to turn it OFF.

Once disabled, YouTube will stop automatically playing the next video.

Method 2: Disable Autoplay from YouTube Settings

  1. Open the YouTube app.
  2. Tap your profile icon in the bottom left corner.
  3. Go to Settings by tapping the gear icon.
  4. Scroll down and tap Playback.
  5. Toggle off Auto-play next video.

How to Turn Off YouTube Autoplay on Desktop (Web Browser)

If you’re watching YouTube on a computer, the steps are just as simple. You can also keep Autoplay enabled on your phone while disabling it on your computer.

  1. Open YouTube in your browser.
  2. Play any video.
  3. On the right side of the video player, you’ll see the Autoplay toggle.
  4. Click the switch to turn autoplay OFF.

After disabling it, YouTube will stop loading the next video automatically. Your preference is usually saved in your browser, so you won’t need to change it every time.

How to Disable YouTube Autoplay on Smart TVs and Streaming Devices

If you use YouTube on smart TVs or streaming devices such as Roku or Fire TV, you can disable Autoplay through the app settings.

  1. Open the YouTube app on your TV.
  2. Go to Settings.
  3. Scroll to Auto-play.
  4. Select the options to turn auto-play On or Off.

This stops the platform from automatically playing recommended videos after the current one finishes.

How to Disable Video Previews on YouTube

Besides Autoplay, YouTube also uses video previews that automatically play when you hover over thumbnails. These previews can be distracting and may use extra data.

You can disable them as well.

On iPhone and Android

  1. Open the YouTube app.
  2. Tap your profile icon.
  3. Go to Settings.
  4. On iPhone, tap Playback. For Android, select General.
  5. Tap Playback in feeds.
  6. Choose Off from the options.

This stops videos from previewing automatically while you scroll.

On Desktop and Web

  1. Click your profile icon.
  2. Select Settings from the dropdown menu.
  3. Go to Playback and Performance from the left pane.
  4. Toggle off Video Previews at the bottom.

After disabling it, hovering over videos will no longer start previews.

On TV App

Most TV versions of YouTube also include preview autoplay.

To disable it:

  1. Open YouTube on your TV.
  2. Go to Settings.
  3. Find Previews or Autoplay previews.
  4. Turn it OFF.

YouTube Autoplay Not Turning Off? Try These Fixes

Sometimes YouTube continues playing the next video even after Autoplay is turned off. This usually happens because of app glitches, browser issues, or account sync problems.

Here are some effective fixes:

  • Check the Autoplay toggle again: Occasionally, the toggle does not register correctly. Turn Autoplay on and then off again to refresh the setting.
  • Refresh the page or restart the app: Temporary glitches can cause Autoplay bugs. Refresh the browser page, close and reopen the YouTube app, or restart your phone or computer.
  • Clear browser cache and cookies: If you watch YouTube in a browser, corrupted cache files can cause Autoplay to behave incorrectly. Clearing them often fixes the issue.
  • Disable browser extensions: Some extensions, especially ad blockers or video enhancement tools, can interfere with YouTube playback settings. Disable them one by one to identify the cause.
  • Update the YouTube app: An outdated version of the app may cause Autoplay bugs. Check the App Store or Google Play Store for updates.
  • Log out and sign back in: Account sync issues can sometimes reset settings. Sign out of YouTube, close the app or browser, and log in again.

If the issue continues, try opening YouTube in another browser such as Chrome, Edge, or Firefox, or test it on another device. If Autoplay works normally there, the problem is likely related to your current browser configuration.

Final Thoughts

YouTube Autoplay can help you discover new content, but it can also lead to unwanted video playback and longer screen time. Thankfully, YouTube gives users full control over this feature.

By turning off Autoplay on your phone, computer, or TV, you can decide exactly when and what to watch next. You can also disable previews to make browsing calmer and more intentional.

Spending just a few minutes adjusting these settings can give you a more controlled, focused, and enjoyable YouTube experience.

FAQs

Will turning off YouTube Autoplay affect video recommendations?

No. Turning off Autoplay does not change how YouTube recommends videos. The recommendation system will still use your search history and other activity to suggest relevant videos. The only difference is that the next video will not start automatically.

Can I disable YouTube Autoplay on smart TVs or streaming devices?

Yes. Most smart TVs and streaming platforms include Autoplay settings in the YouTube app. You can usually disable it by opening YouTube → Settings → Autoplay and turning off Autoplay Next Video. Once disabled, videos will stop playing automatically after the current one finishes

mainEntity.name: Will turning off YouTube Autoplay affect video recommendations?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. Turning off Autoplay does not change how YouTube recommends videos. The recommendation system will still use your search history and other activity to suggest relevant videos. The only difference is that the next video will not start automatically.

mainEntity.name: Can I disable YouTube Autoplay on smart TVs or streaming devices?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Most smart TVs and streaming platforms include Autoplay settings in the YouTube app. You can usually disable it by opening YouTube → Settings → Autoplay and turning off Autoplay Next Video. Once disabled, videos will stop playing automatically after the current one finishes

title.rendered: Apple Confirms Plans to Mark 50th Anniversary on April 1, 2026

content.rendered:
Apple today announced it will celebrate the company’s 50th anniversary in the coming weeks, marking five decades since its founding on April 1, 1976. The company confirmed the milestone in a press release but did not disclose specific details about the planned celebrations.

Apple said the anniversary will serve as a moment to reflect on the company’s history while recognizing the people and communities that have built products, apps, and creative work using Apple technology.

Apple Signals a Reflective Milestone but Reveals Few Details

The company stated that its anniversary activities will highlight the creativity, innovation, and global impact made possible through Apple products over the past five decades. However, Apple has not yet outlined the format or timing of any specific events or announcements tied to the celebration.

In the press release, Apple described the milestone as an opportunity to acknowledge the journey that shaped the company and the community that grew around its technology.

Tim Cook Publishes “50 Years of Thinking Different” Letter

Apple CEO Tim Cook marked the announcement by sharing a letter titled “50 Years of Thinking Different.” The message references Apple’s long‑running “Think Different” advertising slogan used in the late 1990s and early 2000s.

Cook said the idea of thinking differently has remained central to Apple’s approach to product development and its broader mission to build tools that help people create, communicate, and express themselves.

He also noted that while Apple typically focuses on future innovation rather than past achievements, the 50‑year milestone offered an opportunity to thank the millions of people who have contributed to the company’s growth.

Apple Launches New “Hello Apple” Instagram Account

Alongside the announcement, Apple launched a new Instagram account called “Hello Apple.” The account appears intended to support the anniversary campaign and related storytelling around Apple’s history and community.

Apple has not yet said whether additional product announcements, events, or commemorative initiatives will accompany the anniversary as April 1 approaches.

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. It works normally on extended displays and ultrawide monitors.

acceptedAnswer.text: No. Disabling “Calls on Other Devices” only affects phone call forwarding. iMessage syncing works separately.

mainEntity.name: Will turning off YouTube Autoplay affect video recommendations?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. Turning off Autoplay does not change how YouTube recommends videos. The recommendation system will still use your search history and other activity to suggest relevant videos. The only difference is that the next video will not start automatically.

mainEntity.name: Can I disable YouTube Autoplay on smart TVs or streaming devices?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. title.rendered: Google Maps Gets a Powerful Gemini AI Upgrade and It changes Search

content.rendered:
Google has released a major AI upgrade to Google Maps, integrating its Gemini model to make place searches more intuitive. The update adds a conversational feature named Ask Maps along with a new Immersive Navigation system designed to make navigation more intelligent and interactive.

The integration aims to transform Google Maps from a traditional navigation tool into an AI-driven discovery platform that helps users find places, plan trips, and understand routes with more context.

Gemini Integration Brings Conversational Search to Maps

With the new Ask Maps interface, users can ask complex questions directly in Google Maps, rather than relying on basic keyword searches.

For example, users can ask prompts such as:

  • Find a quiet cafe nearby with good Wi-Fi
  • Suggest a scenic road trip route for the weekend
  • Where can I play tennis tonight with lights

Gemini processes large amounts of Maps data, including reviews, photos, and business information, to deliver contextual recommendations. This approach helps surface locations that match the user’s needs more accurately than standard search queries.

AI-Powered Recommendations Based on User Preferences

The update also improves recommendations by analyzing a user’s past activity and preferences within Google Maps.

The AI can suggest restaurants, attractions, or places to visit based on a user’s interests and previous searches. It can also generate trip ideas by combining multiple stops, such as cafes, parks, and sightseeing spots, along a route. This turns Google Maps into a planning assistant that helps users discover places rather than simply navigate.

Immersive Navigation With Enhanced Route Previews

Alongside Ask Maps, Google is introducing a new Immersive Navigation experience in Google Maps. The upgraded navigation interface provides a more detailed visual representation of routes, including:

  • Realistic 3D buildings and terrain
  • Clearer road layouts and intersections
  • Previews of upcoming turns and landmarks

The goal is to make navigation easier to understand before reaching a location.

Rollout and Availability

The Gemini-powered features are rolling out to Google Maps on iOS and Android, with initial availability in select regions including the United States and India.

Google plans to expand the rollout to more users and platforms over time as the AI-powered experience continues to evolve.

What do you think about Gemini AI coming to Google Maps? Share your thoughts in the comments below.

Currently, Vikhyat specializes in crafting How-to and troubleshooting guides for the Apple ecosystem at iGeeksBlog. When not typing away on his MacBook Air, he loves exploring the real world.
