title.rendered: Apple Launches MacBook Pro With M5 Pro and M5 Max: Specs, Features, and Price

content.rendered:
Apple has officially introduced the new MacBook Pro powered by M5 Pro and M5 Max chips, along with the M5 MacBook Air. This update is a big one. If you’re a developer, video editor, designer, or someone who pushes their laptop hard every day, this launch is worth your attention.

In this detailed guide, I’ll break down everything you need to know about the new MacBook Pro M5 Pro and M5 Max, including its specifications, features, pricing, and whether it’s worth your money.

What’s New with the MacBook Pro (2026)

The latest MacBook Pro models, available in 14-inch and 16-inch sizes, now come equipped with Apple’s all-new M5 Pro and M5 Max chips. These silicon upgrades offer massive gains in performance, AI processing, graphics, and overall pro-level capabilities.

Key Highlights:

  • Upgraded CPU with the world’s fastest single-core performance.
  • Next-gen GPU architecture with Neural Accelerators in each core for AI tasks.
  • Enhanced SSD that’s up to 2× faster than previous models.
  • Starts at 1TB storage for M5 Pro models and 2TB for M5 Max models.
  • Up to 24 hours of battery life on select configurations

Introducing M5 Pro and M5 Max Chips: Built for Power Users

Let’s talk about the heart of the machine: the new chips in the M5 family. The M5 Pro and M5 Max is created using new Apple-designed Fusion Architecture specifically for AI. Apple has integrated a new up-to-18-core CPU with 6 super cores and 12 performance cores. Overall, it offers up to 30 percent faster performance. This means you can:

  • Compile code faster
  • Edit high-resolution videos smoothly
  • Work on complex spreadsheets and simulations
  • Run multiple heavy apps at once without slowdown

Apple has also improved AI performance significantly. Tasks like on-device machine learning, image processing, and AI-assisted editing are much faster compared to previous generations.

If you’re a developer, video editor, or content creator, the M5 Pro will already feel extremely powerful.

M5 Max: Maximum Performance for Extreme Workloads

The M5 Max is for users who need the highest possible performance in a laptop.

This version focuses heavily on graphics power and memory bandwidth. It’s ideal for:

  • 3D rendering and animation
  • Advanced video production
  • Large-scale AI workloads
  • Game development
  • Scientific simulations

The GPU in the M5 Max is significantly more powerful than the Pro version, and it supports higher unified memory configurations. If your workflow involves heavy graphics or massive datasets, this is the chip you’ll want.

Related: Mac Processor history: How Apple transformed computing

Massive AI Performance Improvements

The latest MacBook Pro really stands out in AI performance. Apple says the new chips can deliver up to 4× faster AI performance compared to the previous generation, and up to 8× faster in some AI image generation tasks compared to the original M1 Pro and M1 Max. That matters if you use tools like on-device large language models (LLMs), image-generation apps, or other AI-driven creative.

Apple has also improved SSD speeds up to 2x. That means faster file transfers and quicker loading of large projects. Moreover, M5 Pro supports up to 64GB of unified memory with up to 307GB/s of memory bandwidth, while M5 Max can handle up to 128GB of unified memory with up to 614GB/s of memory bandwidth.

If you regularly work with large files, like 4K/8K footage or big development environments, you’ll immediately notice the difference.

Display: Still One of the Best in the Industry

The MacBook Pro continues with the Liquid Retina XDR display, and it remains one of the best laptop displays available.

You get:

  • Extremely high brightness for HDR content
  • Deep blacks and vibrant colors
  • ProMotion technology for smooth scrolling
  • Optional nano-texture glass to reduce glare

If you edit photos or videos, this display is a huge advantage. Colors are accurate, and brightness levels make HDR work much easier.

For developers and writers, the sharpness and clarity also reduce eye strain during long sessions.

Battery Life: Power Without Compromise

Despite the major performance boost, battery life remains impressive.

Apple claims up to 24 hours of battery life on certain configurations. Of course, real-world usage depends on what you’re doing, but even under heavy workloads, MacBook Pro models are known for strong efficiency.

This is where Apple Silicon shines. You get high performance without constantly worrying about charging.

Connectivity and Ports: Pro-Level Setup

Apple hasn’t removed ports, and that’s good news.

You get:

  • Three Thunderbolt 5 ports
  • HDMI supporting up to 8K resolution
  • SDXC card slot
  • MagSafe 3 charging
  • Headphone jack
  • Wi-Fi 7 and Bluetooth support thanks to the new N1 chip

For creators and professionals, this means fewer dongles and better support for high-speed accessories and external displays.

Storage and Memory Options

One notable change is higher starting storage.

  • M5 Pro models start with larger 1TB base storage compared to older generations.
  • M5 Max models offer even higher default storage tiers starting from 2TB.

You can configure the laptop with more unified memory depending on your needs. Since Apple uses unified memory architecture, RAM and GPU memory are shared, making performance more efficient, especially for creative and AI workloads.

If you work with large projects, choosing higher memory will make a noticeable difference.

Pricing: How Much Does It Cost?

Pricing depends on configuration and region.

  • The 14-inch M5 Pro model starts at $2,199, whereas the 16‑inch is priced at $2,699.
  • The 14‑inch MacBook Pro with M5 Max starts at $3,59,9 and the 16‑inch model starts at $3,899.
  • The configurations cost significantly more, especially when you upgrade memory and storage.

This is clearly a professional machine, not an entry-level laptop. If your work generates income or requires high performance daily, the investment may be justified.

Who Should Buy the New MacBook Pro?

You should seriously consider it if you are:

  • A software developer compiling large projects
  • A video editor working in 4K or 8K
  • A 3D designer or animator
  • An AI/ML engineer running local models
  • A professional content creator

If your usage is mostly browsing, streaming, and light office work, this machine is probably overkill.

Final Verdict: Is It Worth Upgrading?

The new MacBook Pro with M5 Pro and M5 Max is clearly built for professionals who demand serious performance.

It’s not just a small upgrade; it’s a meaningful jump in:

  • CPU power
  • GPU performance
  • AI capabilities
  • SSD speed
  • Connectivity

If you’re using an older Intel MacBook or even an early Apple Silicon model and your workflow is demanding, this upgrade could dramatically improve your productivity.

However, if you already own a recent M3 or M4 Pro/Max machine and your system handles your work smoothly, you may not need to upgrade immediately.

Bottom Line

The MacBook Pro M5 Pro and M5 Max models bring desktop-class performance into a portable machine while maintaining excellent battery life and display quality. For professionals, creators, and developers, this is one of the most powerful laptops available right now.

If performance, reliability, and future-proof hardware matter to you, this launch sets a new benchmark.

title.rendered: MacBook Air Gets M5 Chip Upgrade in Apple’s Latest Refresh

content.rendered:
Apple has officially unveiled the latest MacBook Air, now powered by the all-new M5 chip. The refresh brings noticeable performance gains, faster wireless connectivity, and double the base storage, making the world’s most popular laptop even more compelling for students, professionals, and everyday users.

Faster Performance With M5

At the heart of the new MacBook Air is Apple’s next-generation Apple M5 chip.

The M5 features a faster CPU, up to a 10-core GPU, and enhanced machine learning acceleration. Apple claims significantly improved performance in AI-driven tasks compared to the previous generation, with major gains for users upgrading from M1-based models.

Everyday workflows such as photo editing, video trimming, spreadsheet management, and multitasking should feel noticeably quicker. The improved Neural Engine also boosts Apple Intelligence features across the system.

The new Air ships with macOS Tahoe, designed to take full advantage of on-device machine learning.

Now Starts With 512GB Storage

In a welcome move, Apple has doubled the base storage. The MacBook Air now starts at 512GB, addressing one of the most common complaints about earlier models.

Storage can be configured up to 4TB, making it suitable for heavier workflows like video editing and large media libraries.

Wi-Fi 7 and Improved Connectivity

The new model supports Wi-Fi 7 and Bluetooth 6, thanks to Apple’s updated wireless architecture N1 chip. Users can expect faster speeds, lower latency, and improved reliability when connected to compatible routers.

The laptop also includes two Thunderbolt 4 ports and continues to support dual external displays, expanding its appeal for desk-based setups.

Design and Display Remain Familiar

Apple retains the thin, fanless aluminum design available in both 13-inch and 15-inch sizes. The Liquid Retina display continues to deliver sharp text, accurate colors, and strong brightness for both indoor and outdoor use.

Battery life is rated for up to 18 hours, maintaining the all-day endurance the Air lineup is known for.

The laptop also features a 12MP Center Stage camera with Desk View support, enhanced microphones, and a Spatial Audio-capable speaker system.

Pricing and Availability

The 13-inch MacBook Air with M5 starts at $1,099 in the US, while the 15-inch model starts at $1,299. In India, pricing begins at ₹1,19,900.

Pre-orders begin March 4, with availability starting March 11.

Thinking about upgrading to the M5 MacBook Air, or sticking with your current Mac? Share your thoughts in the comments below.

title.rendered: Apple Briefly Lists “MacBook Neo” in Regulatory Filing Ahead of Expected Launch

content.rendered:
Apple briefly revealed the name of a lower-cost MacBook model in a regulatory document published on its website, indicating the device may be called “MacBook Neo.” The reference appeared in an EU compliance listing for Model A3404 before being removed. The device is expected to be formally announced Wednesday.

The regulatory PDF itself did not include the “MacBook Neo” branding, but the product name appeared in a link on Apple’s compliance site. Shortly after the listing was noticed, Apple removed the reference.

Regulatory Listing Identifies Model A3404

The appearance of Model A3404 in Apple’s EU regulatory documentation confirms that a new Mac notebook has cleared compliance requirements ahead of release. Such filings are typically published close to launch and often surface product identifiers before official announcements.

No specifications, images, or pricing details were included in the document.

Positioned Below MacBook Air

The device is expected to sit below the MacBook Air in Apple’s lineup as a lower-cost alternative. Reports surrounding the product have indicated it may use an iPhone-class chip, such as the A18 Pro or A19 Pro, instead of Apple’s M-series processors used in current Mac models.

If accurate, that would mark a shift in Apple’s Mac silicon strategy by deploying a high-end mobile chip in a notebook form factor rather than a dedicated Mac-class system-on-chip. Apple has previously used A-series chips in iPads, but not in modern MacBooks.

The MacBook Neo is also rumored to feature a 12.9-inch display and to launch in brighter color options, including yellow, green, blue, and pink. No hardware details have been confirmed in Apple’s filing.

Pricing and Launch Details

Pricing remains unannounced. Estimates have placed the starting price between $599 and $799, which would position the device below the MacBook Air and closer to the entry-level iPad Pro price band.

Apple is hosting in-person “Apple Experience” briefings in New York, London, and Shanghai at 9 a.m. Eastern Time on Wednesday. The company has not scheduled a livestream event for the launch, suggesting the product will be introduced via press release on the Apple Newsroom.

With the regulatory reference now removed, official details are expected shortly.

How to Redeem Anime Eternal Codes

Redeeming codes is quick once you know where the option is.

  1. Launch Anime Eternal on Roblox
  2. Click the Shop button on the left
  3. Scroll to the very bottom of the shop menu
  4. Enter a working code
  5. Press Redeem

If you do not see the code box, scroll further down. This is the most common reason players think codes are broken.

Where Do New Anime Eternal Codes Come From

Codes are released directly by the developer through official channels.

  • Anime Eternal Discord server, mainly the #codes channel
  • Major game updates and rebalances
  • Holiday events like Halloween and Christmas
  • Milestones for likes, favorites, visits, and player counts
  • Bug fixes and emergency shutdowns

If you do not want to track Discord, bookmarking a regularly updated code page is the easiest option.

Browse our complete list of Roblox codes to unlock free rewards.

Why Your Anime Eternal Code is Not Working

Most code issues are simple and not bugs.

  • The code has expired
  • There is a typo or an extra space
  • Servers have not refreshed after an update
  • The code was entered in the wrong menu

Copy and paste codes when possible. After a new update, rejoin the game before redeeming.

What is Anime Eternal

Anime Eternal is a Roblox incremental game built around fast scaling progression. You click to gain energy, use that energy to fight enemies across different worlds, and open stars to unlock anime-inspired heroes. As you move forward, every system scales quickly, from enemy strength to upgrade costs, which makes resource management important.

The game pulls characters and worlds from multiple anime series rather than focusing on a single franchise. Names and designs are altered, but the inspiration is clear across heroes, maps, and abilities.

Final Thoughts

Anime Eternal codes are part of normal progression, not optional bonuses. Using them early saves time and reduces grind. Check for new codes after every update, use rewards carefully, and avoid sitting on stat resets. In this game, timing matters as much as raw power.

What is Anime Last Stand?

Anime Last Stand is a fast, punchy tower defense game on Roblox where anime-inspired heroes’ team up to protect your base from wave after wave of enemies. You hand pick and upgrade units, each with unique abilities borrowed from beloved series, then place them with care to hold the line. Simple idea, tricky to master.

As you progress, you unlock new characters, power them up, and experiment with different tactics to crack tougher stages. Redeemable codes can deliver a real boost, whether you are new or already deep in the grind, and those free Rerolls, Pearls, and Technique Shards can be the difference when you are shaping a dream defense team.

How to Redeem Codes in Anime Last Stand

Redeeming codes is simple and only takes a moment:

  1. Launch Anime Last Stand in Roblox.
  2. Click the “Codes” button (found on the left or right side of your screen).
  3. Enter or paste your code into the text box.
  4. Click “Redeem” to claim your rewards.
Note

Some codes may require you to join the official Anime Last Stand Roblox group before redeeming.

Quick-Reference Reward Table

Here is a simple table that shows the most common Anime Last Stand code rewards and what they are mainly used for:

Unique or Rare Code Rewards

Occasionally, codes unlock more than the usual currencies. Quick tip for iPhone and iPad, save rare finds in Notes or set a Text Replacement so you paste them cleanly into Roblox. Keep an eye out for: 

  1. Exclusive Units: Some codes have granted limited time characters you cannot get anywhere else, sometimes tied to collabs or a single patch window. 
  2. Event-Only Cosmetics: Unique skins, effects, or accessories that mark your event run, perfect for flexing in lobbies and screenshots. 
  3. One-Time Items: Rare resources or special items linked to big updates or creator milestones, handy when you are pushing harder maps. 

These rewards are especially valuable for collectors and long-term players, since they might not return once the event ends. Blink, and they are gone. 

How Event Currencies Work and Expiry Tips

Event currencies, like Snowflakes, Love Letters, or Soul Coins, show up only during specific seasonal or special events. Treat them as timed tokens. 

  1. Limited Window: These currencies usually expire when the event ends, and any unused amounts are often removed from your inventory. 
  2. Where to Check: End dates appear in games on the event banner or shop, and in the official Discord. On iPhone, a quick Discord alert helps. 
  3. Tip: Spend event currencies before the event concludes so you do not miss exclusive items. A quick Calendar reminder on iPhone or Mac 1 hour before cutoff helps. 

Best-Value Redemption Scenario

Want to get the most from your code rewards? Here is a sample strategy: 

Let’s say you redeem codes over a month and collect 3 Pearls, 50 Rerolls, and 15 Technique Shards. 

  • Wait for a major update or limited time banner featuring a top tier or exclusive unit, set a Calendar reminder on iPhone. 
  • Use Pearls to summon during this banner, maximizing your chance at rare units. 
  • Immediately use your Rerolls and Technique Shards on any powerful new unit you obtain, boosting its abilities for a competitive edge. 
  • If you have event currencies, visit the event shop before it closes to grab exclusive cosmetics or units, check the event tab and Discord for the exact cutoff. 

By saving and timing your redemptions, you ensure every reward lands where it matters most for progression and collection.

Code Rewards and Benefits: What Do You Actually Get?

Anime Last Stand codes unlock a mix of resources, each with a clear job in your build. Each has the best use case. On iPhone or Mac, copy from Notes and paste with Universal Clipboard to avoid typos. 

  1. Rerolls: Spent at the Technique counter to reroll or upgrade a unit’s ability. Best on rare pulls or a new banner unit used daily. 
  2. Technique Shards: A currency for unlocking or enhancing techniques. Save for top tier units or when an update shifts the meta. Quick patch note check helps. 
  3. Pearls: Used to summon exclusive units or obtain rare items. Because Pearls are scarce, wait for limited banners or event rotations, then spend in a focused burst. 
  4. Emeralds: The baseline currency for summoning at the Summon counter. New players should stack Emeralds to build a flexible roster, then refine with Rerolls and Shards. 
  5. Event and Limited-Time Rewards: Some codes deliver event currencies, like Snowflakes for winter units, Love Letters for Valentine cosmetics, or Soul Coins for special shop items. Unique cosmetics or a limited unit can appear, so redeem early and check the event shop before it closes to be safe. 

What Can You Actually Do With Code Rewards?

Here are practical ways to put your code rewards to work. On iPhone or iPad, a quick paste from Notes keeps entries clean. 

  • New Player Example: Redeem all current codes to fire off several summons with Emeralds or Pearls, reroll your best unit’s ability for a stronger start, and maybe unlock a limited time event unit or cosmetic. That jump starts early story progress and lets you hop into ongoing events without stalling. 
  • Veteran Player Example: Bank Pearls and any event currency from codes until the next meta defining banner. Then spend. Use Technique Shards to immediately upgrade newly summoned top tier units. This keeps the roster sharp and ready for late game maps or a leaderboard push. 

Reward Prioritization: What Should You Focus On?

  • New Players: Focus on Emeralds and Rerolls to build your team and optimize early units.
  • Collectors: Save Pearls and event currencies for exclusive banners and rare cosmetics.
  • Competitive Players: Prioritize Technique Shards and Rerolls for meta units, and time redemptions with major updates.

Event/Exclusive Reward Examples

Recent codes have included:

  • Snowflakes: Used for winter event units and shop items.
  • Love Letters: Redeemable for Valentine’s event cosmetics and rewards.
  • Soul Coins: Spendable in the event shop for exclusive units or skins.

Always check what current event currencies can unlock before spending them.

Maximizing Your Rewards: Progression Path Example

If you redeem every code released this month, you can expect to:

  • Summon at least 4–6 new units.
  • Reroll abilities on your best units 50+ times.
  • Unlock at least one exclusive event cosmetic or unit.
  • Earn enough resources to tackle early story content or join current events without extra grinding.

Common Mistakes to Avoid

  • Do not rush to spend Pearls or special currencies. Wait for limited banners or event shops to get the best value. 
  • Check event expiry dates. Some event currencies expire, use them before the event ends. 
  • Avoid rerolling on low tier units. Save Rerolls and Technique Shards for your rarest or most powerful characters. Simple. 

Expert Tips for Maximizing Code Rewards

  1. Plan Your Redemptions: Save high value rewards like Pearls and Technique Shards for big updates or limited banners. 
  2. Synergize Rewards: After summoning a rare unit, use Rerolls immediately to unlock the best abilities. 
  3. Do not Overlook Event Items: Event currencies can unlock exclusive units or cosmetics, claim them before they disappear. 
  4. Use Passive Income: Join AFK World to earn Emeralds and Gold while away, and log in daily for extra rewards from quests and login bonuses. 
  5. Learn from Others: Share your best code pulls or strategies in the comments, and see what is working for other players. 

Troubleshooting: Why Isn’t My Code Working?

If you are having trouble redeeming a code, use this quick checklist. On iPhone or iPad, copy codes from Notes to avoid stray characters. 

  1. Double check spelling and capitalization: Codes are case sensitive; one wrong letter or symbol will cause an error. 
  2. Check for extra spaces: Especially if copying and pasting on mobile, hidden spaces before or after the code can make it invalid. 
  3. Verify code status: Make sure the code has not expired, check this guide’s latest list. 
  4. Join required groups: Some codes only work if you have joined the official Anime Last Stand Roblox group. 
  5. Switch servers: Sometimes codes only work on updated servers. Try rejoining or switching to a different server to force an update. 
  6. Review error messages: “Invalid”, “Already Redeemed”, or “Expired” each has a specific meaning, match the message to the fix above. 
  7. Account issues: If nothing helps, check for account restrictions or bans that may prevent code redemption. 
  8. Time zone delays: For new codes, wait a few hours, sometimes codes roll out gradually across regions. 
  9. Ask the community: Share your issue, with screenshots, in the official Discord or Roblox community for help from moderators or developers. 
Pro Tip Keep a personal log of codes you’ve redeemed to avoid confusion with similar code names, especially if you play on multiple devices or accounts.

How to Get More ALS Codes

Never miss a freebie: 

  • Bookmark this page in Safari and pin it, then check back often for updates. 
  • Join the official Anime Last Stand Discord server for announcements, sneak peeks, and community events, and turn on notifications on iPhone or Apple Watch. 
  • Follow the developers on Roblox and social media for surprise code drops and turn on alerts. 
  • Watch for in game milestones and special events, these often include exclusive codes. Add a Calendar reminder for end dates. 

Stay Updated for More Anime Last Stand Freebies

Anime Last Stand codes are more than free gifts; they help you level up faster and unlock special content. Follow the tips above to squeeze full value from each code and check back often for fresh ones. Have a code, tip, or story, share it in the comments to help the community. 

Happy defending and may your summons always be legendary!

Staying Connected with the Apple Ecosystem

title.rendered: Solo Hunters Codes (April 2026)

content.rendered:
Update: Verified the latest Solo Hunters Codes on April 01, 2026

Dungeon runs in Solo Hunters can feel brutal when your build is not ready. One wrong stat decision or weak class choice can make bosses feel impossible. That is exactly why Solo Hunters codes matter. They give you free Gems, Class Rerolls, and Stat Resets so you can fix mistakes, experiment with builds, and grow stronger without wasting hours.

This guide includes all working Solo Hunters codes for March 2026, expired codes, step-by-step redemption instructions, and clear answers to common questions. Everything is updated and explained in simple terms.

All Working Solo Hunters Codes

  • SoloHuntersISBACK: 500 gems (NEW)
  • ORCCASTLE: 500 gems (NEW)
  • ORCUPDATE: 750 gems (NEW)
  • PORTALREWORK: 1000 gems (NEW)
  • DEMONKINGV2: 3 demon castle tickets, 1 stat reset, and 1 class reroll
  • DEMONCASTLE: 300 gems and 1 class reroll
  • 200KLIKES: 300 gems and 1 class reroll
  • SORRYFORLONGDELAY: 300 gems and 1 class reroll
  • ROCKETSWORD: 200 souls
  • SALAMATPH: 1 class reroll
  • 80KLIKESLETSGOO: 200 gems and 1 stat reset
  • RANDOMUPD: 200 gems
  • UPDMONDAY: 600 gems and 1 stat reset
  • SUB2SISTERGUARD: 300 gems and 1 stat reset
  • GEM222ZZZZ: 1.5k gems
  • REVERTXD: 300 gems and 2 stat resets

These rewards mostly include Gems, which are used to unlock and upgrade abilities. Some codes may grant Stat Resets or Class Rerolls depending on the update.

For more free rewards, check out our updated My Dragon Island codes, Fruit Battlegrounds codes, and Hunty Zombie codes lists for the latest working codes and in-game bonuses.

Expired Solo Hunters Codes

35KCCUTHANKS33, 40KCCUTHANKS66, 50KCCUTHANKSZ, 75KCCUTHANKYOU, ABDUCTEDBYROBLOXIANS, ARIGATOJP, CLASSREROLL, CURSEDCOMMANDER, DANKEGERMANY, DUBSALLAROUND, GEMZZZZ, GOMAWOYO, GRACIASLATAM, GRAZIEITALIA, LOVETOBRAZIL, MERCIFRANCE, OBRIGADOBR, RAA333AAAAPART2, RAAAAAAAA, RAAAAAAAAPART2, RAIDFIXED, RELEASE, RESETMYSTATS, SHABORUSSIA, SORRYABOUTUPD, TERIMAKASIHID, THANKSFORTHELIKESGUYS, THANKSFORTHELOVE, THXFORTHEHYPE, TOTHEMOON, UPDATETHISWEEKEND, WWWW

What Do Solo Hunters Codes Give?

Most codes reward one of the following:

  • Gems – The main in-game currency used for unlocking and improving abilities.
  • Class Rerolls – Let’s you change your class if you are unhappy with your current one.
  • Stat Resets – Resets your allocated stats so you can rebuild your character properly.

If you are new, save rerolls until you understand how classes perform in higher-tier dungeons. Stat resets are best used when you want to completely change your build.

How to Redeem Codes in Solo Hunters

The redemption system differs slightly from that in most Roblox games. You cannot enter codes from a menu. You must visit a specific NPC in the Overworld.

Follow these steps carefully:

  1. Launch Solo Hunters in Roblox.
  2. Complete the opening tutorial until you unlock the Overworld.
  3. Press Start Dungeon if needed and wake up in the Overworld area.
  4. Press M on PC to open the map.
  5. Head all the way south toward the dock area.
  6. Look for the blue NPC wearing a red hat near the crane.
  7. Approach the NPC and press E to interact.
  8. Enter a working code in the text box.
  9. Click Redeem.

On mobile, the map shortcut may not be available. Simply walk south from spawn until you reach the docks.

Why Is My Solo Hunter’s code not working?

If a code fails, it is usually for one of these reasons:

  • The code has expired.
  • You typed it incorrectly.
  • You copied an extra space before or after the code.
  • The game servers have just been updated and will take a minute to refresh.

Codes are sometimes case-sensitive in Roblox games, so the safest option is to copy and paste directly. Each code can only be redeemed once per account.

Browse our complete list of Roblox codes to unlock free rewards.

How Often Are New Codes Released?

New codes usually appear:

  • After major updates
  • During bug fixes
  • When the game hits milestones
  • During seasonal events

Developers typically share code in their official Discord server, mostly inside the announcements channel. Since they do not always tag players, many people miss them. That is why keeping this page bookmarked saves time. We update this page as soon as new codes drop. 

What Is Solo Hunters?

Solo Hunters is a dungeon-crawling Roblox RPG inspired by Solo Leveling. You start as a weak hunter and gradually grow stronger by clearing dungeons, defeating bosses, collecting loot, and upgrading abilities. Each dungeon has multiple rooms, tougher enemies, and a final boss that tests your build.

Your stats directly impact performance. Strength, Defense, Health, Attack Speed, and Critical Chance all shape your playstyle. A poorly planned build can slow your progress. A smart build can make even higher-tier dungeons manageable.

Codes help bridge that gap. They give you flexibility. They give you second chances. And in a game where scaling matters, that flexibility is powerful.

Final Thoughts

Solo Hunters reward patience and smart build planning. Codes are not just free rewards. They are tools that help you refine your character and stay competitive as updates roll out.

Redeem active codes quickly, experiment carefully with rerolls, and use stat resets only when you understand your class direction. That is how you grow from a rookie hunter into one of the strongest players in the dungeon.

In case you missed

  • 99 Nights in the Forest Codes
  • Roblox Music Codes
  • Roblox You VS Homer Codes
  • Roblox Knockout Codes
  • Roblox Horse Life Codes

content.rendered:
Update: Verified the latest Anime Defenders Codes on March 3, 2026

If you play Anime Defenders on Roblox, you know how tough it gets after a few waves. The enemies don’t slow down, and if your team isn’t strong enough, you’re toast. That’s where codes come in; they give you free Gems, Exclusive Wishes, Relics, and Trait Crystals that help you summon better characters and upgrade your units faster. Whether you’re new to the game or grinding for the next big update, these Anime Defenders codes are your shortcut to progress.

All Working Anime Defenders Codes

  • merrychristmas: 1000x Snowflakes
  • hollydefenders: 1 Exclusive Wish
  • xmassoon: 5x Divine Trait Crystals
  • REDONE: 1 Exclusive Wish
  • ELEMENTS: 1000 Ancient Relics
  • SKILLTREES: 5x Divine Trait Crystals
  • subcool: 50 Gems
  • sub2toadboigaming: 50 Gems
  • sub2mozking: 50 Gems
  • sub2karizmaqt: 50 Gems
  • sub2jonaslyz: 50 Gems
  • sub2riktime: 50 Gems
  • sub2nagblox: 50 Gems

Expired Anime Defenders Codes

200KHOLYMOLY, ADFOREVER, ADONTOP, APOLOGYDEFENDERS, ATHENYXLIVEX, CODEIS, DAYUM100M, DIVINESPIRITS, DRAGONPART1, FIVEPOINTFIVE, FORTUNETICKETS, GOODBYEHELENE, IDK, INCREDIBILLI, MEGAUPDATEX, MEMBEREREBREWRERES, NEWREALMX, QOLUPDATE, RAIDSARECOOL, RELEASE2024, SAYONARAMILTON, SORRY4DELAY, SOWY4DELAY, SUMMERTIME, THANKS400K, THANKS500K, TYFORFEEDBACK, UPDATE2, UPDATE6, WSINDACH4HT

How to Redeem Codes in Anime Defenders

You can’t redeem codes right after starting the game. First, you need to reach Level 8 and make sure your Roblox account is at least 90 days old. Once you meet those conditions, here’s how to redeem a code:

  1. Open Anime Defenders on Roblox.
  2. Click the three dots (…) on the top left of your screen.
  3. Select the Codes option from the menu.
  4. Paste a working code into the text box.
  5. Press the Redeem button.

We may earn from qualifying affiliate purchases. Read more.

Troubleshooting: What to Do If a Code Doesn’t Work

If a code doesn’t work, don’t assume it’s broken right away. Here are a few things to check:

  • Double-check for typos. Codes are case-sensitive.
  • Make sure you copied the full code correctly.
  • Confirm your account is over 90 days old and you’re level 8 or higher.
  • Restart the game — some codes only work on newer servers.
  • If nothing works, the code may have expired.

What Do Anime Defenders Codes Give You?

Anime Defenders codes don’t just hand out random freebies. Each reward plays a key role in helping you summon stronger units, power up your characters, or collect limited-time event items.

These items are essential for progressing through tougher levels or preparing for big updates.

You may like to read: Best short anime to watch instead of One Piece

Where to Find More Anime Defenders Codes

The developers don’t follow a fixed schedule when dropping new codes. Here’s where to find them first:

  • Join the Anime Defenders Discord and check the announcements channel.
  • Follow @Anime_Defenders on X (Twitter).
  • Join the official AD Roblox group.
  • Bookmark this article, we update it every time new codes drop.

Browse our complete list of Roblox codes to unlock free rewards.

Tips to Dominate Anime Defenders

Even with codes, you’ll need a good strategy to win. Here are some quick tips:

  • Log in daily to get extra rewards just for showing up.
  • Join the Roblox group for bonus gems.
  • Use the AFK area when you’re away to farm gems passively.
  • Focus on summoning and upgrading a balanced team.
  • Play Story Mode and Endless Mode to unlock more content and earn rewards.

The stronger your team, the longer you last and the more fun you’ll have. Use those codes, plan your summons, and keep climbing!

Update: Verified the latest Hunty Zombie Codes on April 12, 2026

Hunty Zombie throws you straight into chaos. You land in a world full of zombies, bosses, and wild anime style attacks, and the only way to survive is to keep getting stronger. That means better weapons, stronger perks, and a lot of grinding.

Thankfully, the game gives out plenty of codes that help you level up faster. These rewards may seem small at first, but when you’re stuck fighting a boss with barely any HP left, you start appreciating every free spin and every extra coin. Here are all the working Hunty Zombie codes, the expired ones, and the steps to redeem them.

All Working Hunty Zombie Codes

  • GiveMeMyCarrotBack: Lucky Weapon Spin, Perk Spin, and Trait (NEW)
  • QoL: 111 Lucky Perk Spins (NEW)

How to Redeem Hunty Zombie Codes

Before you redeem anything, make sure you reach level 5. Some rewards don’t work unless you meet that requirement.

Once you’re ready:

  1. Open Hunty Zombie on Roblox.
  2. Tap the Codes button on the right side of the screen.
  3. Type any working code into the text box.
  4. Hit Confirm to claim your rewards.

If a code doesn’t work, try using it on a private server. Many players said that some codes only work there.

That’s everything you need to start collecting free spins and coins in Hunty Zombie. These codes make your early game easier, especially when you’re still figuring things out or trying to get your first Mythic weapon. Stay sharp, survive longer, and keep checking for new codes every week.

Where to Find More Hunty Zombie Codes

Most new codes appear when the developers release updates or run in-game events. The HZ DEV Roblox group is the best place to check because announcements usually land there first.

The game’s update page often includes codes as well, so checking it regularly is worth it. If you like staying stocked on spins, bookmarking a reliable codes page also helps.

Why Your Hunty Zombie Code Is Not Working?

Sometimes a code shows as invalid even if it was recently released. These are the most common reasons:

  • You haven’t reached level 5 yet.
  • The code is case sensitive and must be typed exactly.
  • The code may only work in a private server.
  • The code has already expired, even if other sites still list it.
  • The server you are in is outdated and needs a rejoin.

Try switching servers, especially private ones, and re-enter the code carefully.

Visit the updated Roblox game codes list for the newest rewards.

Other Useful Tips

  • Save your Lucky Spins for new weapons added in big updates.
  • Coins are easy to burn through, so use them on upgrades that help you survive longer.
  • Don’t waste Traits on weak weapons. Wait until you get a solid drop.
  • Check for codes after big milestones like likes, visits, or events.

title.rendered: Best iPhone 17e Cases You Can Buy Right Now

content.rendered:
The iPhone 17e is Apple’s latest addition to its lineup, designed for users who want powerful performance, a stunning display, and a sleek design without stepping into ultra-premium pricing. Like every new iPhone, the 17e features a beautiful glass back, refined aluminum frame, and improved camera system.

But here’s the thing: it’s still glass. And glass breaks. That’s why choosing the right case for your iPhone 17e matters. In this guide, I’ll walk you through the best iPhone 17e cases you can buy right now, based on usability, protection level, and overall value.

Table of Contents
  • How We Picked the Best iPhone 17e Cases
  • 5 Best Cases for iPhone 17e
    • 1. Spigen Liquid Air MagFit – Best Slim Protective Case
    • 2. ESR Clear MagSafe Case – Best Clear iPhone 17e Case
    • 3. FNTCase Matte Case With Screen Protector – Best Budget Protection Bundle
    • 4. Smartish Case with Card Holder – Best Wallet Case
    • 5. Torro Leather Case – Best Premium iPhone 17e Case
  • What to Look for When Buying an iPhone 17e Case
  • Keep Your iPhone 17e Safe!

How We Picked the Best iPhone 17e Cases

A good case doesn’t just protect your phone from drops and scratches. It also enhances grip, provides useful features such as card slots, and lets you express your personal style.

To keep things practical, we focused on real-world usage instead of marketing claims. Here’s what we looked at:

  • Protection Level: Drop protection, shock absorption, raised edges for screen and camera protection, and military-grade certifications.
  • Everyday Usability: Grip comfort, button responsiveness, pocket-friendliness, and compatibility with MagSafe charging.
  • Build Quality: Material durability, resistance to yellowing (for clear cases), and long-term wear.
  • Extra Features: Card holders, bundled screen protectors, leather finish, or rugged enhancements.
  • Brand Reputation & Value: Well-known brands with consistent product quality and positive customer reviews.

Now let’s get into the best iPhone 17e cases for daily protection.

5 Best Cases for iPhone 17e

Whether you want a slim and minimal, clear, or military-grade rugged case, you will find the perfect one for your iPhone 17e.

1. Spigen Liquid Air MagFit – Best Slim Protective Case

If you want a slim case that doesn’t add bulk but still protects your phone well, the Spigen Liquid Air is an excellent choice. The case features a flexible TPU material with a matte textured back and grooves. That texture isn’t just for looks; it significantly improves grip, which reduces accidental drops.

The slim profile makes it easy to carry in pockets, and it doesn’t interfere with wireless charging. It also offers Air Cushion technology in the corners for military-grade shock absorption and raised lips around the screen and camera. Moreover, the integrated magnets lets you use MagSafe accessories with your iPhone 17e.

Spigen has also launched several cases for iPhone 17e, including clear Liquid Crystal MagFit, Ultra Hybrid with kickstand, etc.

Best for: People who want everyday protection without turning their iPhone 17e into a bulky brick.

Check out on Amazon

2. ESR Clear MagSafe Case – Best Clear iPhone 17e Case

The iPhone 17e launched in three beautiful colors, so hiding it under a thick case doesn’t make sense. That’s where the ESR Clear Case comes in. The reinforced Air Guard corners absorb shock up to 11-ft drops, while the sleek 1.6mm transparent back highlights the original iPhone design.

Many clear cases turn yellow over time, but ESR includes tough acrylic and anti-yellowing materials to resist scratches and the slow oxidation process. It’s slim, lightweight, and fully compatible with MagSafe wireless charging. Additionally, ESR has used high-grade magnets with 1500g holding power.

Best for: Users who want to show off their iPhone 17e while keeping it safe from scratches and minor drops.

Check out on Amazon

3. FNTCase Matte Case With Screen Protector – Best Budget Protection Bundle

Looking a allrounder protection at a budget-friendly price? The FNTCase Matte Case with Screen Protector for iPhone 17e offers serious value. This case includes a screen protector in the box, which saves you extra cost.

The matte finish resists sweat and fingerprints, and provides better grip. Reinforced air bag corners, shockproof TPU sides, and raised edges offer strong 10-ft drop protection. You can choose between multiple color options to match your vibe.

If you need even more rugged durability, FNTCase also offers a heavier-duty version with kickstand and holster designed for tougher environments.

Best for: Students, workers, or anyone who wants strong protection without spending too much.

Check out on Amazon

4. Smartish Case with Card Holder – Best Wallet Case

If you’re tired of carrying both a wallet and a phone, the Smartish Wallet Case is a smart solution. I like its aesthetic design and sleek profile. This case has a built-in card slot on the back that can hold 4 cards and cash securely. The thumb slot lets you push out the cards for quick access.

Despite the extra storage, it remains relatively slim and offers decent drop protection up to 6 feet. The textured sides keep the case grippy and prevents slip offs. It’s perfect for quick errands, travel, or minimal everyday carry. However, you can’t charge your phone wirelessly with the case on.

Best for: Minimalists who want to carry fewer things.

Check out on Amazon

5. Torro Leather Case – Best Premium iPhone 17e Case

Last but not least, here’s a more professional and elegant case for your iPhone 17e. Made from premium top-grain cowhide leather, Torro case is handcrafted and develops a natural patina over time, giving it a unique look. The interior microfiber lining protects against scratches.

The best part is you can use it as a kickstand for hands-free viewing and FaceTime calls. Also, the front cover has pockets to carry cash and cards. Simply, lock the front using the magnetic clasp to keep everything secure. Therefore, it’s ideal for business settings or anyone who prefers a classic aesthetic over rugged styling.

Best for: Professionals who want protection with style.

Check out on Amazon

What to Look for When Buying an iPhone 17e Case

Think about how you use your phone before making a purchase.

  • If you drop your phone often: Go for military-grade protection or reinforced corners (Spigen or FNTCase rugged).
  • Care about looks? Clear cases (ESR) or leather options (Torro) are great choices.
  • If you want convenience: A wallet case like Smartish reduces what you carry.
  • Check for raised edges: This protects both the camera module and screen when the phone is placed on a flat surface.
  • MagSafe charging compatibility: Most slim and TPU iPhone 17e cases support it, but wallet and very thick rugged cases may reduce charging efficiency.
  • Grip matters more than you think: A slippery phone is a dropped phone. Textured or matte finishes improve safety in daily use.

Keep Your iPhone 17e Safe!

The best iPhone 17e case isn’t just about protection; it’s about how you use your phone every day.

Ultimately, a good case matches your lifestyle, not just your phone. So, choose the one that suits your lifestyle, and your iPhone 17e will be protected for years to come.

  • Best iPhone 17e Screen Protectors
  • Must-Have Accessories for iPhone 17e

title.rendered: Snapchat Parental Controls: How to Set Up Family Center and Keep Your Teen Safe

content.rendered:
Since its debut, Snapchat has grown into one of the most popular social media platforms among teenagers worldwide. Its disappearing messages, creative camera tools, and fast-paced communication style make it highly appealing to younger users. At the same time, this rapidly expanding teen audience has raised concerns among parents about online safety, screen time, and digital interactions.

To address these concerns, Snapchat introduced Family Center, a dedicated parental control feature that allows parents to gain insight into their teens’ app usage while still respecting their privacy.

Here’s everything you need to know about Snapchat parental controls.

Table of Contents
  • What Are Snapchat Parental Controls?
  • Requirements to Set Up Family Center on Snapchat
  • How to Set Up Parental Controls on Snapchat
  • What Insights Parents Get from the Family Center
    • Friend and Communication Insights
    • Screen Time and Usage Insights
    • Safety and Activity Visibility
  • What Parents Cannot See on Snapchat
  • Limitations of Snapchat Parental Controls
  • A Safer Snapchat Experience

What Are Snapchat Parental Controls?

Snapchat parental controls are available inside Family Center, a supervision dashboard designed for parents and teens aged 13 to 17.

Once enabled, parents can:

  • View their teen’s friend list
  • See recent contacts
  • Monitor weekly usage insights
  • Understand new friend connections
  • Access reporting and safety tools

Requirements to Set Up Family Center on Snapchat

As a parent, you cannot set up parental controls on Snapchat until you meet the following requirements:

  • Both the parent and the teen have Snapchat accounts.
  • You are friends on Snapchat.
  • The teen accepts the supervision invitation.

Snapchat has made it clear that Family Center only works after mutual approval between the parent and teen accounts.

How to Set Up Parental Controls on Snapchat

Now that you know what Family Center on Snapchat is and meet the requirements to set it up, here’s how you can set up Family Center (Parental Controls) on Snapchat:

  1. Go to your Snapchat account settings.
  2. Here, scroll down and tap Family Center under the Privacy Controls section.
  3. Next, select your teen’s account and tap the Send Invitation button. Your teen will receive a request via Snapchat.
  4. Now, ask (not order) your teen to accept the invitation.
  5. Once the teen accepts the invite, parental controls activate.

What Insights Parents Get from the Family Center

Once Family Center is set up, parents gain access to activity insights that help them understand how their teens use Snapchat without viewing private conversations. The feature focuses on awareness and safety rather than direct monitoring.

Here’s what parents can see inside Family Center:

Friend and Communication Insights

Parents can:

  • See their teen’s friend list
  • See who they recently interacted with
  • Check newly added friends

Additionally, Snapchat also provides Friend Trust Signals that show how a new connection may be linked, such as through mutual friends or shared contacts, helping parents better understand unfamiliar connections without revealing message content.

Screen Time and Usage Insights

Parents can see weekly screen time insights, including the average amount of time their teen spends on Snapchat and how that time is distributed across features like Chat, Camera, Snap Map, Stories, and Spotlight. These insights help families discuss app usage habits more informatively.

Safety and Activity Visibility

Family Center also gives parents access to safety and reporting tools and shows the teen’s location-sharing status when enabled by the teen.

What Parents Cannot See on Snapchat

Even with parental controls enabled, Snapchat protects teen privacy by limiting parents from:

  • Reading messages or Snaps
  • Viewing chat media
  • Accessing saved conversations
  • Seeing passwords or private files

Limitations of Snapchat Parental Controls

While Family Center offers helpful insights and supervision tools for parents, Snapchat has designed it to balance safety with teen privacy. Therefore, parents should understand that these controls provide visibility rather than full monitoring.

Here are some important limitations to keep in mind:

  • No access to messages or Snaps: Parents cannot read chats, view shared media, or access saved conversations. Snapchat keeps all personal communication private.
  • No screen time restrictions: Family Center shows usage insights but does not allow parents to set daily time limits or block app usage.
  • Teen approval is required: Parental supervision only works after the teen accepts the invitation.
  • Teens can leave Family Center at any time: Teens can end supervision whenever they choose, which immediately removes parental access to Family Center insights.
  • Limited content filtering: Snapchat does not offer robust content blocking tools like dedicated parental control apps.
  • Location sharing is optional: Parents can only see the teen’s location status if the teen enables location sharing in Snap Map.

A Safer Snapchat Experience

Snapchat’s Family Center gives parents greater peace of mind by offering meaningful insights into their teen’s activity on the platform while still respecting personal privacy. Instead of enabling strict monitoring, the feature focuses on transparency and awareness, helping families stay informed without compromising trust.

Remember, it is also important for parents to have open conversations with their teens about online behavior and safety.

Are you using Snapchat Family Center for your teen? Let us know your experience in the comments.

FAQs

Can parents read Snapchat messages?

Snapchat does not allow parents to view message content through Family Center.

Does Snapchat allow screen-time limits?

No built-in limits exist, but parents can view weekly usage insights.

Can teens remove parental supervision?

Snapchat allows teens to end supervision at any time, reflecting its consent-based design.

How to Redeem Mugen Codes

You can redeem codes across all Roblox platforms (iOS, Android, Mac, and Windows).

Just make sure you’re not in Combat mode:

  1. Launch Mugen on Roblox.
  2. Tap the “Codes” tab at the bottom of the screen.
  3. Enter or paste your code into the box.
  4. Hit “Enter” and enjoy your rewards!

Common Issues With Roblox Mugen Codes (and Fixes)

If a code isn’t working, here’s how to troubleshoot:

  • Double-check spelling (codes are case-sensitive).

  • Copy and paste instead of typing manually.
  • Log out and back in to refresh.

  • Enter the code in Character mode, not Combat mode.
  • On mobile, remove hidden spaces when pasting.
  • If servers are lagging, rejoin later and try again.

Final Thoughts

Mugen codes are the easiest way to stack up spins, yen, and unlock stronger builds without endless grinding. Stay active in the community, redeem codes regularly, and you’ll always be a step ahead of the competition.

Update: Verified the latest Arise Ragnarok Codes on March 3, 2026

Arise Ragnarok is a grind-heavy Roblox RPG where progress depends on your build, gear, and time investment. Arise Ragnarok codes reduce that grind by giving free rewards that directly boost your progress.

These codes give you coins, class rerolls, stat resets, and event rewards, letting you fix build mistakes, try new classes, and progress faster without spending Robux. For new players, they provide a strong early boost. For returning players, they’re the quickest way to catch up after updates.

Expired Arise Ragnarok Codes List

Currently, all available codes are valid and can be redeemed. Keep in mind that developers may remove them when new codes are issued, so it’s best to redeem them promptly.

How to Redeem Arise Ragnarok Codes in Roblox

Follow these steps exactly to avoid errors:

  1. Launch Arise Ragnarok on Roblox.
  2. Wait for the game to fully load.
  3. Open the Shop menu on the left side of the screen.
  4. Enter the code exactly as shown.
  5. Click Redeem.

If the code is valid, rewards are applied instantly.

Looking for more freebies? Claim bonuses in Dungeon Hunters codes, redeem the latest Borderlands 4 SHiFT codes, or pick up powerups with our Ghoul Re codes guide.

Common Arise Ragnarok Code Redemption Issues

Even valid Arise Ragnarok codes can fail if they are not entered correctly or if the game servers are not fully synced. Most redemption problems are minor and easy to fix once you know what causes them.

  • The code has expired or was already redeemed on your account
  • Incorrect capitalization, extra spaces, or formatting mistakes
  • Copy-paste errors, such as missing characters or hidden line breaks
  • Trying to redeem codes during server lag or immediately after an update

If a code does not work, recheck spelling, remove extra spaces, rejoin the server, and wait a few minutes after major updates before trying again.

What Are Arise Ragnarok Codes and How Do They Work?

Arise Ragnarok codes are developer-issued promotional codes that can be redeemed inside the in-game Shop. When redeemed, they instantly grant rewards to your account.

These rewards directly impact gameplay:

  • Coins: Buy gear and progression items faster
  • Class Rerolls: Change your class without restarting
  • Stat Resets: Rebuild your character properly
  • Event Rewards: Limited-time bonuses tied to updates

Codes are released by CLGAMES during updates, milestones, and events. They expire to keep rewards time-limited and prevent long-term balance issues.

Benefits of Using Arise Ragnarok Codes for Faster Progression

Using codes gives you practical advantages without spending Robux:

  • Faster early-game progression
  • Ability to fix build mistakes instantly
  • Freedom to test different classes
  • Reduced grinding for coins and resets

Codes are especially valuable after updates or when learning the game’s systems.

Where to Find New Arise Ragnarok Codes Safely

Developers release new codes on their social platforms:

  • Official Arise Ragnarok Discord (code-list channel)
  • CLGAMES Roblox group page
  • Developer social media accounts (X/Twitter, announcements)

You can also bookmark this page, as we regularly update this guide with the latest working Arise Ragnarok codes as soon as they are released.

Codes are usually released during updates, milestones, and events.

FAQ

Are Arise Ragnarok codes free?

Yes. All codes are free and require no Robux or real money.

How often are new codes released?

New codes typically appear during updates and milestone events, sometimes multiple times per week.

Can expired codes be reactivated?

No. Expired codes usually remain permanently disabled unless officially re-released.

title.rendered: Dungeon Hunters Codes (April 2026)

content.rendered:
Update: Verified the latest Dungeon Hunters Codes on March 3, 2026

Dungeon Hunters is a fast-paced Roblox dungeon crawler where progress depends on upgrading weapons and gear. While dungeon runs and loot drops drive gameplay, advancement slows down without enough resources.

Dungeon Hunters promo codes solve this by giving free Gems, the game’s most important currency, letting you summon better weapons and upgrade gear without grinding or spending Robux.

All New Dungeon Hunters Codes

  • Dc_!20000: 100 Diamonds (NEW)
  • 200K_liKEs: 100 Diamonds (NEW)
  • Dc_15000!: 100 Diamonds (NEW)
  • Dc_!10000!: 100 Diamonds
  • dC_!9000: 100 Diamonds

  • 12K_LiKes: 100 Diamonds
  • 5K_lIKes: 100 Diamonds
  • 1K_LiKes: 100 Diamonds
  • 100liKES: 100 Diamonds
  • DC_join: 100 Diamonds
  • NEW: 100 Diamonds

Expired Dungeon Hunters Codes

Currently, all available codes are valid and can be redeemed. Keep in mind that developers may remove them when new codes are issued, so it’s best to redeem them promptly.

What Are Dungeon Hunters Codes?

Dungeon Hunters codes are limited-time promotional codes released by the developers to reward players with free Gems or Diamonds. These currencies are used to summon weapons, enhance gear, and keep progression moving when difficulty increases.

Most active codes grant around 100 Gems each. While a single code may seem small, redeeming several at once can provide a strong early or mid-game boost. Because codes are case-sensitive, they must be entered exactly as shown. Each code can only be redeemed once and expires after a set time, so claiming them early is the only way to benefit.

If you play other Roblox titles too, you might want to check out our Parkour Champions codes, Hunty Zombie codes, and Anime Crusaders codes to grab more freebies.

How to Redeem Dungeon Hunters Codes

Follow these steps to redeem codes:

  1. Launch Dungeon Hunters on Roblox.
  2. Enter the main lobby.
  3. Click the gear icon in the top-right corner.
  4. Locate the “Enter code…” field.
  5. Paste the code exactly as shown.
  6. Press OK to claim the reward.

Valid codes add Gems instantly to your account.

Benefits of Using Dungeon Hunters Codes

Using codes provides clear progression advantages:

  • Free premium currency with no Robux required.
  • Faster access to stronger weapons.
  • Smoother progression through difficult dungeons and bosses.
  • Helps new players progress without heavy grinding.

Multiple codes stack, making even small rewards valuable.

Where to Find New Dungeon Hunters Codes

New Dungeon Hunters codes are released through official game channels. These are the only reliable sources where developers share valid and working codes:

  • Official Dungeon Hunters Discord server (Announcements channel).
  • Official Roblox game page and update notes.
  • Developer posts and in-game announcements during updates or events.

To make sure you never miss a code, bookmark this page and check back regularly. We update this guide frequently whenever new Dungeon Hunters codes are released, so you’ll always find the latest working rewards here.

Common Dungeon Hunters Code Redemption Issues

If a code fails, it’s usually due to one of the following:

  • Incorrect capitalization (codes are case-sensitive)
  • Extra spaces before or after the code
  • The code has expired
  • The code was already redeemed

Copy-pasting codes and redeeming them early avoids most issues.

Conclusion

Dungeon Hunters codes are the fastest way to earn free Gems and progress without grinding or spending Robux. Since codes expire quickly, checking for updates regularly is essential.

Staying active in the official Discord ensures you never miss new rewards.

FAQs

What are Dungeon Hunters Codes?

Promotional, case-sensitive codes that grant free Gems or Diamonds when redeemed in-game.

Can expired codes be reused?

No. Expired codes cannot be redeemed again.

How often are new codes released?

There is no fixed schedule. Codes usually appear during updates, milestones, or special events.

In case you missed

  • Tap Simulator Codes
  • Ghoul Re Codes
  • Dueling Grounds Codes
  • Anime Final Quest Codes

title.rendered: Best iPhone 17e Screen Protectors You Can Buy Now

content.rendered:
The iPhone 17e carries Apple’s signature premium DNA, even though it sits at the more accessible end of the lineup. However, its competitive price does not translate into a compromised display experience. The high-quality 6.1-inch panel delivers sharp resolution, accurate colors, and excellent brightness levels suitable for both indoor and outdoor use.

To keep that beautiful screen safe from scratches, drops, and everyday wear and tear, investing in a solid screen protector is non-negotiable. While Apple’s Ceramic Shield front glass is durable, a dedicated protector still provides an extra layer of defense and helps preserve resale value.

Here are my top five picks for the best iPhone 17e screen protectors.

Table of Contents
  • What to Look for in an iPhone 17e Screen Protector
  • 5 Best Screen Protectors for iPhone 17e
    • 1. Spigen Glas.tR EZ Fit Tempered Glass Screen Protector
    • 2. ESR 9H+ Glass Screen Protector
    • 3. ZAGG Glass Elite Screen Protector
    • 4. TOCOL Privacy Screen Protector
    • 5. ZAGG XTR4 Screen Protector
  • Tips for Applying a Screen Protector on iPhone
  • Protect Your iPhone 17e the Right Way…

What to Look for in an iPhone 17e Screen Protector

Before diving into specific recommendations, here are the key factors you should consider when choosing a screen protector for your iPhone 17e.

  • Tempered Glass with 9H Hardness: Look for genuine tempered glass rated at 9H hardness. This protects against scratches from keys, coins, and everyday wear and tear.
  • Edge-to-Edge Coverage: A properly cut protector should align precisely with the 6.1-inch display, offering full coverage without interfering with cases.
  • Oleophobic Coating: A good fingerprint-resistant coating keeps smudges to a minimum and makes cleaning easier.
  • Touch Sensitivity: The protector should not compromise responsiveness. Premium options maintain the same fluid scrolling and gesture control.
  • Installation System: Alignment trays or installation frames reduce air bubbles and misalignment issues, which is useful for first-time installations.
  • Special Features: Privacy filters, anti-reflective coating, or reinforced impact layers can be valuable depending on your usage.

5 Best Screen Protectors for iPhone 17e

Here are some of the best screen protectors you can consider.

1. Spigen Glas.tR EZ Fit Tempered Glass Screen Protector

Spigen’s Glas. tR EZ Fit is one of the easiest protectors to install, thanks to the included alignment tray. The tempered glass has a 9H hardness rating, meaning it can handle everyday scratches from keys, coins, and other hard objects. It’s also ultra-clear, so it doesn’t impact brightness or color accuracy, and its oleophobic coating helps resist fingerprints.

Pros

  • Easy installation with an alignment tray
  • Strong scratch resistance
  • Good clarity and touch response

Cons

  • No privacy or anti-glare features
  • Slightly thicker than some ultra-thin options

Check out on Amazon

2. ESR 9H+ Glass Screen Protector

The ESR set includes three tempered glass protectors, which is a great value if you plan to replace them after wear. It’s engineered to be both impact-resistant and highly transparent, so your display stays crisp and touch-sensitive. Additionally, the bundled EPF installation tray and cleaning kit make fitting easier.

Pros

  • Great protection at a reasonable price
  • High clarity maintains the original screen feel
  • Extra protectors in the pack and installation tools included

Cons

  • No premium features
  • Basic oleophobic coating

Check out on Amazon

3. ZAGG Glass Elite Screen Protector

ZAGG’s Glass Elite is a more premium glass protector designed for users who prioritize durability. It’s made from reinforced aluminosilicate glass that can withstand everyday scratches and minor drops. The glass also resists smudges well and maintains a strong touch response.

Pros

  • Premium aluminosilicate tempered glass
  • Strong scratch and minor impact resistance
  • Oleophobic coating keeps fingerprints at bay

Cons

  • Slightly pricier than basic tempered glass options
  • Installation can be a bit fiddly

Check out on Amazon

4. TOCOL Privacy Screen Protector

The TOCOL privacy screen protector is ideal if you often use your iPhone in public settings like trains, cafes, or offices. It combines tempered glass protection with a privacy filter that limits viewing angles. The screen looks normal straight on, but dims when seen from the side.

Pros

  • Blocks side-angle views for privacy
  • Provides durable tempered glass protection
  • Reduces fingerprint smudges 

Cons

  • Loss of brightness, especially outdoors
  • Slightly higher price than standard protectors

Check out on Amazon

5. ZAGG XTR4 Screen Protector

ZAGG’s XTR4 is their highest-end offering in this list. It brings enhanced coatings that improve clarity and reduce reflections, and many versions also block a portion of blue light. Its impact protection is strong, making it suitable if you want maximum everyday defense.

Pros

  • Exceptional durability with premium coatings
  • Anti-reflective surface improves outdoor visibility
  • Often includes blue-light filtering benefits

Cons

  • Higher cost relative to other options
  • Some users notice a slight tint from coatings

Check out on Amazon

Tips for Applying a Screen Protector on iPhone

While all the screen protectors on this list come with an installation kit, proper application still makes a big difference in the final result. A careful install ensures better adhesion, fewer bubbles, and longer durability.

Here are a few quick tips:

  • Clean the display thoroughly using the included alcohol wipe and microfiber cloth.
  • Remove dust particles with the provided sticker before installation.
  • Use an alignment tray if included.
  • Apply from one edge and allow the adhesive to spread naturally.
  • Press gently at the center to eliminate remaining air bubbles.

Protect Your iPhone 17e the Right Way…

These were some of the best iPhone 17e screen protectors available right now. Go ahead and choose the one that aligns with your usage habits and budget. A small investment today can save you from an expensive screen replacement tomorrow.

Did we miss your favorite iPhone 17e screen protector? Drop it in the comments below.

  • Best iPhone 17e Cases You Can Buy

About Vikhyat Rishi

  • Vikhyat has over five years of experience writing consumer tech content.
  • During his association with Smartprix and Beebom, Vikhyat has tested, tested, and reviewed numerous gadgets, including but not limited to smartphones, TVs, and more.
  • His passion for technology and Apple products led him to iGeeksBlog, where he specializes in writing How-to and troubleshooting guides for fellow Apple enthusiasts.

Experience

Vikhyat embarked on his journey in consumer technology writing in 2019, driven by his passion for technology. He has sharpened his skills through associations with Smartprix and Beebom, where he extensively tested and reviewed various gadgets, focusing mainly on smartphones. Currently, Vikhyat specializes in crafting How-to and troubleshooting guides for the Apple ecosystem at iGeeksBlog. When not typing away on his MacBook Air, he loves exploring the real world.
